[1. PURPOSE]
배달앱 단품 메뉴 썸네일용 photoreal food image. Rich, clickable single-dish presentation optimized for app grid visibility, with realistic tabletop context and a small delivery-menu information treatment that feels like an actual app listing photo.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main dish hero centered and fills about 75–80% of the frame, with the food surface occupying most of the square while still allowing realistic tabletop details to support the scene.
- Compose the plate so {메뉴명} reads instantly at thumbnail size, with the strongest visual mass in the lower-center area and side dishes, sauce sheen, rice, egg, and toppings arranged to balance the composition.
- Background should use {배경 톤} with a realistic tabletop surface: subtle wood grain, ceramic texture, small sauce marks, chopstick rest, folded receipt edge, or a tiny napkin corner that naturally belongs in a delivery-food setting.
- Keep spacing tight and appetizing, allowing practical margins for app cropping and a small lower-corner menu-info strip without covering the most delicious part of the food.
- Add a realistic delivery-app product card cue: a compact bottom or side label area integrated into the photo frame, not a floating poster, showing menu information such as {메뉴명}, ‘대표메뉴’, ‘리뷰 4.8’, ‘₩8,900’, and ‘배달 25–35분’ in small Korean UI text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero dish: Render {음식 비주얼} as the main subject, with rice grains, sauce gloss, egg yolk texture, scallion cuts, sesame flecks, meat fibers, and side-dish detail clearly visible in a high-resolution photoreal style.
- Plate and surface: Place the meal on a simple but believable plate, bowl, or tray that suits {배경 톤}, using a grounded tabletop look with ceramic rim detail, faint scratches, paper liner texture, or warm takeout-tray cues where appropriate.
- Menu-thumbnail information: Include a small app-style information band or placard near the lower edge with Korean text: ‘{메뉴명}’, ‘대표메뉴’, ‘₩8,900’, ‘리뷰 4.8’, ‘배달 25–35분’, plus tiny save/share/cart micro icons; keep it readable but secondary to the food.
- Restaurant realism: Add a small store-name line such as ‘온기식당’, an address/contact micro line such as ‘서울 마포구 와우산로 24 · 02-1234-5678’, and a simple divider line in the label area to make the thumbnail feel like a real menu listing.
- Angle and framing: Use {구도} so the viewer can immediately recognize the dish shape and toppings; keep the food visually dominant, appetizing, and centered with realistic perspective.
- Texture emphasis: Make the rice fluffy, the meat richly coated, the vegetables freshly cut, and the egg slightly runny or freshly set; include natural steam, oil sheen, and sauce pooling only where physically plausible.
- Thumbnail readability: Ensure {메뉴명} remains the clear focal identification for the menu item through food form, color contrast, plating, and the small UI label, while avoiding oversized poster typography.
- Camera realism: Simulate {카메라·렌즈} with crisp food detail, controlled depth, and natural perspective suitable for a premium app thumbnail.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: if text appears, use accurate Korean UI typography in Pretendard or Noto Sans KR; make {메뉴명} bold and readable, with supporting labels smaller and lighter, as a realistic delivery-app menu card overlay.
- Color palette: natural food tones with warm amber accents, soft off-white, light wood brown, muted beige, subtle soy-sauce brown, fresh green garnish, and appetizing red-orange sauce notes from {컬러 톤}.
- Border/shadow: if needed, use a soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity under the food or the app-card strip to lift elements from the background without looking composited.
- Surface detail: include believable tabletop grain, ceramic glaze, paper receipt fibers, stainless spoon reflection, or chopstick texture in small amounts to add realism and scale.
- App-card details: keep the label area compact and functional, with tiny iconography, price, review score, delivery estimate, and a short store line; the graphic treatment should feel like a cropped real delivery-app thumbnail, not a separate advertisement.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Hasselblad X2D 100c look, XCD 90mm f/2.5, ISO 100, f/4, with sharp food texture and moderate depth separation.
- Lighting: natural window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from the right, realistic soft shadow falloff, warm reflections on sauce and egg, and controlled highlights on ceramic or metal surfaces.
- Color grade: warm amber-balanced food color, natural white rice, subdued matte highlights, slightly magazine-editorial but still practical for delivery app use.
- Realism cues: shallow but not excessive depth of field, visible rice-grain separation, believable sauce thickness, tiny sesame seeds, garnish shadows, tray contact shadows, and subtle handheld tabletop asymmetry.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean delivery-app food thumbnail — appetizing editorial product photography with real restaurant-table energy, Baemin-style menu-card clarity, and warm everyday lunchtime realism.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: if text appears, render Korean cleanly and legibly, especially ‘{메뉴명}’, ‘대표메뉴’, ‘리뷰 4.8’, ‘₩8,900’, ‘배달 25–35분’, ‘온기식당’, ‘서울 마포구 와우산로 24’, and ‘02-1234-5678’.
- All food components should look anatomically and proportionally plausible as real plated food: rice mound, meat portions, side dishes, garnish, sauce, and egg must be naturally formed and physically believable.
- The dish should remain instantly recognizable at small thumbnail size, with the added UI label and tabletop details supporting clarity rather than covering the food.
- Maintain {비율} square delivery-app composition and keep the final image suitable for 1024x1024 cropping.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Public institution / civic organization recruitment poster for volunteer participation, designed as a credible editorial campaign poster for community action.
Tall social-poster format with a documentary volunteer-photo feel, suitable for municipal notice boards, community centers, bus-stop bulletin panels, and social sharing.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: a realistic 시민·자원봉사자 group photo occupies the center 56–60% of the frame, showing an active volunteer moment rather than a posed studio mockup.
- Layout: strong vertical hierarchy, headline at upper 16%, hero image in the middle, recruitment details and event information stacked in the lower area, with visible civic-poster information density.
- Background treatment: tactile off-white recycled paper texture with faint warm beige gradient wash, slight poster-print grain, and subtle green accent ribbons, map-line graphics, leaf icons, and small civic pictograms that echo environmental and neighborhood themes.
- Realistic poster context: include small tape marks or pin shadows near the corners, a faint paper curl at one edge, and mild ink texture so it feels like a printed public notice.
- Keep all text areas legible and organized; use {기관·단체명}, {활동 내용}, {활동 일정}, {모집 대상}, {혜택·지원}, {신청 방법}, {비주얼 컨셉}, {컬러 톤} as customizable content placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header area (top 16%): place {기관·단체명} as the primary title, centered or slightly left-aligned, with bold poster hierarchy. Add a small eyebrow label above it: '자원봉사자 모집' and a small campaign tag such as '우리 동네를 바꾸는 하루'.
2) Subtitle strip: set a concise recruitment line beneath the title using {활동 내용}, keeping it readable like an official civic campaign notice. Add a short supporting line: '함께하면 더 깨끗하고 안전한 지역사회'.
3) Hero image area (middle 56–60%): show {비주얼 컨셉} as a documentary-style photo with volunteers wearing gloves and light safety vests, holding grabbers, collecting litter, arranging donation boxes, planting flowers, or helping residents depending on the concept. Include authentic details such as reusable trash bags, clipboards, name stickers, traffic cones, folding tables, public-park signage, and neighborhood background context. Volunteers should smile naturally, talk to one another, and work in believable poses with realistic skin texture and varied ages.
4) Event-detail band overlapping the lower edge of the hero image: add compact chips and icons for '일시', '장소', '대상', and '준비물'. Use {활동 일정} for the date/time information, {모집 대상} for the audience, and add realistic fixed details such as '집결: 주민센터 앞 광장', '준비물: 편한 복장 · 개인 물병'.
5) Info block area (lower 18%): stack {활동 일정}, {모집 대상}, and {혜택·지원} in separated boxed rows with clear labels. Include small supportive labels: '활동 일정', '모집 대상', '혜택 및 지원', and a small note line: '봉사시간 인정 · 안전교육 제공'.
6) CTA area (bottom 8%): present {신청 방법} as the call-to-action, visually distinct with a button-like green panel, QR placeholder zone labeled 'QR 신청', and contact microtext such as '문의 02-0000-0000' and '신청 마감 D-7'.
7) Sponsor and footer area: add a slim sponsor/cooperation strip near the bottom with small text such as '주최 {기관·단체명}', '협력 지역 주민자치회 · 청년봉사단', plus tiny website/social text like '@volunteer_city'. Do not use fake seals or certification marks.
8) Color application: apply {컬러 톤} across title accents, label chips, icon strokes, separator lines, CTA panel, and small decorative route-map graphics so the poster feels civic, fresh, and environmentally grounded.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for the main title, Pretendard SemiBold for labels, and Noto Sans KR Regular for body copy; title size should feel like 78–96px equivalent, body around 28–34px equivalent, footer microcopy around 18–22px equivalent.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} with specific support colors such as forest green #3D6B4E, warm beige #E8DDC8, amber #D89B4A, soft sage #A8BFA3, and deep charcoal #2B2B2B.
- Graphic system: use rounded information cards, small line icons for calendar/location/person/benefit, dotted walking-route lines, subtle leaf or hand-heart motifs, and thin divider lines in muted green.
- Border/shadow: use thin divider lines in muted green, plus a soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for floating info cards and the QR panel.
- Print realism: add slight paper grain, offset-print texture, tiny registration softness around colored shapes, and natural poster lighting so the result looks like a finished recruitment poster photographed or scanned from print.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary event photography look, 35mm full-frame lens at f/2.8 for natural environment context, or 50mm f/2 if the volunteers are grouped tighter.
- Lighting: overcast diffused daylight with gentle front fill; if indoors, use soft window light from upper-left at 45° with subtle fill from front-right.
- Color grade: natural green + beige + warm amber grade, with moderate contrast and lightly lifted shadows for a civic documentary tone.
- Image treatment: hero photo should have realistic depth, visible clothing fibers, glove texture, public-space details, and a believable mix of candid expressions; poster graphics should integrate with the photograph through soft shadows and consistent color grading.

[6. MOOD]
Public-service editorial campaign — like a municipal volunteer recruitment poster photographed with the grounded realism of National Geographic documentary spreads and the clarity of a well-designed nonprofit annual report. Warm, trustworthy, local, practical, and action-oriented.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following verbatim strings must appear correctly in the rendered image:
  - {기관·단체명}
  - {활동 내용}
  - {활동 일정}
  - {모집 대상}
  - {혜택·지원}
  - {신청 방법}
- Additional Korean poster text should appear correctly and legibly: '자원봉사자 모집', '우리 동네를 바꾸는 하루', '활동 일정', '모집 대상', '혜택 및 지원', 'QR 신청', '문의 02-0000-0000', '신청 마감 D-7'.
- If text is rendered in panels, chips, captions, or badges, keep line breaks clean and avoid awkward wrapping that breaks Korean readability.
- Faces, hands, and volunteer tools must look anatomically correct; gloves, grabbers, clipboards, trash bags, vests, and holding poses should be natural and believable.
- Maintain a clear recruitment-poster hierarchy: title, activity summary, schedule, target audience, benefits, application method, QR area, and sponsor/footer information must remain distinct.
- The poster must feel like a real public recruitment notice with enough event details, contact information, visual context, and printed texture to be used in a civic campaign.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Public institution recruitment poster for senior learning and welfare programs, portrait format for noticeboards, community centers, apartment elevator boards, and social-media sharing.
Create a warm, realistic civic poster with clear senior-friendly typography, useful program details, decorative public-service graphics, and a trustworthy community-center atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main header block at the top 18%: {기관명·강좌명} set as the primary title, bold and highly legible, with a small municipal-program label above it such as ‘2026 어르신 배움·복지 프로그램 모집’.
- Middle section occupies about 55% of the frame: program details arranged in stacked rounded info cards with strong separation, generous line spacing, and simple pictogram icons for 대상, 일정, 장소, 혜택.
- Add a realistic civic poster layer: small notice label, application-period ribbon, simple calendar graphic, phone icon, map-pin icon, and a QR-code placeholder box labeled ‘온라인 신청 QR’.
- Lower section (bottom 22%): application, fee, contact information, organizer/sponsor area, and a final action band with the most prominent call-to-action.
- Background treatment: soft warm beige paper texture with subtle grain, faint recycled-paper fibers, and printed-poster ink texture for a real community noticeboard feel.
- Use {컬러 톤} as the overall palette direction, with clear visual hierarchy, practical spacing, and content-rich civic details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area: place {기관명·강좌명} centered or slightly upper-left, using a large bold title that fills the width confidently. Add small supporting text: ‘우리 동네 평생학습 안내’ and ‘접수기간 2026.04.15–05.03’.
2. Subtitle line: directly under the title, show {강좌 분야} in a smaller but still readable weight, with a calm divider rule beneath and small category chips such as ‘초보 환영’, ‘생활밀착’, ‘무료 교육’.
3. Information grid: present {대상·정원}, {일정·기간}, and {장소·강사} as separate stacked blocks, each with a label-like emphasis, icon marker, and concise alignment. Include a tiny calendar thumbnail showing ‘화 10:00’ and ‘총 12회’.
4. Benefit block: highlight {비용·혜택} in a visually distinct box or colored strip, making it easy to scan at a glance. Add supportive copy in Korean: ‘준비물: 개인 스마트폰 지참’, ‘처음 배우는 분도 천천히 안내합니다’.
5. Application block: place {신청 방법} near the bottom as the final actionable section, with a clear phone-number style emphasis, QR placeholder, and a bold CTA button-style strip reading ‘지금 신청하세요’.
6. Footer and sponsor area: include organizer text ‘주관 서대문구 복지센터’, support line ‘협력 지역 평생학습 네트워크’, contact hours ‘평일 09:00–18:00’, page-style code ‘POSTER 2026-05 / senior welfare program’, and a small address line.
7. Accent treatment: use respectful decorative shapes such as soft rounded panels, thin lines, small icon-like markers, calendar dots, subtle leaf or community-symbol motifs, and a muted coral ribbon without overpowering the official information.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main body, with ExtraBold for the title and Medium/Semibold for labels; title size should feel poster-scale and body text must remain readable from a distance.
- Color palette: warm beige, charcoal, muted coral/dark vermilion accents, sage-gray secondary accents, and soft off-white surfaces, matching {컬러 톤}.
- Border/shadow: use subtle 3px–6px soft shadow, low-opacity charcoal, thin divider lines, and light paper-edge depth so the poster feels printed and tactile.
- Add realistic print details: fine halftone edge softness, gentle ink density variation, small alignment marks or footer code, and a believable QR-code placeholder made of crisp square blocks.
- Maintain a formal public-service tone while allowing the poster to feel actively used, informative, and visually complete.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean graphic poster composition inspired by editorial layout design, equivalent to a 50mm standard lens perspective with straight-on framing and no distortion.
- Lighting: even diffused studio-style illumination, like soft window light from upper-left with gentle shadowing to keep text surfaces flat and readable.
- Color grade: warm cream + charcoal + muted red accent, gently desaturated for official public-service clarity.
- Finish: realistic printed-paper surface, matte civic flyer texture, crisp vector-like Korean typography, and clean iconography integrated into the poster.

[6. MOOD]
Trustworthy municipal brochure — calm Korean public-service design with the clarity of a community center notice board, enriched with useful program details, friendly senior-learning cues, and a warm neighborhood welfare atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: "서대문구 복지센터 — 시니어 디지털 클래스 (스마트폰·키오스크)", "디지털·스마트폰·키오스크 / 또는 헬스·요가·문화·여가·평생학습", "60세 이상 어르신 / 정원 30명 / 선착순", "2026.05.07 ~ 07.30 / 매주 화 10:00~11:30 / 총 12회", "서대문구 복지센터 2층 / 강사 김혜민 (디지털 교육 8년)", "무료 / 교재·다과 제공", "센터 방문 또는 전화 02-330-XXXX / 우편 신청서".
- 추가로 선명하게 보이는 보조 문구: "2026 어르신 배움·복지 프로그램 모집", "접수기간 2026.04.15–05.03", "초보 환영", "생활밀착", "온라인 신청 QR", "주관 서대문구 복지센터", "문의 평일 09:00–18:00", "지금 신청하세요".
- All body text must remain crisp, fully legible, and correctly spaced in Korean.
- Poster layout should feel senior-friendly with large type, strong hierarchy, practical information density, and clear separation between title, details, benefits, and application method.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Public institution youth class recruitment poster, vertical notice-style editorial layout for parents and students.
Designed for municipal/community bulletin use, with clear enrollment information hierarchy, realistic civic poster details, and a friendly educational tone suitable for a city hall, youth center, library, or school notice board.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center a rich documentary-style main photo area in the upper 45% of the poster, showing {비주얼 컨셉} in a believable youth learning environment with desks, notebooks, tablets, pencils, classroom posters, warm student interaction, and natural background depth.
- Put {기관명·강좌명} at the top as the strongest headline block, occupying about 15% of the height, with a small label above it such as “2026 청소년 배움 프로젝트” and a date tag like “모집기간 2026.05.01–05.20”.
- Arrange {강좌 분야}, {대상·정원}, {일정·기간}, {장소·강사}, {비용}, {신청 방법} in stacked information bands below the hero image, with strong left alignment, clear label chips, and practical civic notice styling.
- Use bright white or very light cream background with subtle paper texture, faint printed grain, small colored tabs, dotted dividers, playful geometric accents, and classroom-themed spot illustrations such as pencil marks, sticky notes, stars, speech bubbles, and calendar icons.
- Include realistic poster information details: “선착순 접수”, “문의 02-000-0000”, “운영시간 평일 09:00–18:00”, a small QR placeholder box labeled “온라인 신청”, a sponsor/partner area, and a footer note such as “자세한 내용은 홈페이지 공지사항을 확인하세요.”

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone: Set {기관명·강좌명} large and centered or slightly left-aligned, using a bold public-service poster hierarchy with a thin dividing line underneath; add small supporting Korean text such as “청소년을 위한 방과후 성장 프로그램”, “VOL. 2026-05”, and “접수 안내”.
2. Hero zone: Show {비주얼 컨셉} in the upper-middle area as a realistic framed photo with cheerful classroom energy, visible learning materials, student hands, friendly instructor presence, bulletin-board texture, and a soft realistic shadow so it sits naturally on the printed page.
3. Program summary band: Present {강좌 분야} and {대상·정원} as two adjacent info blocks with small icon-like accent shapes, colored label pills, and short helper text such as “분야” and “대상/정원”, keeping the wording crisp and immediately readable.
4. Schedule block: Display {일정·기간} as a structured timeline-style box with clear spacing between date, time, and total sessions; include decorative micro labels such as “일정”, “회차”, “준비물 안내”.
5. Venue and instructor block: Show {장소·강사} in a compact but prominent information panel, visually separated with a thin rule or colored label bar; add a small map-pin icon, instructor-card motif, and text label “장소·강사”.
6. Fee and application block: Highlight {비용} and {신청 방법} near the lower third, with the application method styled like a call-to-action box; place a clean QR placeholder zone labeled “QR 신청 바로가기” beside a checklist line such as “보호자 동의 후 신청 가능”.
7. Footer support strip: Add a slim footer area with realistic institutional notes, partner/sponsor text, contact line, page-code details like “공고번호 YOUTH-2026-05”, and subtle decorative accents, keeping the design balanced and poster-like rather than commercial-ad-like.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for the main body, with Pretendard Bold 700–800 for the title and Noto Sans KR Medium 500–600 for details; use varied but disciplined hierarchy with headline, subtitle, label chips, body rows, footer notes, and small civic notice microtext.
- Color palette: Use bright yellow, sky blue, coral, white, and soft navy from {컬러 톤}, with small accent use of pale mint, light gray, and warm cream for dividers, paper panels, stickers, and icon backgrounds.
- Border/shadow: Apply a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, and 15% opacity; use thin rounded rectangles, gentle outline strokes, colored tab corners, dotted separators, and realistic printed-paper layering.
- Poster details: Add event-style information elements including “모집기간”, “신청기간”, “문의”, “장소”, “대상”, “참가비”, “신청방법”, “주최/운영”, and small sponsor area text such as “함께하는 기관: 지역청소년센터 · 마을도서관”.
- Graphic accents: Use tasteful civic education motifs like calendar icons, pencil doodles, notebook lines, star stickers, speech bubbles, check marks, and small arrows to guide reading flow while preserving the official public-institution feeling.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm or 50mm documentary-style photo look, f/2.8–f/4, as if shot for a civic education brochure with clear subject separation.
- Lighting: Bright diffused daylight, soft window light from upper-left at 45°, with a subtle fill from the front to keep faces, hands, learning materials, and poster details evenly visible.
- Color grade: Clean pastel civic palette — white, sunshine yellow, sky blue, coral pink, and a touch of soft navy, with moderate saturation and low contrast.
- Realism: Make the poster feel like a photographed printed recruitment notice prepared by a public youth program office, with believable paper texture, slight ink density variation, crisp Korean typography, and a practical bulletin-board layout.

[6. MOOD]
Friendly municipal education campaign poster — feels like a well-organized city hall youth program leaflet with the clarity of a contemporary school newsletter, enriched with real recruitment details, warm classroom energy, and trustworthy community-program atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as rendered strings for the key fields shown in the design, including {기관명·강좌명}, {강좌 분야}, {대상·정원}, {일정·기간}, {장소·강사}, {비용}, {신청 방법}.
- Additional Korean poster text may include realistic short labels such as “2026 청소년 배움 프로젝트”, “모집기간 2026.05.01–05.20”, “선착순 접수”, “문의 02-000-0000”, “온라인 신청”, “QR 신청 바로가기”, “자세한 내용은 홈페이지 공지사항을 확인하세요.”
- Layout invariant: information sections must remain clearly separated and readable, with no broken line flow, and decorative elements must not cover the key text.
- If a QR area is represented, it must be a clean placeholder zone only, labeled in Korean, not a scannable code.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-388.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
직장 내 게임·e-sports 동호회 모집 포스터. 사내 게시판, 메신저 공지, 복지/동호회 안내용으로 바로 읽히는 세로형 홍보물이며, 실제 사내 행사 포스터처럼 날짜·장소·참가 안내·스폰서/복지 표기까지 포함된 완성형 디자인.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 중앙 히어로 영역이 전체의 약 58%를 차지하고, 상단 16%는 강한 타이틀 헤더, 하단 26%는 모집 정보와 신청 안내가 정리되도록 구성한다.
- 배경은 다크 네이비 그라데이션 바탕에 얇은 네온 라인, HUD 스코어보드 그래픽, 매치 대진표 조각, 사내 라운지 벽면을 연상시키는 금속 질감 패널을 부분적으로 배치한다.
- 실제 사내 e-sports 모집 포스터처럼 상단에는 작은 이벤트 라벨 “OFFICE ESPORTS CLUB 2026”, “VOL.04 RECRUITING SEASON”을 넣고, 우측 상단에는 작은 QR 코드 박스 느낌의 신청 영역과 “사내 메신저 신청” 라벨을 배치한다.
- 주요 정보는 좌우 2열 또는 카드형 블록으로 나누되, {게임}, {활동}, {모집 대상}, {회비·혜택}, {신청 방법}이 한눈에 구분되게 정보 밀도를 확보한다. 카드 안에는 아이콘, 작은 라벨, 가격/시간/장소 느낌의 보조 텍스트를 함께 넣는다.
- {동호회명}은 가장 크게, {비주얼 컨셉}은 히어로 이미지 설명으로 시각적 무게감을 주며, {컬러 톤}은 전체 팔레트와 네온 포인트, 버튼, 구분선, 배지에 반영한다.
- 포스터 하단에는 행사 정보 바를 추가한다: “OT 매치데이 2026.05.24 금 19:30”, “장소 12F 라운지 & 온라인 디스코드”, “참가비 0원 / 관전 환영”, “문의 HR 복지팀 · 사내동호회 담당”.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 16%): {동호회명}을 대형 타이틀로 배치하고, 그 아래에 “직장 게임·e-sports 동호회 모집” 성격의 보조 헤드라인을 짧고 강하게 넣는다. 굵은 산세리프와 약간의 자간 확장으로 e-sports 이벤트 포스터처럼 만든다. 타이틀 주변에는 “NEW MEMBERS WANTED”, “SEASON OPEN”, “RANKED NIGHT” 같은 작은 영문 키커와 한국어 라벨 “신규 멤버 모집중”을 함께 배치한다.
- Hero visual (middle 42%): {비주얼 컨셉}을 중심으로, 헤드셋·키보드·게임 패드·마우스·트로피·팀 유니폼 패치·에너지 드링크 캔·매치 브래킷 카드가 놓인 역동적인 무대 이미지를 배치한다. 중앙 장비는 선명하게, 주변은 어두운 배경과 네온 아웃라인으로 깊이를 만든다. 뒤쪽에는 반투명 LED 스크린에 “GG OFFICE LEAGUE”, “ROUND 01”, “TEAM A vs TEAM B” 같은 짧은 경기장 텍스트가 흐르는 느낌을 넣는다.
- Info block 1: {게임}을 카드형 리스트로 정렬해 “리그오브레전드 / 발로란트 / 배틀그라운드 / 스타크래프트”가 읽히도록 하고, 다중 가능임을 구분선과 게임 장르 아이콘으로 표현한다. 각 항목 옆에는 “팀전”, “솔로랭크”, “캐주얼”, “관전 가능” 같은 짧은 배지를 넣는다.
- Info block 2: {활동}은 주간·월간·분기 단위로 리듬감 있게 나눠 배치한다. “매주 수 19:30 온라인 스크림”, “매월 마지막 금요일 사내 토너먼트”, “분기별 챔피언십 & 회식” 같은 현실적인 스케줄 라벨을 넣고, 토너먼트/챔피언십 키워드는 강조색 박스로 띄운다.
- Info block 3: {모집 대상}과 {회비·혜택}은 대조되는 두 개의 박스로 배치해, 참여 조건과 장점을 즉시 비교할 수 있게 한다. 무료 회비, 소정의 상금, 간식 지원, 굿즈, 장비 대여, 초보자 환영은 아이콘 또는 배지 형태로 보강한다. 작은 라벨로 “신입/경력 무관”, “점심시간 관전 가능”, “부서 혼합 팀 구성”을 추가한다.
- Footer area (bottom 12%): {신청 방법}을 CTA처럼 가장 눈에 띄는 위치에 두고, 사내 메신저와 담당자 정보를 명확하게 정리한다. “지금 참가 신청”, “마감 2026.05.20 18:00”, “채널 #game-club 가입”, “담당자 @esports_master” 같은 짧은 안내를 함께 배치한다.
- Sponsor / support strip: 하단 또는 우측 가장자리에 작은 협찬/지원 영역을 넣어 “복지팀 지원”, “사내 동호회 프로그램”, “스낵바 제공”, “장비 대여 가능”을 작은 로고형 텍스트 박스로 표현한다. 공식 인증처럼 보이지 않는 내부 안내형 그래픽이어야 한다.
- Decorative event details: 얇은 네온 대진표 선, 작은 픽셀 번개, 컨트롤러 버튼 패턴, 랭크 배지, 스코어 카드, 티켓 스텁 형태의 “FREE ENTRY” 요소를 배경과 카드 주변에 배치해 실제 포스터의 정보량과 현장감을 살린다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {동호회명}, Pretendard Bold for headings, Noto Sans KR Medium for body text, size hierarchy 54–72px / 28–34px / 20–24px. 보조 라벨과 마이크로 카피는 12–16px로 실제 포스터 인쇄물처럼 촘촘하되 선명하게 처리한다.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} as primary accents, plus deep navy #0B1020, black #050608, neon cyan #28F0FF, neon magenta #FF3BD4, steel gray #A7B0C0, white #F5F7FA.
- Border/shadow: thin neon outline 2px, glow at 18% opacity, soft drop shadow 0px 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), metallic card edges with subtle bevel.
- Graphic texture: brushed metal panel grain, subtle carbon-fiber texture on equipment surfaces, glossy acrylic card highlights, LED screen scanlines, and faint fingerprint/surface reflections on the desk to create realistic printed-poster depth.
- Information design: section labels should be compact and punchy: “PLAY LIST”, “WEEKLY ACTIVITY”, “WHO CAN JOIN”, “BENEFITS”, “APPLY NOW”. Pair each English label with Korean content so the poster reads naturally in a Korean workplace.
- Poster finishing: add tiny crop-mark-like corner ticks, a small vertical spine text on the left edge reading “OFFICE ESPORTS CLUB RECRUITMENT / 2026”, and a small footer credit “Design for 사내 동호회 안내” for a realistic event-poster feel.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: ultra-wide 24mm flat-lay to medium-poster hybrid, with crisp synthetic depth and a slight low-angle perspective for the hero props.
- Lighting: studio softbox key from upper-left at 45°, cool rim light from right, subtle underglow in cyan and magenta to mimic esports stage lighting.
- Color grade: high-contrast cyber neon grade with deep blacks, electric cyan highlights, magenta accents, and restrained steel-blue midtones.
- Render quality: realistic printed poster composition with sharp Korean typography, tactile metallic cards, believable reflections on gaming gear, and layered event-promo graphics. The poster should feel like it was designed for an actual company lounge wall and internal messenger announcement.

[6. MOOD]
Premium corporate esports recruitment poster — a mix of Riot Games launch-event energy and a polished Wired magazine tech feature spread, with the approachable tone of a real office club announcement where beginners and spectators also feel welcome.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 한다: “직장 게임·e-sports 동호회 모집”, “{동호회명}”, “{게임}”, “{활동}”, “{모집 대상}”, “{회비·혜택}”, “{신청 방법}”.
- Additional Korean poster text must be legible and may include: “신규 멤버 모집중”, “OT 매치데이 2026.05.24 금 19:30”, “장소 12F 라운지 & 온라인 디스코드”, “마감 2026.05.20 18:00”, “참가비 0원”, “초보자 환영”, “관전 환영”, “지금 참가 신청”, “복지팀 지원”.
- Layout invariants: e-sports 무대 분위기, 네온 시안·마젠타 포인트, 게임 장비/트로피 시각 요소, 행사 날짜·시간·장소·신청 CTA·스폰서/지원 영역이 반드시 포함되어야 한다.
- No broken Korean characters, no garbled symbols, all text must be horizontally aligned and legible.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-387.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Recruitment poster for an in-company reading and culture club, designed as a refined magazine-style event notice for office corridors, elevator boards, and internal messenger channels.
Poster should feel like a curated editorial recruitment sheet combining book, film, exhibition, coffee culture, and realistic workplace event information.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main headline block centered in the upper 18% of the frame, with {동호회명} as the dominant text and a clear hierarchy beneath.
- Add a small poster kicker above the title: {상단카피}, plus a compact date label such as {모집기간} on the right side of the header.
- Mid-frame composition built around a layered still-life collage: books, coffee cup, cinema ticket, exhibition-photo fragments, bookmark ribbons, a small calendar sticker, and a printed QR application card arranged as a curated desk scene.
- Supporting information zones placed in stacked editorial modules below the hero area, with clear alignment, section labels, dividers, and realistic poster details.
- Background should be an off-white paper texture with subtle grain, warm beige surface tone, faint coffee-ring marks, light paper fibers, and small editorial graphic accents such as film-frame lines and bookmark icons.
- Use {활동 분야}, {활동 일정}, {모집 대상}, {회비·혜택}, {신청 방법}, {개최일시}, {장소}, {참가비}, {신청마감}, {문의}, {후원}, {티켓정보}, {비주얼 컨셉}, {컬러 톤} as editable text elements integrated into the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header area (upper 18%): set {동호회명} in a bold editorial masthead style, centered, with tight vertical spacing; place {상단카피} above it and a small issue-style label reading {포스터번호} near the top-left.
- Header metadata: add a compact row with {모집기간}, {신청마감}, and {장소}, styled like a magazine event listing with thin charcoal rules.
- Hero collage area (middle 34%): place a neat arrangement of book spines, a ceramic coffee cup with a subtle latte surface, a movie ticket stub printed with {티켓정보}, small exhibition-photo prints, a bookmark, a pen, and a QR code application card on the same plane, with realistic shadows and tactile paper edges.
- Info block 1: present {활동 분야} and {활동 일정} as two stacked content rows, each with a small label on the left and a readable text field on the right.
- Info block 2: present {모집 대상}, {회비·혜택}, and {참가비} in a modular structure, using subtle divider lines, compact paragraph styling, and amber label chips.
- Event details block: include {개최일시}, {장소}, {신청마감}, and {문의} as practical poster information, with small icons for calendar, map pin, deadline, and message.
- Application block (lower-mid): highlight {신청 방법} in a stronger weight, framed by a thin rounded rectangle or understated rule box; include a realistic QR placeholder labeled "신청 QR" and a short CTA line {신청CTA}.
- Sponsor/support area (lower 12%): add a quiet sponsor strip reading {후원}, plus small internal support labels such as 복지포인트, 사내카페, 문화지원.
- Visual note block (footer): add {비주얼 컨셉} and {컬러 톤} as concise footer notes, aligned with the editorial grid, followed by a small page-style footer mark {하단문구}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold for the main title, Pretendard Regular for body copy, and Noto Sans KR Medium for labels; headline size should read as 64–80px equivalent, body text 28–34px equivalent, metadata 20–24px equivalent.
- Color palette: off-white #F5F0E8, warm beige #D9C7AE, charcoal #2E2B28, amber accent #C98A3A, muted coffee brown #6B4E3D, faded ink gray #77706A.
- Border/shadow: use thin 1px charcoal rules, soft drop shadows with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, and light paper-contact shadows under tickets and photo prints.
- Layout rhythm: consistent 8–12px grid, well-aligned modules, editorial dividers, small label chips, and practical event-poster information density.
- Decorative graphics may include small bookmark marks, film perforation strips, exhibition caption tags, calendar stickers, QR-card corners, coffee-ring texture, and amber highlight underlines.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial still-life photographed as if on a Canon EOS R5 with RF 50mm f/1.8, slightly top-down at about 20°, sharp focus on the central objects.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45° with a gentle fill from the right, producing quiet paper shadows and natural highlights on the cup and ticket edges.
- Color grade: warm cream, beige, coffee brown, and subdued amber with restrained contrast, realistic paper texture, natural ink density, and premium office-magazine warmth.

[6. MOOD]
Quiet premium office editorial — feels like a Kinfolk spread mixed with a sophisticated in-house magazine recruitment poster, but with enough real event details to feel ready for an actual company bulletin board.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as written when rendered: "직장인 독서·문화 동호회", "독서 토론·영화·전시 / 또는 음악 감상·여행·요리 강좌", "매주 수 19:00 회사 카페 / 월간 영화·전시 함께 / 분기 책 1권", "전 직원 / 책 좋아하는 사람 환영 / 정원 25명", "월 1만원 / 책·영화 비용 일부 지원 / 동호회 굿즈", "사내 메신저 #book-bean / 담당 이수진 대리".
- Additional poster details must be rendered in clear Korean: "모집기간 2026.05.01–05.24", "첫 모임 2026.05.29 금 19:00", "장소 12F 라운지 카페", "신청 마감 5월 24일 18:00", "신청 QR", "인사팀·복지팀 후원".
- Text must remain fully legible, with correct Korean spacing, punctuation, prices, dates, and slash separators.
- Maintain editorial hierarchy: title largest, event metadata clearly grouped, activity information readable, QR/application area immediately noticeable.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Fabricated celebrity composites or unauthorized face likenesses
- Illegible QR-like noise that overwhelms the application block

[1. PURPOSE]
직장 운동 동호회 모집 포스터 for internal company bulletin, vertical recruitment poster, social-media and office-print friendly.
Recruitment message should feel practical, upbeat, and believable, like a real printed corporate wellness poster pinned near an office elevator, pantry, or HR notice board.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main headline area: large centered title at the top 14% with strong hierarchy, plus a small top utility strip containing "사내 웰니스 프로그램", "POSTER NO.08", and "2026 SPRING".
- Hero image area: mid-frame 42–48% filled by {비주얼 컨셉} as the main visual, cropped like a realistic editorial lifestyle photo. Include natural workplace-athletic details such as office buildings in the distance, employee ID lanyards, running watches, water bottles, gym bags, or a riverside path near the company.
- Information blocks: stacked below the hero with 4–5 practical sections, aligned left, each separated by thin rules, small sport icons, calendar markers, and label chips.
- Event detail zone: include a compact date/time/venue/ticket-style strip using Korean text such as "정기모임", "장소", "참가비", "신청마감" while still featuring {활동 일정}, {회비·혜택}, and {신청 방법} prominently.
- Footer area: add sponsor/organizer row, small QR-code style application box, contact line, page-like poster code, and subtle decorative motion lines or route-map graphics that match the athletic theme.
- Background treatment: off-white or very light cool gray paper texture with tactile print grain, slight folded-paper realism, taped corners or bulletin-board pin marks, and soft shadows that make it feel physically posted in an office.
- Use {동호회명}, {종목}, {활동 일정}, {모집 대상}, {회비·혜택}, {신청 방법}, {비주얼 컨셉}, {컬러 톤} as editable text elements.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top band: set the main title "직장 운동 동호회 모집" in a bold, high-contrast Korean headline style, spanning about 80% width, with a neat corporate poster feel. Add small supporting labels around it: "OFFICE SPORTS CLUB", "함께 뛰고, 함께 쉬는 퇴근 후 1시간", and "신규 멤버 모집 중".
- Hero image block: place {비주얼 컨셉} as a wide rectangular visual with crisp editorial cropping. The scene should show believable employees preparing for or enjoying {종목}: warm-up stretching, tying running shoes, checking a smartwatch, group high-five, or walking with towels and water bottles after exercise.
- Overlay details on hero: add a small translucent caption tag such as "AFTER WORK CLUB" and a location/date label such as "여의도 한강공원 · 평일 저녁" without covering faces or important action.
- Club name callout: position {동호회명} directly beneath the hero in a colored label or badge style, larger than the detail text but smaller than the headline. Add a small member-count style note like "현재 멤버 24명 · 첫 참여 환영".
- Detail grid: arrange {종목}, {활동 일정}, {모집 대상}, {회비·혜택}, and {신청 방법} into separate readable rows, each with a short label and the provided copy as the body text. Use icons such as shoe, calendar, people, won sign, chat bubble, and map pin.
- Ticket-style strip: include compact practical info blocks: "참가비", "준비물", "집결", "신청마감 D-7" with believable microcopy, while keeping the supplied {회비·혜택} and {신청 방법} as the primary content.
- Sponsor/organizer area: footer row with small text "주관 HR Wellness Team", "협력 총무팀 · 안전보건팀", "문의 wellness@company.co.kr", and a small square QR-code style graphic labeled "신청 QR".
- Footer accent: add a wellness-oriented divider at the bottom, such as a simplified running-route line, step-count marks, small heartbeat line, or court-line graphic, reinforcing the club’s active and casual office culture.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for headline 72–88px, Pretendard SemiBold for labels 30–36px, Pretendard Regular for body 22–28px; use a clear Korean corporate-poster hierarchy with realistic print spacing.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with specific anchors like green #2E7D4F, white #F7F8F4, charcoal #2F343A, and a soft mint accent #DCEFE3.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px separators in charcoal at 20% opacity, subtle card shadows with 0px x-offset, 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 12% opacity.
- Graphic accents: use small rounded chips, route-map curves, step-count dots, calendar tabs, and sport pictograms in the same green/charcoal palette.
- Print realism: show slight paper fiber, ink density variation, tiny registration marks or poster code "HR-WELLNESS-08", and natural edge shadows as if the poster was printed and posted.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm documentary lens look, f/4, clean editorial framing with natural perspective and enough depth for a workplace lifestyle poster.
- Lighting: overcast diffused daylight or soft window light from upper-left, balanced fill from front-right, keeping the scene realistic and non-glossy.
- Color grade: fresh green + white + charcoal corporate wellness palette with restrained contrast and slightly cool highlights.
- Realism details: natural skin texture, varied employee expressions, practical workout clothing mixed with office items, visible but tasteful environmental cues such as lobby glass, riverside railing, locker shelf, office tote bags, or a company shuttle stop.

[6. MOOD]
Modern corporate wellness campaign — feels like a polished internal HR bulletin blended with a lifestyle magazine recruitment poster. Friendly, active, and approachable: the viewer should immediately understand when to join, where to meet, what it costs, and how to apply.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함:
  - "직장 운동 동호회 모집"
  - "회사 러닝 동호회 — RUN&CHILL"
  - "러닝 / 또는 요가·등산·축구·필라테스·테니스·자전거"
  - "매주 화·목 19:00 회사 근처 한강 / 월간 5km 챌린지"
  - "전 직원 / 신입·경력 무관 / 초보 환영"
  - "월 1만원 / 회사 지원 일부 / 동호회 티셔츠"
  - "사내 메신저 #run-club / 담당 김혜민 차장"
- Additional Korean poster microtext may appear clearly:
  - "사내 웰니스 프로그램"
  - "POSTER NO.08"
  - "2026 SPRING"
  - "신규 멤버 모집 중"
  - "정기모임"
  - "장소"
  - "참가비"
  - "신청 QR"
  - "주관 HR Wellness Team"
  - "협력 총무팀 · 안전보건팀"
- Layout invariants: all text must be legible, Korean characters must not break, and the hero image must remain clearly athletic and office-friendly without becoming a generic stock photo.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
University volunteer and NGO club recruitment poster for social-media sharing and campus bulletin use.
Warm editorial-style recruitment design that feels like a real campus magazine page for student service organizations, with practical recruitment details, event information, and human volunteer imagery.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster composition: strong top headline zone (about 16%), central visual zone (about 52%), and bottom info zone (about 32%) with clear hierarchy and realistic campus-poster density.
- Main club name should be the dominant focal point, with supporting recruitment information arranged in clean stacked blocks, stickers, small labels, and editorial captions around the visual.
- Background treatment: cream-beige paper texture with subtle warm grain, lightly vignetted edges, taped-photo corners, small paper fibers, and a few soft printed marks that make the poster feel physically pinned on a campus board.
- Include real poster details: date/time/venue line, 모집 기간 label, 오리엔테이션 notice, 참가비 무료 note, sponsor/cooperation area, QR-code placeholder, Instagram handle, and short CTA.
- Use {동아리명}, {활동 분야}, {활동 일정}, {모집 대상}, {신청 방법}, {비주얼 컨셉}, {컬러 톤} as the editable content placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header: place a small issue-style line at the very top such as VOL.12 · 2026 SPRING RECRUITMENT, then a bold recruitment masthead, centered, with {동아리명} most prominent and a secondary subtitle directly beneath it.
- Set bold Korean cover line near the title: 대학 봉사·NGO 동아리 모집 포스터, plus a short warm tagline such as 함께하는 작은 행동, 더 나은 내일.
- Main visual band (middle 50%): show a collage-like volunteer activity photo set inspired by {비주얼 컨셉}, with smiling student volunteers in mentoring, cleaning, meal-packing, campaign booth, and care scenes. Arrange as overlapping editorial photo cards with visible tape, rounded corners, handwritten-style caption strips, and small labels like 멘토링, 환경정화, 캠페인.
- Add two or three short photo captions in Korean beneath the images, for example 지역아동센터 멘토링 현장, 주말 플로깅 활동, NGO 캠페인 부스 운영.
- Information blocks: place {활동 분야} and {활동 일정} in two readable text modules with divider rules, small icons, and realistic sublabels such as 활동 분야 and 정기 활동 일정.
- Event details block: include 모집 기간 2026.03.04–03.18, 오리엔테이션 3.21 토 14:00, 장소 학생회관 2층 세미나실, 참가비 무료 as supporting details around the lower middle.
- Recruitment block: show {모집 대상} in a highlighted box or ribbon near the lower third, so the eligibility and capacity are immediately visible, with a small badge reading 신입 부원 모집중.
- Application block: place {신청 방법} at the bottom with a QR-code placeholder area, Instagram handle area such as @campus_ngo, contact line such as 문의 010-0000-0000, and a CTA button-style label 신청서 작성하기.
- Sponsor/cooperation footer: include a small, non-official text sponsor area reading 협력 학생지원센터 · 지역아동센터 · 캠퍼스 봉사네트워크, separated by thin warm-brown rules.
- Color application: use {컬러 톤} throughout the poster as the primary palette, with amber and coral accents used for emphasis dots, labels, ribbons, small illustrated hands/hearts, and thin rules.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for the main title, Pretendard SemiBold for section labels, Noto Sans KR Regular for body text; title size large and condensed-feeling, body text compact but highly legible.
- Color palette: cream beige #F4EBDD, warm amber #D99A4E, coral accent #F07D6A, deep brown #5A4636, soft ivory #FFF9F2, using {컬러 톤} as the guiding palette direction.
- Border/shadow: thin warm-brown rules, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity on cards and photo frames.
- Add subtle decorative graphic elements appropriate for volunteer recruitment: small map-pin icons, checkbox bullets, sticker labels, paper tape, hand-drawn heart and leaf marks, and tiny dotted dividers.
- Layout should feel like a real printed campus poster: information-rich, readable from a distance, and detailed up close.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary-style 35mm lens look, f/2.8, natural campus-photo realism with crisp subject separation.
- Lighting: soft overcast daylight or diffused window light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from the right and no harsh flash.
- Color grade: warm cream + amber + coral editorial grade with slightly lifted shadows and natural skin tones.
- Photo realism: natural student clothing, campus bulletin-board context, believable volunteer tools such as notebooks, tote bags, gloves, clipboards, recycling bags, lunch boxes, donation boxes, and campaign pamphlets.

[6. MOOD]
Premium campus community editorial — feels like a Kinfolk-style volunteer feature spread mixed with a refined university recruitment poster, warm, credible, student-led, and socially engaged.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구:
  - 대학 봉사·NGO 동아리 모집 포스터
  - {동아리명}
  - {활동 분야}
  - {활동 일정}
  - {모집 대상}
  - {신청 방법}
  - 함께하는 작은 행동, 더 나은 내일
  - 신입 부원 모집중
  - 모집 기간 2026.03.04–03.18
  - 오리엔테이션 3.21 토 14:00
  - 장소 학생회관 2층 세미나실
  - 참가비 무료
  - 신청서 작성하기
  - 협력 학생지원센터 · 지역아동센터 · 캠퍼스 봉사네트워크
- Layout invariants: the poster must clearly read as a recruitment flyer, with the club name as the strongest focal point and the info sections separated and easy to scan.
- Photo content must show real volunteer-like activity scenes with natural expressions; no distorted faces, no malformed hands.
- QR-code area should be visually recognizable as a placeholder square, with nearby application and contact text clearly aligned.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
대학 학술·창업 동아리 모집 포스터, 세로형 캠퍼스 홍보 인포그래픽.  
신입생·재학생이 한눈에 동아리 성격, 모집 대상, 활동 혜택, 신청 방법을 파악하도록 설계된 입학/학기 초 모집용 포스터. 실제 대학 게시판, 학과 라운지, 창업지원센터 안내 보드에 붙어 있을 법한 모집 공고처럼 날짜, 장소, 주최/협력 표기, QR 신청, 짧은 프로그램 정보까지 포함한 현실적인 캠퍼스 홍보물로 만든다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 구도는 상단 제목 15%, 중단 정보 블록 60%, 하단 신청/문의 영역 15% 비율로 구성하고, 중앙 정렬 기반의 명확한 그리드 레이아웃을 유지한다.
- 배경은 오프화이트 종이 질감 또는 아주 옅은 라이트 그레이 매트 배경으로 처리하되, 실제 인쇄 포스터처럼 미세한 종이 결, 희미한 좌표 그리드, 창업 아이디어 스케치 라인, 작은 네트워크 노드 장식이 은은하게 보이도록 한다.
- {동아리명}은 상단 헤더에서 가장 크게 배치하고, 그 주변에 2026 SPRING RECRUITING, VOL.04, 모집 기간 2026.03.04–03.18 같은 작은 메타 라벨을 더해 실제 학기 초 모집 포스터의 밀도를 만든다.
- 그 아래에 {분야}, {모집 대상}, {활동 내용}, {멘토 풀}, {혜택}, {신청 방법}, {컬러 톤} 정보가 아이콘/박스형 정보 카드로 질서 있게 배치되도록 한다.
- 시선 흐름은 상단 헤더 → 핵심 소개 태그 → 2열 정보 카드 → 혜택 강조 → 하단 QR 신청 안내 순으로 내려가게 설계하고, 가장자리에는 작은 세로형 마이크로 텍스트와 캠퍼스 공지용 프린트 코드가 들어가 대학 공식 홍보물처럼 현실감 있게 보이게 한다.
- 포스터 하단에는 협력/후원 표기 영역, 오픈세션 날짜·시간·장소, 참가비 무료 안내, 문의 이메일, QR 신청 영역을 포함한다. 공식 인증 마크처럼 보이는 도장은 만들지 않는다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 15%): 상단 좌측에 작은 시즌 라벨 2026 SPRING RECRUITING, 우측에 VOL.04 / CAMPUS POSTER 01 같은 발행 코드 느낌의 텍스트를 배치한다. 중앙에는 {동아리명}을 굵은 타이틀로 크게 배치하고, 바로 아래에 대학 학술·창업 동아리 모집 보조 문구를 둔다. 제목 주변에는 얇은 골드 구분선, 작은 별표형 포인트, 회로도 느낌의 라인 그래픽을 넣어 학술·창업 분위기를 살린다.
- Date and event band: 헤더 아래 얇은 정보 밴드에 모집 기간 2026.03.04–03.18, 오픈세션 03.12 18:30, 장소 창업보육센터 B101, 참가비 무료를 짧은 캡슐 라벨로 표시한다. 작은 캘린더 아이콘과 위치 핀 아이콘을 함께 넣어 한눈에 읽히게 한다.
- Key summary strip (below header): {분야}를 TRACK 라벨처럼 표시해 어떤 동아리인지 즉시 식별되게 하고, 네이비 배경 박스 또는 얇은 골드 라인 박스 안에 넣어 강조한다. 주변에는 Academic Research × Startup Sprint, Problem Finding, Prototype, Demo Day 같은 짧은 영문 마이크로카피를 작게 배치해 실제 창업 프로그램 포스터 느낌을 준다.
- Main info grid (middle 60%): 2열 카드 3행 구성으로 {모집 대상}, {활동 내용}, {멘토 풀}, {혜택}, {신청 방법}, {컬러 톤}을 각각 분리 배치한다. 각 카드에는 작은 아이콘(돋보기, 캘린더, 사람들, 선물, QR, 팔레트)을 넣고, 카드 상단에는 대상 / 활동 / 멘토 / 혜택 / 지원 / 톤 같은 한국어 소제목을 붙인다.
- Content-rich card details: {모집 대상} 카드에는 신입생·재학생·휴학생 가능 여부를 나타내는 작은 체크 리스트 스타일 요소를, {활동 내용} 카드에는 주간 세미나, 리서치 스터디, MVP 제작, 데모데이 같은 짧은 프로그램 칩을 배치한다. {멘토 풀} 카드에는 교수진, 선배 창업가, VC/PM 멘토 등으로 보이는 작은 프로필 실루엣 아이콘과 직함 라벨을 넣는다.
- Benefits emphasis block: {혜택}은 카드 중 하나를 더 크게 하이라이트해, 창업 지원금, 프로토타입 제작비, 해외 컨퍼런스 참가비 지원, 네트워킹 데이 등 혜택이 시각적으로 돋보이도록 굵은 숫자/강조 밴드와 골드 하이라이트를 붙인다. 단, 실제 금액이 필요하면 작은 예시 표기 ₩300,000~, Demo Day, Conference Support처럼 포스터용 텍스트로 자연스럽게 처리한다.
- Application footer (bottom 15%): {신청 방법}을 QR 영역과 이메일/문의 영역으로 나뉜 하단 박스에 넣고, QR 코드는 실제 스캔 가능한 듯한 정사각형 흑백 패턴 자리로 명확하게 표현한다. QR 옆에는 QR로 1분 신청, 신청 마감 D-7, 문의 club@univ.ac.kr, 인스타 @campus_startupclub 같은 작은 실무형 안내 텍스트를 배치한다.
- Sponsor and ticket area: 하단 가장 아래에는 협력 창업지원단 · 학생처 · 산학협력단, 입장권 무료 / 사전신청 필수 같은 작은 스폰서·티켓 정보 라인을 둔다. 로고처럼 보이는 텍스트 박스는 가능하지만 공식 인증 도장이나 수상 인증 마크처럼 보이지 않게 한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard 또는 Noto Sans KR 사용. 제목은 Bold 70–90px, 본문은 Medium 26–34px, 보조 라벨은 SemiBold 20–24px. 숫자/강조는 ExtraBold로 처리. 실제 인쇄물처럼 소제목, 본문, 메타 라벨, 마이크로카피의 계층이 분명해야 한다.
- Color palette: navy #0E1B3D, gold #C8A24A, white #F7F6F2, cool gray #D9DEE7, deep charcoal #20242D. {컬러 톤}의 인상을 유지하되 고급스러운 대학 기관 홍보물에 어울리는 균형 잡힌 채도로 표현한다.
- Border/shadow: 카드마다 1px 골드 또는 라이트 그레이 라인, 그림자는 soft drop shadow 0px 8px 20px 10% opacity, 모서리는 18px 라운드. 전체적으로 플랫하지만 실제 프린트 포스터 위에 정보 카드가 정돈되어 얹힌 듯한 기업/학교 행사 포스터 느낌.
- Graphic elements: 얇은 골드 라인, 섹션 번호 01–06, 작은 체크 아이콘, 위치 핀, QR 박스, 캘린더 칩, 네트워크 노드, 추상적인 로켓/전구/그래프 라인 아이콘을 활용한다. 장식은 정보 흐름을 보조하는 수준으로 배치하고, 포스터가 실제로 읽을 수 있는 홍보물처럼 촘촘한 디테일을 갖게 한다.
- Text rendering: 모든 한국어 문자는 선명하고 깨짐 없이 인쇄된 벡터 타이포그래피처럼 보여야 한다. 중요한 문구는 굵게, 메타 정보는 작지만 읽을 수 있게 처리한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat graphic poster composition, as if shot for a university recruitment brochure with a 50mm standard lens look translated into clean layout geometry; front-facing printed-poster realism with very slight paper surface depth and subtle shadow at the card edges.
- Lighting: studio-soft, evenly diffused editorial lighting 느낌의 그래픽 스타일. 실제 사진처럼 상단에서 부드럽게 정리된 밝기와 종이 표면의 섬세한 질감이 느껴지도록 한다.
- Color grade: navy + gold + white with slight cool gray support, crisp contrast, restrained saturation, premium institutional tone.
- Material feel: premium matte poster paper, crisp ink edges, delicate print grain, realistic QR block, small footer text and sponsor line like a real university club recruitment flyer.

[6. MOOD]
Modern university brochure editorial — like a polished campus startup fair poster, research symposium flyer, and contemporary Korean university noticeboard design. 지적이고 신뢰감 있으며, 동시에 학기 초 새 멤버를 적극적으로 모집하는 활기와 참여 욕구가 느껴지는 분위기.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 한국어 문자열이 깨짐 없이 정확히 보여야 함.
  - 대학 학술·창업 동아리 모집
  - {동아리명}
  - {분야}
  - {모집 대상}
  - {활동 내용}
  - {멘토 풀}
  - {혜택}
  - {신청 방법}
  - {컬러 톤}
- 추가로 포스터 안에 아래 한국어/숫자 정보가 자연스럽게 보이게 할 것.
  - 2026 SPRING RECRUITING
  - VOL.04
  - 모집 기간 2026.03.04–03.18
  - 오픈세션 03.12 18:30
  - 장소 창업보육센터 B101
  - 참가비 무료
  - QR로 1분 신청
  - 신청 마감 D-7
  - 문의 club@univ.ac.kr
  - 협력 창업지원단 · 학생처 · 산학협력단
- 레이아웃 불변사항: 상단 제목, 중단 정보 카드, 하단 신청 영역의 3단 구조를 유지할 것.
- QR 영역은 정사각형 형태로 명확하게 남겨 둘 것.
- 공식 인증서, 수상 증명서, 대학 직인처럼 보이는 요소는 만들지 말고, 모집 포스터용 협력/후원 표기 정도로만 처리할 것.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-383.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
University sports club recruitment poster, vertical admission-style flyer for campus bulletin boards, student union walls, dorm elevators, and social media sharing. Emphasize high-energy athletics, clear readable event info, realistic campus recruitment details, and a youthful competitive vibe that feels like a real university club poster.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main title block occupies the top 16% with strong visual hierarchy; {동아리명} is the hero text, centered and large, supported by the required line “대학 스포츠 동아리 모집”.
- Center composition: a dynamic action collage showing a runner mid-stride or an athletic figure in motion, with the activity theme driven by {종목}; include realistic campus sports details such as stadium lights, track lanes, court markings, chalk dust, taped ankles, training cones, team bibs, or sweat textures where appropriate.
- Add poster-context micro information near the top edge: “2026 SPRING TRYOUT”, “CLUB RECRUITMENT”, “POSTER NO. 07”, and a small date label such as “2026.03”.
- Information blocks are arranged in a strong stacked layout beneath the hero image, using short label-value pairs for {모집 대상·인원}, {활동 일정}, {혜택·지원}, and {신청 방법}; add readable labels: “모집”, “일정”, “혜택”, “신청”.
- Background treatment: dark athletic gradient base with visible track texture, court-line geometry, stadium-light haze, concrete wall grain, paper poster texture, sticker tape edges, and energetic graphic streaks depending on {비주얼 컨셉}. Keep text panels high-contrast and easy to scan.
- Use {비주얼 컨셉} and {컬러 톤} as the dominant visual direction; integrate realistic poster furniture such as small sponsor strip, QR-space placeholder, contact line, venue note, and club social handle.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header zone: Place {동아리명} as the largest element, bold and centered, with compact subtitle lines: “대학 스포츠 동아리 모집”, “초보 환영”, and “2026 SPRING TRYOUT”. Add small corner text such as “CAMPUS ATHLETICS” and “POSTER NO. 07”.
2. Hero action zone (middle 42%): Show a highly dynamic athletic scene aligned with {종목}, using realistic motion blur on limbs, dust, sweat, flying hair, jersey folds, and trailing movement lines, while keeping the main subject crisp and recognizably human. Include secondary silhouettes, a scoreboard glow, stadium railings, campus gym lights, or court/track markings to make the scene feel lived-in.
3. Details zone (lower middle): Stack the recruitment information as clear card-like blocks — {모집 대상·인원}, {활동 일정}, {혜택·지원}, and {신청 방법} — with icon-like separators, jersey-number tags, whistle/stopwatch/clipboard icons, and strong alignment.
4. Event details zone: Add small practical poster text in Korean, such as “오리엔테이션 3.12 목 18:30”, “장소: 학생체육관 / 대운동장”, “참가비 무료”, “문의: @campus_sports”, and “준비물: 운동화 · 개인 물병”. These should support, not replace, the placeholder information.
5. Call-to-action zone (bottom 14%): Give {신청 방법} extra emphasis with a boxed highlight, QR-space placeholder area labeled “QR 신청”, and a short join-now style line: “지금 신청하고 첫 훈련에 함께하세요”. Add tiny deadline text such as “마감 D-7” and a contact strip.
6. Sponsor / footer zone: Add a realistic sponsor/support area with small text like “학생회 후원”, “체육부 협력”, “신입부원 환영”, plus tiny social icons, a page/serial mark, and thin divider rules.
7. Accent zone: Use {컬러 톤} in diagonal streaks, edge highlights, number tags, tape labels, rough halftone dots, or thin rule lines to create energy and poster richness.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard ExtraBold for the main title, Pretendard SemiBold for labels, and Noto Sans KR Medium for body text; title around 74–92px feel, body around 28–34px feel, micro text around 14–18px feel.
- Color palette: base black #0B0B0D, vivid red #E53935, yellow #FDD835, green #43A047, with white #FFFFFF for primary text and charcoal #1C1C1F for secondary panels. Adapt the accent balance to {컬러 톤}.
- Border/shadow: sharp poster edges, thin white divider lines, subtle paper grain, taped-corner detail, and a soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity behind info cards.
- Graphic language: bold sports-campaign layout with layered action photography, jersey-number numerals, diagonal speed shapes, halftone texture, stamped date labels, QR box, sponsor footer, and campus noticeboard realism.
- Keep all key Korean text large enough to read, with detail blocks clearly separated from the moving athlete and layered graphic effects.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.4 sports portrait feel for the hero subject, with slight telephoto compression and crisp subject separation.
- Lighting: stadium-style key light from upper-left at 45° with a cool fill from right, plus rim light to define motion; include believable reflections on skin, sportswear fabric, shoes, and court/track surfaces.
- Color grade: saturated athletic palette with vivid red, yellow, and green highlights over deep black, similar to a Nike campaign poster or an energy-driven sports event graphic.
- Texture realism: visible sweat, fabric weave, shoe rubber, chalk marks, scuffed floor or track surface, paper grain, ink registration texture, and slight poster-print imperfections.
- Composition finish: vertical 1024x1536 recruitment poster with a strong top title, immersive central action, rich lower information system, and realistic campus bulletin-board poster presence.

[6. MOOD]
Campus sports recruitment — Nike x university athletics poster energy with a clean editorial sports-campaign feel, but grounded in believable Korean university club recruitment details, real event information, and active student-life atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: “대학 스포츠 동아리 모집”, “모집”, “일정”, “혜택”, “신청”, “초보 환영”
- Also render short supporting Korean poster text where space allows: “오리엔테이션 3.12 목 18:30”, “장소: 학생체육관”, “참가비 무료”, “QR 신청”, “문의: @campus_sports”, “지금 신청하세요”.
- Layout invariants: the poster must remain vertically stacked, with the title clearly separated from the detail blocks and no overlapping text on the main action subject.
- Human anatomy: if a runner or athlete is shown, limbs must be anatomically correct and natural in motion.
- Preserve all placeholders exactly as written: {동아리명}, {종목}, {모집 대상·인원}, {활동 일정}, {혜택·지원}, {신청 방법}, {비주얼 컨셉}, {컬러 톤}.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likenesses

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
University club recruitment poster for a video + photography society, designed as a cinematic magazine-style vertical campus flyer for noticeboards, Instagram stories, and student community posts.
The poster should feel like a real semester recruitment announcement: editorial hero imagery, clear event logistics, application deadline, orientation details, QR callout, sponsor strip, and practical club benefits.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main poster is a vertical 2:3 layout optimized for 1024x1536, with a cinematic hero visual occupying the upper 50–54% and a structured recruitment information system in the lower half.
- Title zone sits over or just below the hero image with strong visual priority; {동아리명} reads as the main masthead, supported by {포스터 태그라인} and a small semester label {학기}.
- Background treatment uses a deep charcoal-to-near-black matte surface with visible fine 35mm grain, film leader numbers, contact-sheet marks, subtle dust specks, faint cyan/amber light leaks, and editorial paper texture.
- Overall design should resemble a premium campus poster printed on thick matte paper: layered photo frame, filmstrip edge graphics, crop marks, small REC/timecode details, and precise information modules.
- Integrate {분야}, {모집 대상}, {활동}, {장비·지원}, {모집 기간}, {오리엔테이션}, {장소}, {참가비}, {신청 방법}, {문의}, {인스타그램}, {후원}, and {비주얼 컨셉} as readable poster content, not merely decorative filler.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero area (top 50–54%): create a cinematic still or object-led visual based on {비주얼 컨셉}; include a film camera, lens, clapperboard, contact prints, SD card, marked script pages, gaffer tape, or a small monitor showing a moody short-film frame. Make one focal subject dominant with controlled depth.
- Masthead zone (top 14%): place {동아리명} in large type, centered or slightly left-aligned, with {포스터 태그라인} beneath. Add small editorial metadata such as “RECRUITING NOW”, “CAMPUS FILM & PHOTO SOCIETY”, and {학기}.
- Main recruitment band (middle-lower): split into two editorial columns. Left column: “모집 분야” with {분야}, “대상” with {모집 대상}. Right column: “활동” with {활동}, “장비 지원” with {장비·지원}. Use thin divider rules, numbered labels 01–04, and amber/cyan section tabs.
- Event detail strip: include “모집 기간 {모집 기간}”, “오리엔테이션 {오리엔테이션}”, “장소 {장소}”, and “참가비 {참가비}” in a compact ticket-info style row, similar to a real festival poster.
- Application footer (bottom 12–15%): feature {신청 방법} with a clear QR placeholder box labeled {QR문구}; place {문의} and {인스타그램} nearby as micro information. The QR box may be stylized but should look like a printed placeholder rather than a guaranteed scannable code.
- Sponsor / credit area: add a narrow bottom sponsor line with {후원}, small campus-magazine style credit text, and a spine-like vertical credit on one edge reading “FRAME ARCHIVE / FILM PHOTO WORKSHOP / STUDENT CREW”.
- Decorative graphics: use film perforation marks, tiny frame numbers, waveform ticks, negative-strip thumbnails, red REC dot, and small bilingual labels; these should enhance realism while preserving a clear recruitment hierarchy.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for the masthead, Pretendard SemiBold for section headings, Pretendard Regular for body text, and a condensed sans-serif or mono style for timecode, frame numbers, QR label, and metadata. Title size should feel oversized and editorial, with compact tracking and strong hierarchy.
- Color palette: charcoal #16181D, warm amber #C58B4A, muted cyan #5E8FA8, off-white #F2EEE7, and desaturated steel gray #8B919B from {컬러 톤}; use red only as a tiny REC/accent signal.
- Border/shadow: use subtle 1px divider lines in soft gray, hairline crop marks, transparent label boxes, and a restrained soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity under the hero photo layer or floating title blocks.
- Texture: fine 35mm film grain, matte paper finish, slight halftone softness in dark areas, realistic printed ink density, faint fingerprint smudges on photo edges, and soft light-leak overlays.
- Information design: all Korean recruitment details must remain legible at poster scale; create a believable university noticeboard flyer with real dates, location, contact, application CTA, and sponsor/credit microtext.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: cinematic 50mm or 85mm still-life look, shot like a film editorial frame on a full-frame camera, Canon EOS R5 with RF 50mm f/1.2 or RF 85mm f/1.2, shallow but controlled depth and clean subject separation.
- Lighting: soft key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, and a faint cyan rim light to separate the subject from the charcoal background; if using an object scene, add a practical warm amber desk lamp or projector spill.
- Color grade: faded cinematic grade with lifted blacks, muted highlights, charcoal shadows, amber mids, slight cyan in cool areas, mild print grain, and a modern film-still poster mood.

[6. MOOD]
Cinematic student-culture editorial — like a Kinfolk x A24 campus recruitment spread mixed with a real university film festival poster, tactile printed paper, film archive details, practical application information, and confident premium typography.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문자열
  - {동아리명}
  - {포스터 태그라인}
  - {학기}
  - {분야}
  - {모집 대상}
  - {활동}
  - {장비·지원}
  - {모집 기간}
  - {오리엔테이션}
  - {장소}
  - {참가비}
  - {신청 방법}
  - {QR문구}
  - {문의}
  - {인스타그램}
  - {후원}
- Render these Korean poster labels clearly: “모집 분야”, “대상”, “활동”, “장비 지원”, “모집 기간”, “오리엔테이션”, “장소”, “참가비”, “지원하기”, “문의”, “FOLLOW”.
- Layout invariants: hero visual first, masthead second, recruitment modules third, event/ticket details fourth, application footer last; the poster must read as a real structured campus recruitment flyer.
- Make the QR area, sponsor line, frame numbers, contact-sheet marks, and film metadata feel printed and intentional while keeping every main Korean information line readable.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures unless explicitly provided
- Illegible main recruitment text or distorted typography

[1. PURPOSE]
University dance club recruitment poster for campus bulletin and vertical A4-style social media flyer.
K-pop MV energy with a real campus audition-poster feel: dynamic hero dancer, neon performance atmosphere, recruitment blocks, event details, sponsor strip, ticket/free-entry note, and short Korean promo copy that makes the poster feel printed and posted around school.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main dancer hero occupies about 55% of the frame, slightly off-center to the right, with the title block balancing the left upper area and layered event information flowing down the left and bottom zones.
- Background uses a dark stage-like surface with subtle smoke haze, neon light streaks, faint grid texture, taped poster edges, small scuff marks, and campus bulletin-board realism to imply a performance and audition space.
- Build a readable but energetic hierarchy: bold headline, dancer silhouette, three main recruitment cards, small date/time/venue/ticket strip, sponsor area, QR-style application block, and decorative diagonal graphic elements.
- Use {동아리명}, {장르}, {모집 대상·인원}, {활동 일정}, {신청 방법}, {비주얼 컨셉}, {컬러 톤}, {레이아웃} as content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header zone: place {동아리명} as the largest title in bold, stacked Korean + English club-poster style, with a second-line subtitle using {장르} in smaller uppercase text. Add small header labels: 대학 댄스 동아리 모집 포스터, 2026 SPRING CREW, OPEN AUDITION, VOL.08.
- Hero zone (mid-right, about 55%): show a dynamic dancer in a jump or spin pose, motion blur kept controlled and sharp on the body, with vivid multicolor spotlights behind them. Include realistic street-dance styling such as loose jacket, sneakers, layered shadows on the floor, flying hair or fabric, and reflected neon highlights.
- Left info column: organize {모집 대상·인원}, {활동 일정}, and {신청 방법} into three clean boxed sections with clear separators and strong visual hierarchy. Add Korean section labels: 모집 대상, 활동 일정, 신청 방법, 오디션 안내.
- Event detail strip: include date/time/venue and participation information in compact Korean text: 2026.03.04 - 03.15, 매주 화·목 18:30, 학생회관 B1 연습실, 참가비 무료, 현장 관람 가능.
- Ticket / access block: add a small faux ticket tag reading FREE ENTRY, 신입생 환영, QR 신청, 마감 D-7, with a QR-code-like square graphic that does not need to scan.
- Accent zone: integrate {비주얼 컨셉} as a short slogan or visual cue near the lower third, connected to neon shapes, diagonal energy lines, starbursts, arrows, sticker-like tags, and rhythm-wave graphics.
- Sponsor / credit footer: include a small sponsor area with campus-style text such as 주최 학생문화팀, 후원 총학생회, 문의 @campus_dance, photo credit MODEL / {동아리명} CREW, and tiny safety note 실내화 지참.
- Color system: apply {컬러 톤} consistently across title glow, spotlight beams, section dividers, sticker labels, footer strip, QR block, and small decorative shapes.
- Layout system: execute {레이아웃} with a poster-like editorial grid, making the main title dominant and the recruitment information highly legible while still feeling like an energetic printed campus event poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for the main title, Noto Sans KR SemiBold for body info, and condensed sans for small labels; title size should feel oversized, with tight tracking on the hero text and clear spacing in details.
- Korean poster copy to include as readable micro-content where appropriate: 지금 무대의 주인공은 너, 신입 부원 모집, BEGINNER WELCOME, CREW CLASS, PERFORMANCE TEAM, 문의 DM 가능.
- Color palette: use vivid hot pink, cyan, yellow, and black as defined by {컬러 톤}; add small white text for contrast and readability.
- Border/shadow: use sharp neon glow edges on light beams, subtle 8px y-offset drop shadow, 18px blur, 20% opacity for title blocks, thin divider lines for info cards, plus realistic print grain, slight paper texture, tape corners, sticker outlines, and small registration-mark details.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame action photography look, f/2.8, fast shutter impression, slightly low-angle framing to amplify dance power.
- Lighting: hard stage spotlights from upper left and upper right, colored rim light in cyan and magenta, with a faint backlight haze for concert atmosphere.
- Color grade: high-contrast K-pop music video grade with electric magenta, neon cyan, and warm yellow highlights against deep black shadows.
- Material realism: combine photographic dancer lighting with graphic poster overlays, semi-gloss print texture, subtle folded-paper shadows, mild ink grain, and realistic campus flyer wear.

[6. MOOD]
High-energy campus performance poster — feels like a polished K-pop comeback teaser, a university dance showcase ad, and a real audition flyer posted on a busy student-center wall.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following verbatim Korean strings must appear correctly in the rendered image:
  - 대학 댄스 동아리 모집 포스터

  - 학생회관 B1 연습실
  - 문의 @campus_dance
- Typography must be crisp and readable; all Korean characters must remain unbroken.
- Show a single coherent poster layout with one main dancer hero, structured recruitment information, event detail strip, QR-style application block, sponsor/credit footer, and decorative K-pop dance graphics.

- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-380.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
University music and band club recruitment poster in a vintage zine style, designed for student-facing campus noticeboards, hallway boards, student union walls, and social sharing.
Portrait-format recruitment poster with a small-stage live music mood, combining silhouetted performance photography, hand-drawn line art, handwritten copy, campus event information, QR application cues, sponsor strip, and ticket-stub-inspired details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The poster is a vertical 2:3 composition matching 1024x1536, with the main title and issue-style header occupying the top 18%, the hero live-stage collage in the middle 50%, and recruitment, event, application, and sponsor details stacked through the lower 32%.
- Center the club name {동아리명} as the primary focal point, then build a layered student zine layout using boxed notices, torn tape labels, sticker bursts, ticket stubs, handwritten arrows, and small line icons.
- Use a dark charcoal paper-like background with subtle grain, faded print texture, folded poster creases, tape residue, photocopy speckles, and slightly worn zine edges for an authentic campus flyer feel.
- Include realistic poster metadata such as VOL.04, 2026 SPRING RECRUIT, campus notice number, date stamp, small page-code marks, and a thin spine credit reading 디자인·촬영 동아리 홍보팀 along one side.
- Integrate {비주얼컨셉} so the layout feels like a gig flyer assembled from collage, live photo fragments, hand-marked notes, and printed campus announcement materials.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header band: Set {동아리명} in a large condensed masthead style, with slightly uneven ink edges, centered over a distressed rule line. Add a small subtitle line for {장르}, plus micro labels VOL.04, 2026 SPRING RECRUIT, OPEN JAM NIGHT, and the main handwritten copy {메인카피}.
- Mid hero zone: Create a small live-stage scene with 3 to 4 silhouetted student performers, visible guitar neck, drum kit rim, mic stand, bass amp, pedalboard, tangled cable loops, and a few blurred audience hands near the bottom edge. Use one warm amber backlight, rough halftone printing, and thin vintage line illustrations of speakers, microphones, picks, cassette tape, and waveform scribbles.
- Recruitment note block: Place {모집대상인원} in a bold boxed zine note area titled 모집 파트, with compact role badges such as VOCAL, GUITAR, BASS, DRUM, KEYS, PRODUCER, and short Korean role labels that are easy to scan.
- Event details panel: Place {활동일정}, {오디션일시}, {오티일시}, and {장소} in a calendar-like strip with date/time/venue hierarchy. Add small labels 일정, 오디션, OT, 장소, 정기공연, and a mini timetable graphic.
- Ticket and participation area: Add a ticket-stub section showing {참가비}, 입장 무료, 선착순 오픈잼, 학생증 지참, and 동아리방 방문 환영, designed like a perforated live-house ticket.
- Application block: Set {신청방법} beside a realistic QR placeholder area, with marker-style arrows, QR로 30초 신청, 신청 마감 {마감일}, and {문의}. Add small tear-off tabs along the bottom with repeated contact snippets and Instagram/mail cues.
- Sponsor and supporter strip: At the very bottom, create a small SUPPORTED BY area for {후원}, campus cultural office support, local practice room partner, and tiny monochrome sponsor marks styled as printed logos without official-seal treatment.
- Accent graphics: Add red sticker-like marks, scribbled underlines, tape pieces, thumbtack shadows, torn paper overlaps, rough halftone dots, amp-volume knobs, plectrum icons, staff-line fragments, and small Korean callouts around the main information.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard SemiBold or SUIT Bold for core labels, Noto Sans KR Medium for body copy, and a hand-drawn script accent only for tiny emphasis lines; title size should feel poster-large and the body should remain highly legible.
- Color palette: Use the palette implied by {컬러톤}, anchored in dark charcoal #1E1E1E, vintage amber #C98A2A, muted red #B83A2F, and off-white paper tint #F2E9DA, with occasional dusty gray ink and faded kraft-paper beige.
- Borders/shadows: Add thin worn paper borders, overlapping photocopy sheets, soft offset shadow 2px y-offset, 8px blur, 18% opacity, and subtle print misregistration to mimic a duplicated club flyer taped to a campus wall.
- Texture: Apply light halftone grain, photocopy noise, faint ink bleed at edges, rough risograph dots, crease marks, and slight toner density variation across text blocks and photos.
- Layout rhythm: Combine strong title hierarchy with dense but organized zine details, letting event information, ticket stub, QR, sponsor strip, and decorative graphics feel naturally printed rather than digitally sterile.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm documentary-style stage photo feel, equivalent to a Canon EOS R5 with 35mm f/1.8 at f/2.8, framed as a live club flyer image rather than a wide concert shot.
- Lighting: Single warm stage spotlight from upper-left behind the performers, with low ambient fill and slight edge rim from the right to define silhouettes.
- Color grade: Dark charcoal base with warm amber highlights and selective red accent marks, giving a scanned indie-zine print finish.

[6. MOOD]
Campus indie gig flyer — like a DIY student zine inspired by Vice magazine culture, basement live-house posters, student union bulletin boards, photocopied audition notices, and end-of-semester campus festival handbills.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구 — 대학 음악·밴드 동아리 모집 포스터, 동아리, 장르, 모집, 일정, 신청, 오디션, 장소, 마감, 문의, 입장 무료, 협력.
- 포스터 안에 실제로 보이는 한국어 예시를 자연스럽게 포함: 지금 같이 무대에 설 사람, QR로 30초 신청, 학생회관 B1 소공연장, 4월 10일 금 19:00, VOL.04, 2026 SPRING RECRUIT.
- 제목, 장르, 모집 파트, 일정, 신청 방법, 장소, 마감일, 문의가 한눈에 구분되도록 글자 크기와 박스 라벨의 위계를 분명히 유지.
- QR 영역은 실제 캠퍼스 포스터처럼 보이는 정사각형 코드 자리와 안내 화살표를 포함하되, 신청 문구와 연락처가 가려지지 않게 배치.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications / university authority stamps
- Broken Korean characters or garbled Hangul
- Celebrity face composites or real-person impersonation
