[1. PURPOSE]
1-2 English lines: i2i professional costume transformation portrait, photoreal commercial style for social profile / concept art use.
Create a believable occupation-themed makeover while preserving identity and body structure from the source photo, with real workplace atmosphere and a subtle profile-card editorial layer.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: the attached person stays the hero, full upper-body to half-body framing with face occupying about 35-40% of frame height.
- Identity preservation: keep {원본 보존} exactly, with no facial reshaping, no body slimming, no age change.
- Costume focus: replace only clothing according to {직업·코스튬}; add believable workwear details such as seams, pockets, name tag, apron strap, badge holder, pen clip, cuff folds, or safety accessory when appropriate.
- Job action: integrate {포즈·자세} so the hands interact with real occupational tools from {직업 소품} in a natural, mid-work moment.
- Background treatment: build a realistic occupational environment based on {배경}, including practical textures, shelves, counters, instruments, documents, machines, trays, cables, wall notices, or soft background signage that would naturally exist in that workplace.
- Editorial profile layer: add a small clean Korean label area using {프로필 라벨}, {날짜·위치}, {캡션}, and {해시태그}; keep it secondary to the portrait, like a modern SNS profile card rather than an advertisement poster.
- Framing direction: subject slightly off-center for a natural editorial feel, with the occupational context visible around hands, torso, and background.
- Use {직업·코스튬}, {배경}, {포즈·자세}, {직업 소품}, {라이팅}, {컬러 톤}, {프로필 라벨}, {날짜·위치}, {캡션}, {해시태그}, {원본 보존} placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Face and body lock-in — preserve the source person’s facial identity, skin texture, hairstyle silhouette, and body proportions from {원본 보존}; keep expression natural and realistic.
2. Wardrobe replacement — apply the occupation outfit from {직업·코스튬} with believable fabric folds, seam details, material thickness, and practical wear marks; avoid costume-party exaggeration.
3. Pose integration — adapt {포즈·자세} so hands interact naturally with {직업 소품}; fingers must remain anatomically correct and gesture flow must match the occupation.
4. Environment build — render {배경} as a real working location with appropriate counters, tools, equipment, posters, notices, shelves, papers, uniforms, instruments, or everyday workplace objects that support the profession.
5. Profile-card details — place {프로필 라벨} as a small top or lower-third identifier, {날짜·위치} as a date/location tag, {캡션} as a short one-line caption, and {해시태그} as subtle social tags; include tiny save/share style micro icons if they fit the layout.
6. Lighting match — follow {라이팅} with physically plausible shadows, consistent highlights on face and clothing, and realistic reflections on metal, glass, ceramic, fabric, or plastic props.
7. Color harmony — apply {컬러 톤} across clothing accents, background materials, tools, label graphics, and secondary objects so the scene feels commercially coherent.
8. Photoreal finish — keep pores, hair strands, cloth texture, dust, paper grain, steam, soft fingerprints on glass, ambient occlusion, and real lens depth visible; maintain a polished commercial-photo finish rather than illustration.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use clean Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the small editorial overlay and any readable workplace labels; medium to semi-bold weight, 22-36px equivalent for tags, 38-54px equivalent for the main profile label.
- Text placement: profile label and caption should sit in a calm lower-third or side tag area; date/location may appear as a small pill label; hashtag text can be compact near the bottom edge.
- Color palette: derive from {컬러 톤}, with realistic neutrals like black, white, gray, navy, wood brown, stainless steel, cream, or mint accents as needed; avoid oversaturated neon unless the chosen profession naturally uses it.
- Graphic accents: use subtle translucent rectangles, thin dividers, tiny dots, save/share micro icons, or small tag stickers; make them feel like a modern mobile profile card overlay integrated with the photograph.
- Shadow and depth: use natural shadows under chin, clothing folds, hands, props, and countertop contact points, with realistic soft edge falloff and practical ambient occlusion.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.4 portrait look, shallow but controlled depth of field, commercial portrait sharpness.
- Lighting: match the environment with soft window light or overhead fluorescent practicals depending on {배경}; keep a clear key-light direction and gentle fill, with realistic specular control on skin, fabric, tools, glass, metal, and laminated surfaces.
- Color grade: photoreal editorial grade with balanced contrast, clean skin tones, and occupation-specific color balance from {컬러 톤}.

[6. MOOD]
Modern commercial portrait transformation — like a high-end LinkedIn headshot campaign meets a realistic TV drama wardrobe change, finished as a stylish Korean SNS profile card.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render all visible Korean text cleanly and exactly, especially {프로필 라벨}, {날짜·위치}, {캡션}, and {해시태그}; examples may read “바리스타 프로필”, “2026.05.01 성수동”, “오늘의 라떼아트 기록”, “#출근룩 #직업프로필”.
- Anatomical/layout invariants: preserve the source person’s identity from {원본 보존}; hands must be anatomically correct with exactly 5 fingers per hand; no extra limbs, duplicate hands, warped wrists, or face distortion.
- Work realism: costume, tools, and background must match the chosen job from {직업·코스튬}; props should look used in a real workplace, not like toy props or stage decorations.
- The result must feel like a real photographed occupational portrait with subtle profile-card design, not a cosplay poster or illustration.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications / government-style authorization marks
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable Hangul
- Unauthorized celebrity composites or duplicated faces
- Extra hands, distorted anatomy, cartoonish props, CG glow, or painterly rendering

[INPUT]

- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean portrait studio style conversion for i2i, preserving the original person while transforming the image into a formal Korean photo studio finish. Vertical 2:3 editorial studio portrait, identity-safe retouching, suitable for family, graduation, wedding, profile, or milestone commemorative photos with a believable printed-studio atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Preserve the original subject's face and identity exactly, while converting only the styling, background, pose feel, wardrobe, and studio rendering into a classic Korean photo studio look.
- The subject should remain the clear hero, occupying about 65% of the frame height, with refined headroom and shoulders framed cleanly for a premium studio-portrait crop.
- Background treatment: seamless studio paper or painted canvas in {배경 톤}, evenly lit with a natural tonal gradient, subtle paper grain, gentle floor/backdrop transition if visible, and realistic contact shadow behind the subject.
- Composition should feel like a real Korean portrait studio session: centered or slightly off-center depending on {포즈}, with tasteful studio details such as a small posing stool edge, soft reflector catchlight, folded fabric texture, or a faint studio floor line only when naturally fitting the pose.
- Add a subtle printed-photo presentation: a narrow lower margin or small studio proof label may appear with clean Korean text such as "기념사진 · 2026.05", "서울 사진관", or "소중한 오늘", placed small enough to feel like a studio print detail rather than a poster.
- Use {원본 보존} as the identity constraint, {사진관 모드} as the portrait styling direction, {의상} for wardrobe matching, and {카메라·렌즈} for the capture look.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero subject area (middle 60%): keep the original person fully recognizable, with natural pores, fine hair detail, real facial asymmetry, and studio-grade retouching limited to tonal cleanup, lint removal, and gentle complexion balancing.
- Face and expression: maintain the original facial structure and expression stability from {원본 보존}, with a calm formal smile or neutral dignified expression appropriate to {사진관 모드}; keep the gaze believable and eye catchlights consistent with the studio lights.
- Wardrobe styling: apply {의상} precisely according to the selected photo-studio mode, with realistic fabric weave, collar structure, seams, buttons, lapels, cuffs, jewelry or boutonniere details only if appropriate to the mode.
- Pose and hands: follow {포즈}, with anatomically correct hands, relaxed shoulders, natural neck posture, and a composed studio stance; if hands are visible, keep fingers natural, proportionate, and softly posed as a photographer would direct.
- Background plane: render {배경 톤} as a premium studio backdrop with realistic matte surface, soft tonal falloff, faint contact shadows, and gentle separation around hair and shoulders.
- Lighting pass: apply {라이팅} as a controlled studio setup, creating even facial illumination, gentle under-chin softness, clean catchlights, realistic shadow under the jawline, and believable separation between subject, clothing, and backdrop.
- Camera rendering: emulate {카메라·렌즈} with a medium-format studio portrait feel, crisp focus on eyes, natural skin detail, controlled depth, accurate fabric texture, and restrained highlight roll-off.
- Studio print details: if a lower caption strip or proof mark is included, set short Korean text cleanly in small Pretendard-style type, e.g. "2026년 5월 · 가족사진", "STUDIO 기록", or "서울 강남 사진관", with no spelling errors.
- Final grade: keep the image elegant, formal, and print-ready, with balanced contrast, rich but restrained tonal depth, believable photographic paper texture, and a refined Korean portrait studio finish.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: optional small studio-print label only; use Pretendard SemiBold or Pretendard Regular, 20–32px equivalent, accurate Korean typesetting, placed in a lower margin, corner proof label, or tiny studio credit line.
- Color palette: anchor the scene to {배경 톤}, with muted studio neutrals such as cream gray, soft beige, warm taupe, off-white, charcoal accents, and natural skin tones; avoid oversaturation while retaining lifelike depth.
- Border/shadow: if presented as a studio print, allow a thin off-white photo-paper edge, very soft contact shadow, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 12–15% opacity, and slight paper thickness for a realistic keepsake-photo feel.
- Surface finish: keep the portrait matte and print-like, with subtle photographic paper grain, real textile texture, natural hair detail, and no plastic smoothing, CGI gloss, or synthetic overlay effects.
- Decorative details: allow restrained Korean studio finishing touches such as a small date/location label, embossed-looking studio credit, neutral mat-board edge, or a simple archival sticker reading "보정본" or "기념사진" when it supports the portrait mode.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: emulate Hasselblad H6D-100c, 80mm f/4, ISO 100, studio portrait framing, sharp central detail with smooth edge falloff.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from front-left at about 45°, very light fill from front-right, subtle hair or rim separation when appropriate, realistic reflector softness, minimal shadow contrast, consistent with a formal Korean portrait studio.
- Color grade: neutral cream + beige + soft gray grade with accurate skin tones, low saturation, refined midtone contrast, clean white balance slightly warm but not yellow, and a polished studio-print finish.

[6. MOOD]
Classic Korean portrait studio editorial — formal keepsake photo quality with the restrained dignity of a high-end family studio portrait, enhanced by subtle real-world studio print details, refined wardrobe texture, and believable photographic depth.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: if any caption, proof label, studio credit, or date/location text appears, render it in clean Korean without broken characters; recommended short strings include "기념사진", "2026년 5월", "서울 사진관", "소중한 오늘", or "보정본".
- Identity invariants: the subject's face, age impression, facial proportions, and personal identity must remain 100% recognizable from the reference image.
- Portrait invariants: no extra limbs, no warped hands, no exaggerated beauty retouching, no facial structure changes, no artificial bokeh halos, no CGI look, and no plastic skin smoothing.
- Studio invariants: keep the image consistent with a real Korean photo studio capture, including believable lighting, fabric texture, background contact shadows, clean print finishing, and restrained tonal conversion only.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals/certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness substitution

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean ion beverage advertising poster, vertical A4-style promotional key visual for a refreshing sports-drink campaign.
Editorial commercial poster with photoreal product hero, dynamic splash action, energetic beach-running lifestyle context, and polished Korean typography for print, subway lightbox, convenience-store POP, and social use.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: {레이아웃} with a strong vertical split; left column for campaign copy, runner scene, and small promotional details, right side for the oversized bottle hero, and a white bottom band for logo, availability, QR/coupon area, and legal copy.
- Subject placement: the bottle hero occupies about 42% of the frame height on the right, angled slightly toward camera; left text column takes about 34% width; bottom band about 11% height, with realistic print-ad micro text and a small barcode/QR-style coupon box.
- Background treatment: cool sky-blue to white gradient field with a subtle water mist texture, condensation droplets, refractive splash particles, and a distant beach-and-sky morning scene anchored in the lower-left area with promenade details, flags, hydration station cups, and soft sunlight on the sand.
- Spacing and framing: keep the headline, bottle label, and footer readable while allowing natural advertising details such as campaign date, small sponsor/retail information, tiny product-size callouts, and realistic poster production marks.
- Use {브랜드·제품명}, {메인 한글 헤드라인}, {부카피}, {3대 가치}, {hero 비주얼}, {배경 군중}, {컬러 톤}, {하단 슬로건·로고}, {fine print} as the content variables.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top campaign strip: add a slim upper-left label reading "2026 SUMMER HYDRATION CAMPAIGN" and "VOL. 06 / BEACH RUN EDITION" in small type, with a tiny date label "2026.06.01–08.31".
2) Left copy block: set {메인 한글 헤드라인} large at the upper-left, followed by {부카피} in smaller body text, with {3대 가치} stacked beneath as three compact icon-led bullets; include small blue divider lines and tiny water-drop icons that feel like printed campaign graphics.
3) Left lower visual block: place {배경 군중} beneath the copy, blending them into the scene as a lifestyle runner group with clear silhouettes and energetic motion, realistic race bibs, sweat-darkened athletic fabric, morning beach haze, and a small hydration point in the background.
4) Right hero block: render {hero 비주얼} as a photoreal translucent PET bottle with crisp label readability, visible condensation beads, cap grooves, transparent liquid refraction, and high-speed water splash arcs with bright refractive highlights.
5) Promotional detail layer: near the lower middle, add realistic poster callouts such as "500ml / 1.5L", "전국 편의점·마트에서 만나요", "상쾌한 수분 밸런스 체크", a small QR coupon box labeled "스캔하고 오늘의 수분 루틴 받기", and a tiny handle "@pocarisweat_kr".
6) Background integration: wrap the entire poster in {컬러 톤}, using the sky-blue area behind the runners and a whiter, brighter zone behind the bottle for contrast; add layered splash droplets that cross the split subtly so the scene feels physically connected.
7) Bottom band: place {하단 슬로건·로고} on the left and center, with {fine print} in very small but legible type along the bottom edge; include a narrow barcode-style retail mark, production code "AD-ION-2026-06", and small recycling/PET sorting icons as realistic packaging-ad details.
8) Brand hierarchy: {브랜드·제품명} should be visually dominant on the bottle label and echoed in the footer branding, while the main headline remains the emotional campaign message.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Black or Cafe24 for the main headline at very large size; Pretendard SemiBold for subcopy; Noto Sans KR for fine print; use confident Korean sans-serif forms with tight tracking for the hero headline, compact captions for micro information, and more open tracking for footer copy.
- Color palette: sky blue #1AA3E8, white #FFFFFF, ice blue #DDF4FF, deep cobalt #1E5FA8, and soft silver-gray #D9E2EC.
- Border/shadow: use a subtle soft shadow under the bottle, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; add a faint white glow around splash highlights for separation.
- Decorative graphic elements: use translucent water-drop badges, cobalt divider rules, tiny wave-line motifs, and print-realistic registration/crop micro marks near the edges, all integrated into the commercial poster design.
- Product realism: the bottle plastic should show molded seams, label wrap curvature, condensation, slight cap texture, and believable liquid thickness; splashes must interact with the bottle and foreground light.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: commercial product-photo look shot on a Phase One IQ4 with an 80mm lens at f/8 for the bottle, paired with a 35mm editorial framing feel for the full poster composition.
- Lighting: bright studio key from upper-left at 45° with a cool fill from the right, plus hard specular catches on the bottle and splash edges; the runners should be lit with soft daylight consistent with a beach morning scene.
- Color grade: crisp cyan-white commercial grade with cool aqua mids, clean whites, and slightly boosted clarity on the splash droplets.
- Material detail: droplets should have individual highlights and shadows, beach air should feel slightly humid, and the printed typography should sit naturally over the photographic layers like a finished outdoor ad.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean sports-drink campaign visual — modern Seoul outdoor ad aesthetic with refreshing summer energy, beach-run realism, crisp hydration cues, and a high-end beverage poster finish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 렌더링되어야 하는 문구: "몸이 원하는 / 수분 밸런스", "땀 흘린 만큼, 포카리스웨트", "체액과 가장 가까운 수분 밸런스, 포카리스웨트가 당신의 하루를 가볍고 상쾌하게 채워줍니다.", "💧 체액과 가장 가까운 수분 밸런스", "🏃 땀으로 손실된 전해질 빠르게 보충", "❤️ 남녀노소 누구나 안심하고 수분 보충", "30년 이상, 변하지 않은 진심 / 수분 보충은 포카리스웨트", "ION SUPPLY DRINK".
- Additional small Korean/English poster details may include: "2026 SUMMER HYDRATION CAMPAIGN", "VOL. 06 / BEACH RUN EDITION", "2026.06.01–08.31", "500ml / 1.5L", "전국 편의점·마트에서 만나요", "스캔하고 오늘의 수분 루틴 받기", "@pocarisweat_kr", "AD-ION-2026-06".
- Bottle label must read exactly POCARI SWEAT with the white serif logo treatment, white curve mark, and the small ION SUPPLY DRINK text.
- Human figures in {배경 군중} should look anatomically correct, natural-running posture, and the group must contain exactly 4 people with a 2 male / 2 female balance as described.
- Keep splash motion photoreal and physically plausible, with droplets and arcs driven by bottle movement rather than abstract CG ribbons.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- title: 프리미엄 커피 브랜드 광고

[1. PURPOSE]
Premium coffee brand advertising poster for a global cafe identity, designed as a high-end A4 vertical campaign visual with editorial magazine polish.
Brand-led lifestyle ad that balances product, cafe space, seasonal promotion, and human connection in a refined commercial photography style.
The poster should feel like a real in-store campaign print: premium hero photography, clear brand story, event details, QR reservation cue, small partner strip, and polished footer information.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall composition: {레이아웃}.
- Left column: deep green campaign information panel containing {브랜드명}, {캠페인명}, {메인 영문 헤드라인}, {한글 부카피}, the three value statements, and small editorial divider lines.
- Right hero zone: warm wood tabletop cafe scene featuring {hero 비주얼}, with realistic ceramic glaze, coffee surface reflections, paper grain, wood texture, pastry crumbs, receipt edge, roasted beans, and soft natural shadow.
- Lifestyle presence: integrate {인물라이프스타일컷} as a secondary photographic moment, either softly visible in the cafe background or as a small editorial inset aligned with the grid.
- Bottom campaign footer: include {하단 카피}, {프로모션기간}, {이벤트정보}, {장소및시간}, {티켓안내}, {가격정보}, {매장정보}, {QR안내}, {소셜태그}, and {후원및파트너} as believable printed poster information.
- Decorative graphics: add restrained coffee-bean contour marks, small steam-line icons, a narrow vertical side credit using {사이드크레딧}, and fine typographic rules that support a premium cafe identity.
- The final visual should read immediately as a premium coffee campaign poster at 1024x1536, with a clear left-to-right hierarchy and rich, realistic cafe details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Left header block: place {브랜드명} at the top-left in refined branding text, then place {캠페인명} as a small campaign label above or near the main headline.
2. Main headline block: set {메인 영문 헤드라인} as the dominant typographic statement using a large editorial serif style, with strong contrast against the green panel.
3. Korean subcopy block: place {한글 부카피} under the headline in smaller Korean copy, using clean line spacing and crisp hierarchy.
4. Value block: present {3대 가치} as three separate compact items, each with a small icon, rule, or dot marker; include coffee bean, people-connection, and sustainability-inspired micro symbols.
5. Right hero scene: show {hero 비주얼} as the visual anchor on a warm wood surface, including realistic product contact shadows, ceramic highlights, natural grain, condensation or steam detail, notebook paper texture, pen metal reflection, and plant bokeh.
6. Lifestyle integration: place {인물라이프스타일컷} as a candid cafe moment that extends the brand story, with believable posture, laptop, books, tableware, and warm ambient light.
7. Footer information system: build a real poster footer with {프로모션기간}, {이벤트정보}, {장소및시간}, {티켓안내}, {가격정보}, {매장정보}, a small QR code area labeled {QR안내}, {소셜태그}, and {후원및파트너}.
8. Side credit and production detail: add {사이드크레딧} vertically along one edge, plus tiny print-production style text such as campaign code, print date, or poster series number.
9. Palette application: use {컬러 톤} as the core color logic, with deep green on the left, amber-wood warmth on the right, cream text, dark espresso accents, and subtle gold highlights.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Playfair Display or Garamond for the English headline in bold serif styling, plus Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean copy in clean medium-to-regular weights; headline size should feel large and editorial, subcopy and event details should remain highly legible.
- Color palette: derive the design from {컬러 톤}; emphasize deep green #006241, warm amber, golden wood, cream white, espresso brown, muted olive, and natural paper neutrals.
- Print realism: include slight paper grain, ink-like deep green density, precise typographic alignment, realistic QR label block, fine divider rules, and small sponsor/partner text that resembles an actual printed retail poster.
- Shadow and depth: use a soft realistic drop shadow around the hero mug and objects, about 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; add natural contact shadow under notebook, pen, cup, and receipt.
- Brand treatment: real cafe brand styling and logo placement are allowed; keep the logo clean, correctly proportioned, and integrated into the campaign layout.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Hasselblad X2D 100c with XCD 80mm f/2.8 at ISO 100, f/4 for the hero scene; optional secondary lifestyle detail can feel like Sony A7R V with 50mm f/1.4 for candid commercial realism.
- Lighting: soft natural side light from the left at roughly 45°, gentle fill from the front, warm golden-hour ambience, subtle highlight roll-off on the mug and tabletop, realistic plant bokeh in the background.
- Color grade: warm cream, deep green, amber wood, espresso brown, and soft golden neutrals with a refined magazine print tone, controlled contrast, and realistic saturation.
- Material detail: ceramic mug glaze, coffee crema, wood grain, recycled paper receipt, linen napkin fibers, matte notebook cover, glossy logo ink, and tiny dust or light particles should feel tactile and photographed.

[6. MOOD]
Premium coffee campaign editorial — a Starbucks-inspired commercial poster with Kinfolk magazine calm, warm cafe lifestyle storytelling, seasonal event credibility, and polished global brand confidence.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보이도록 렌더링할 것:
  - 스타벅스 STARBUCKS — Starbucks Coffee Company
  - SPRING RESERVE TASTING
  - More than Coffee — 커피 그 이상의 경험
  - 커피 그 이상의 공간 / 당신의 하루가 더 특별해지는 곳, 스타벅스가 함께합니다.
  - QUALITY COFFEE — 최고의 품질과 윤리적 원두 구매를 고집합니다
  - MEANINGFUL CONNECTION — 사람과 사람을 잇는 따뜻한 연결을 만듭니다
  - BETTER FUTURE — 지속 가능한 미래를 위해 오늘도 노력합니다
  - 2026.05.01–05.31
  - 매주 금·토 16:00 / 서울 종로 리저브 매장
  - 참가 무료 · 모바일 QR 예약
  - 오늘의 커피 Tall ₩4,500 / 리저브 핸드드립 ₩7,500 / 시그니처 라떼 ₩6,200
  - 서울 종로구 세종대로 172 | 02-1522-3232
  - 공식 파트너: 지속가능 커피 랩 · 로컬 베이커리
  - @starbucks_korea #MakeItYours #오늘의커피
  - "MAKE IT yours"
  - 이 공간, 이 순간, 이 커피는 당신만의 이야기로 완성됩니다.
- Visual integrity: hands, cups, notebook, QR block, receipt, logo, and lifestyle figures must be anatomically and materially believable; no extra fingers, warped mugs, melted typography, or distorted logo geometry.
- Layout consistency: left column, right hero, lifestyle moment, side credit, and bottom footer must remain clearly readable as one premium poster system.
- Rendered Korean must be sharp, correctly spaced, and placed on stable flat surfaces or clean typography layers.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / government-style certification marks
- Broken Korean characters / garbled typography
- Celebrity composites or recognizable celebrity likenesses
- Anatomically distorted hands, faces, cups, or warped product logos

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean beer advertisement poster, vertical A4-style campaign key visual, premium photoreal commercial look.
Designed for a crisp, high-energy alcohol brand promo with a cold, refreshing night-event atmosphere, including realistic poster information such as event date, venue, ticket notice, sponsor strip, and responsible drinking details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main bottle hero occupies the center 45% of the frame, slightly forward in perspective, with {hero 비주얼} as the visual anchor.
- Headline sits in the upper 18% area, large and bold, with {메인 헤드라인} clearly separated from the hero object.
- Subcopy is placed directly below the headline in a compact block, aligned left or center depending on balance, using {부카피}.
- Add a small event header near the top edge with {이벤트명}, {행사 일정}, and {행사 장소}, designed like a real seasonal campaign poster rather than a plain product ad.
- Background crowd stays concentrated in the lower-left and lower-center zones, using {배경 군중} to create concert-festival energy while the bottle remains dominant.
- Tag/info elements appear in the lower corners and footer strip, especially {태그·정보}, {티켓 정보}, {SNS·문의}, and {브랜드 정보}.
- Include a sponsor/support area in the bottom footer using {스폰서 영역}, styled as small typographic sponsor marks and simple logo-like text blocks.
- Add icy decorative graphics from {장식 그래픽}: fractured ice shards, cold mist, metallic silver streaks, small snowflake icons, splash trails, and light flares integrated around the bottle and headline.
- Keep the layout tall, poster-like, and layered: event header → headline/subcopy → hero splash → lifestyle/crowd energy → ticket/sponsor/footer details.
- Use {브랜드·제품명}, {브랜드 정보}, and {인물·lifestyle 컷} as coordinated campaign content, but keep the hero poster as the primary focal point.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top campaign band: place {이벤트명} as a small but premium event label, then place {메인 헤드라인} in a strong advertising masthead style, spanning most of the width, with the smaller {부카피} tucked beneath in a clean supporting line.
2. Main hero zone (mid 50%): render {hero 비주얼} as a photoreal bottle centerpiece with icy splash arcs, flying condensation droplets, cracked ice pieces, and cold vapor, lit to emphasize glass highlights and metallic label detail.
3. Event detail ribbon: integrate {행사 일정}, {행사 장소}, and {티켓 정보} as believable poster information on a metallic-silver or translucent ice-blue ribbon crossing the lower-middle or lower-right area.
4. Lower energy zone: build {배경 군중} as a deep-blue nightlife silhouette layer, with raised arms, bottles catching light, stage beam lights, confetti-like ice particles, and subtle motion blur only in the background.
5. Lifestyle insert: incorporate {인물·lifestyle 컷} as a natural auxiliary visual thread, like a small diagonal photo-strip, reflective glass panel, or background vignette connected to the same brand event mood.
6. Info/footer layer: place {태그·정보}, {SNS·문의}, {브랜드 정보}, {푸터 고지}, and {스폰서 영역} in the lower area as crisp campaign details, legible against the darker blue background.
7. Brand lockup: show {브랜드·제품명} as a clear product identity near the bottle label or lower-right lockup, matching the cold metallic beer campaign style.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the headline, with 72–96px scale feel; use Pretendard Medium or Noto Sans KR Regular for subcopy and event details at 24–36px feel.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}; use cold contrast between deep blue background, crisp white typography, ice-blue splash, metallic silver shadows, and selective gold accent highlights.
- Layout: follow {레이아웃}; make the poster feel like a finished outdoor campaign piece with real-world text hierarchy, event information, sponsor footer, and drink-responsibility notice.
- Border/shadow: use polished poster edges, soft shadow under bottle 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; add realistic glow on splash highlights, ice shards, condensation, and stage beams.
- Typography treatment: headline can include metallic beveling, frosty edge texture, cold vapor around strokes, and selective silver highlights while remaining sharply readable.
- Decorative system: use {장식 그래픽} as energetic supporting elements that wrap around the bottle and headline, with realistic reflections on glass and ice.
- Sponsor/footer styling: {스폰서 영역} should look like small printed partner marks, ticket partners, venue support labels, and event-operating notes, not as fake official certification seals.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Hasselblad X2D 100c with XCD 80mm f/2.8, ISO 100, f/4 commercial product-shot clarity; optional Sony A7R V with 50mm f/1.4 for lifestyle cut integration.
- Lighting: hard-soft studio key from upper-left at 45°, cool rim light from upper-right, controlled specular highlights on bottle glass, faint fill from front-center to preserve label readability.
- Color grade: cold night-blue base with silver-white highlights, restrained gold accents, and crisp contrast reminiscent of premium beer campaign photography.
- Texture realism: realistic glass thickness, wet label edges, condensation beads, melting ice, water splash refraction, printed poster ink sharpness, and believable night-event haze.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean beer campaign key visual with a nightclub-festival editorial energy, like a high-end Cass seasonal poster shot in a modern commercial studio and finished as a real event promotion poster for a summer night beer festival.

[7. CRITICAL]
- 한국어 문구 정확도: 포스터에 들어가는 핵심 문구는 깨지지 않게 선명하게 보여야 한다.
  - "오늘, 짜릿하게 / CASS하라"
  - "언제 어디서나 짜릿함이 필요한 순간 / 카스 하나면 충분하다!"
  - "COLD BREWED — 저온숙성으로 완성된 상쾌한 맛"
  - "CASS FRESH NIGHT SPLASH 2026"
  - "2026.07.18 SAT 19:30"
  - "한강 블루스테이지 · 여의도"
  - "얼리버드 ₩15,000 / 현장 ₩20,000"
  - "@cass_nightsplash  #오늘짜릿하게  #콜드브루드"
  - "20세 이상 / 책임음주 / 카스 fresh"
  - "CASS FRESH — 카스 프레시 (Cold Brewed)"
- Preserve photoreal commercial photography realism: natural skin texture, natural candid expressions, realistic condensation, realistic glass reflections, and believable printed ad typography.
- Bottle, splash, crowd silhouettes, event ribbon, sponsor footer, and lifestyle people must feel like a single coordinated campaign shoot.
- If people appear, hands and faces must be anatomically correct, with natural crowd proportions and no distorted fingers.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable celebrity likenesses
- Low-detail or cartoon-like beer bottle depiction

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Premium dark café advertisement poster for a luxury-brand coffee and dessert campaign, designed as a vertical A4 editorial poster with polished commercial photography, real printed-poster details, and persuasive in-store campaign information.
Suitable for premium café window display, counter standee reproduction, social media promo, seasonal dessert-pairing campaign visuals, and luxury coffee brand launch advertising.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: the hero still life sits in the center-lower 55% of the frame, while the headline block occupies the top 20% and the value-summary / campaign-information block anchors the bottom 18%.
- Background treatment: deep charcoal matte backdrop with a subtle gradient from near-black top-left to warm dark brown bottom-right, faint stone texture around the table area, and realistic café ambience such as soft reflected highlights, distant warm pendant-light glow, and a barely visible dark wood counter edge.
- Spacing and framing: build a premium editorial hierarchy with controlled breathing room, layered microcopy, date labels, ticket-style campaign information, and refined decorative lines so the poster feels like a real café promotion rather than a sterile mockup.
- Use {브랜드명}, {메인 한글 헤드라인}, {부카피}, {3대 가치}, {hero 비주얼}, {컬러 톤}, {레이아웃}, {인물·lifestyle 컷} exactly as the customizable campaign elements.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header zone: place {메인 한글 헤드라인} in a bold, elegant display arrangement near the upper center, with {브랜드명} aligned as the brand anchor above or near it; keep the headline visually dominant and poster-scale, supported by a small date label such as “2026 MAY CAMPAIGN” and “VOL.05 DESSERT PAIRING WEEK”.
2. Subcopy zone: position {부카피} directly below the headline in a smaller, clean sans-serif line, with refined letter spacing; add one short Korean feature blurb line nearby, for example “오늘의 커피와 디저트를 더 깊게 즐기는 시간”.
3. Hero still life zone: render {hero 비주얼} as the central product cluster on a round stone table, with the mug, latte glass, and chocolate cake forming a triangular composition; include realistic crema, condensation on glass, cake crumb detail, a dark ceramic saucer, a folded linen napkin, a small dessert fork, a tiny leafy branch, and a subtle logo detail for campaign realism.
4. Lifestyle connection zone: integrate {인물·lifestyle 컷} as a secondary editorial moment, either as a soft side panel, inset photo strip, or visually linked cutaway that feels like part of the same café campaign; show believable café gestures such as a hand holding a cup, a customer by a window, or a quiet table scene with warm reflections.
5. Campaign information zone: add a refined poster information strip with event details, using Korean text such as “기간 2026.05.01–05.31”, “장소 전국 프리미엄 매장”, “시간 매일 10:00–22:00”, and “디저트 페어링 세트 ₩7,500부터”; include a small coupon / ticket stub area reading “PAIRING TICKET” and a tiny QR-style square or barcode-like block for realism.
6. Value block zone: place {3대 가치} in a bottom gray-toned information box or structured panel, using compact spacing and clear hierarchy so each value reads like a premium feature line; add subtle divider rules, small numerals 01 / 02 / 03, and muted-gold icons or dots.
7. Layout system zone: follow {레이아웃} as the overall spatial blueprint, including the vertical English side line, dark top copy area, centered hero zone, lower structured value block, sponsor / store-info footer, and small credit text such as “Photo by Studio Seoul / Barista Selection”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the main headline, Pretendard Medium for subcopy, and a condensed sans-serif for the 3-value block; headline size should feel poster-scale, with tight but readable line spacing and crisp Korean glyph rendering.
- Color palette: apply {컬러 톤} with exact anchors like deep charcoal #1f1f1f, warm beige #e8dfca, muted gold #b8924a, espresso brown, cream foam white, and soft stone gray for the lower panel.
- Poster graphic details: include thin muted-gold rules, small typographic labels, date chips, ticket-like perforation marks, a refined sponsor / store-info footer, and subtle café menu-style dividers that enhance the luxury campaign without overpowering the food photography.
- Texture and material realism: show matte paper grain, stone table pores, ceramic glaze, glass rim highlights, chocolate ganache sheen, cake crumb texture, linen weave, and tiny coffee splashes or sugar dust where natural.
- Border/shadow: use a soft realistic drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, and 15% opacity under cups, glass, cake, fork, napkin, and table edges; use refined hairline framing and embedded print-poster details instead of flat boxed sticker graphics.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Hasselblad X2D 100c with XCD 80mm f/2.8 at ISO 100, f/4, or Sony A7R V with 50mm f/1.4 for the lifestyle component; maintain premium campaign-photography sharpness and natural depth.
- Lighting: soft studio key from upper-left at 45° with a subtle fill from right, plus gentle rim separation on glassware; for the lifestyle cut, use window light from the side with visible ambient café reflections, warm highlights on skin and cup rims, and natural shadow falloff.
- Color grade: deep espresso brown, warm beige, muted gold highlights, restrained contrast, slightly lifted shadows, and rich dark tonal separation that preserves detail while keeping a luxury café mood.
- Real-world finish: the final image should feel like a photographed premium printed poster displayed in a café or professionally composed for an advertising campaign, with believable scale, tactile surfaces, and readable promotional information.

[6. MOOD]
Premium café editorial campaign — feels like a Kinfolk-meets-Aesop product spread with high-end Seoul café advertising polish, dark luxury ambience, warm dessert-pairing comfort, and a real seasonal campaign poster presence.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “일상의 작은 쉼표, / 투썸 한 잔의 여유”, “바쁜 하루 속, 커피와 디저트가 전하는 나만의 편안한 순간”, “PREMIUM COFFEE — 최상급 원두로 완성한 깊고 풍부한 풍미”, “DELICIOUS DESSERT — 신선한 재료로 정성껏 만든 다양한 디저트”, “COMFORTABLE SPACE — 편안한 분위기 속에서 온전한 나만의 시간”, “A TWOSOME PLACE — Coffee & Dessert”.
- Additional Korean poster microcopy should be clear and realistic: “2026 MAY CAMPAIGN”, “기간 2026.05.01–05.31”, “장소 전국 프리미엄 매장”, “시간 매일 10:00–22:00”, “디저트 페어링 세트 ₩7,500부터”, “PAIRING TICKET”, “Photo by Studio Seoul”, and “Barista Selection”.
- All food, glassware, tableware, printed text, QR-style blocks, and lifestyle elements must look physically plausible; if hands appear, fingers must be natural and complete.
- Preserve a true premium café campaign hierarchy: brand, headline, subcopy, hero products, lifestyle connection, campaign details, value block, and footer information.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Photoreal soda advertising poster for a lemon-lime soft drink, vertical A4-style layout with bold headline column and dynamic product hero.
Built for a real print-style campaign key visual, convenience-store display poster, and social-shareable ad poster, with a crisp refreshment-first look and believable retail advertising details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster orientation: A4 portrait, using {레이아웃}: a strong left text column occupying about 38% of the frame and the hero product visual dominating the right 62%.
- Main subject: {브랜드·제품명} positioned as the central hero, with a transparent glass, lime slices, ice, and a large PET bottle arranged in a layered diagonal flow.
- Background treatment: white-to-cool-mint studio backdrop with subtle moisture haze, real condensation textures, faint citrus pulp specks, tiny air bubbles, and soft reflected highlights on a glossy acrylic surface.
- Motion and spacing: dynamic splash arcs radiate upward and slightly toward the upper-right, with droplets, lime wedges, crushed ice pieces, and chilled mist surrounding the product while the headline remains readable.
- Poster information layer: include believable campaign details such as a small date label, promo period, QR/barcode area, retail availability line, sponsor/partner strip, and fine-print credit text in the footer.
- Optional lifestyle support visual: {인물·lifestyle 컷} integrated as a smaller campaign cut or soft secondary panel showing a candid summer refreshment moment, keeping the main product hero dominant.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Left text column: set the headline stack at the upper-left with strong visual hierarchy; place {메인 헤드라인 (영문)} in a large bold sans-serif, and place {한글 부카피} directly below in smaller but still prominent Korean copy.
2. Campaign label area: above or beside the headline, add small Korean retail-ad details such as "SUMMER DROP 2026", "2026.05.01–06.30", "전국 편의점 동시 출시", and "한정 청량 캠페인" in compact type.
3. Feature block: arrange {3 특징} as three compact callout lines below the subcopy, each line paired with a small lime slice icon, water-drop bullet, or thin aqua divider so it feels like a finished beverage advertisement.
4. Hero product zone: position {hero 비주얼} in the right half with the glass slightly in front of the bottle, lime slices catching highlights, ice cubes visible through the liquid, carbonation bubbles rising, and splash droplets frozen sharply for energy.
5. Brand labels: anchor {브랜드 라벨} near the lower corners with a believable print-ad finish; include a left brand logo lockup and a right hashtag/QR area as if this poster is ready for store display.
6. Retail footer: add a slim footer band with tiny but legible Korean details: "전국 편의점 · 대형마트 · 온라인몰", "권장소비자가 500ml ₩2,000", "문의 080-123-4567", "제품 이미지는 연출 컷입니다", plus a small barcode/QR-style block.
7. Lifestyle integration: if used, embed {인물·lifestyle 컷} as a small supporting image strip, rounded photo inset, or sticker-like panel labeled "오늘의 청량 루틴" that suggests summer refreshment without overpowering the main product.
8. Final balance: let the white and cool-mint field feel icy and spacious, with green accents concentrated around the product, splash, headline, campaign labels, footer details, and decorative citrus graphics.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Helvetica Neue Condensed Bold for {메인 헤드라인 (영문)}, and Noto Sans KR Bold for {한글 부카피} and {3 특징}; headline size should feel oversized and ad-like, with the Korean copy in a clean 1/3 to 1/4 of the headline scale.
- Supporting typography: use Noto Sans KR Medium/Regular for promo period, availability line, footer, QR label, and fine print; make the microcopy believable but subordinate to the headline and product hero.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} with crisp white #FFFFFF, cool aqua highlights, vivid green #009639, and small lemon-lime accents; keep black text controlled and preserve detail in the greens.
- Graphic elements: include lime-tinted translucent panels, thin aqua rule lines, small droplet icons, subtle citrus rings, and a realistic QR/barcode block to make the poster feel printed and campaign-ready.
- Shadow and surface: use a soft drop shadow under the glass and bottle, roughly 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity, plus realistic reflected highlights, wet tabletop glints, and tiny condensation beads.
- Print finish: emulate a glossy beverage poster with sharp product edges, fine halftone-free gradients, rich ink density, and clean studio contrast.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Hasselblad X2D 100c with XCD 80mm f/2.8 at ISO 100, f/4, studio commercial product photography framing.
- Lighting: bright softbox key from upper-left at 45°, cool fill from front-right, and a thin rim light from behind to outline the bottle, glass, and splash droplets.
- Color grade: clean cool white balanced against vivid green #009639 and lime-yellow accents, with slightly chilled cyan shadows and crisp specular highlights.
- Rendering feel: photoreal advertising campaign scan, with realistic condensation, liquid transparency, carbonation bubbles, ice refraction, PET bottle plastic, and splash physics that look captured in-camera rather than generated.
- Material detail: bottle label should have glossy ink, slight curvature, tiny edge highlights, natural shrink-wrap tension, and visible droplets; the glass should show thickness, refraction, and cold fogging near the rim.

[6. MOOD]
Premium beverage campaign key visual with a Nike-style energy level and a bright Korean summer convenience-store advertising feel, tuned for a fresh lemon-lime soda launch poster that feels lively, cold, and commercially real.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열 — "투명하게 상쾌하게, 스프라이트처럼!", "CLEAR & CLEAN — 더 깨끗하고 투명한 레몬 라임의 상쾌함", "NATURAL FLAVOR — 자연에서 온 향으로 더 산뜻하게", "COOL & REFRESHING — 톡 쏘는 청량감으로 기분까지 시원하게", "좌하단 Sprite 로고 + Obey Your Thirst 슬로건", "우하단 #스프라이트 #청량하게 #ObeyYourThirst".
- Additional small Korean poster text should read naturally and accurately: "SUMMER DROP 2026", "2026.05.01–06.30", "전국 편의점 동시 출시", "권장소비자가 500ml ₩2,000", "제품 이미지는 연출 컷입니다", "QR로 청량 이벤트 참여".
- Layout invariant: the product hero must remain on the right side and the main text column on the left side, with the splash staying dynamic but not covering the headline.
- Photorealism invariant: skin, liquid, bottle plastic, ice, glass refraction, label printing, condensation, and droplets must all look physically believable, with no CGI sheen or fake compositing look.
- If the lifestyle cut is included, the people must look candid and naturally lit, not posed like a studio fashion shot.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters or jamo breakup
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likenesses in the lifestyle cut

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean low-cost coffee brand advertising poster, vertically structured A4-style campaign sheet for social feed, counter display, window posting, and in-store menu promotion.
Photoreal commercial poster that sells value, size, cold refreshment, and everyday accessibility with a bold MEGA concept, enriched with realistic franchise-ad details such as promo dates, store information, menu snippets, small legal copy, QR/app order callout, and campaign micro-labels.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster format: tall vertical sheet with a left-branding column and right hero-product column, using {레이아웃} as the base structure.
- The top-left area carries {브랜드명·로고} as a compact logo lockup, while the main headline occupies the upper-left 22% of the frame with a real franchise-poster masthead feel.
- The center-left column stacks the headline, handwritten subcopy, the three value statements, a short seasonal promo label, and a compact menu/pricelist strip with tight editorial rhythm and clear hierarchy.
- The right half is reserved for {hero 음료}, shown as the main visual anchor with crisp product edges, realistic condensation, visible ice geometry, meniscus line, cup lid detail, and natural reflections on the transparent cup.
- The lower band contains {가격·태그} with a strong promo block, QR-style app/order callout, ticket-like coupon detail, and small store/contact information aligned to the bottom-right.
- Include a small supporting lifestyle cut based on {인물·lifestyle 컷}, integrated as a secondary campaign image with a realistic photo-card border, tiny caption, date/location label, and natural storefront atmosphere.
- Use {컬러 톤} as the core background split and accent system, with subtle paper grain, printed poster texture, coffee splash marks, ice-cube accents, hand-drawn marker strokes, and small menu-divider graphics that feel appropriate for a real coffee chain advertisement.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Brand zone: Place {브랜드명·로고} at the upper-left in a compact commercial logo treatment, sized to feel like a real coffee-chain poster masthead. Add tiny campaign metadata nearby: "SUMMER VALUE CAMPAIGN", "VOL.247", "2026.05", and a short branch line such as "전국 매장 동시 진행".
2. Main headline zone: Set {메인 헤드라인} beneath the logo in a rough stencil-style English headline with hand-marked emphasis on the word “size,” using a yellow marker effect. Add a small Korean kicker above or beside it: "오늘도 크게, 부담은 작게".
3. Handwritten message zone: Add {손글씨 부카피} under the headline in casual handwritten Korean, with the fine-print line rendered small but fully legible. Include small annotation arrows and a marker underline that point toward the hero drink.
4. Value list zone: Stack {3대 가치} as three short editorial rows, each with the MEGA term leading and the explanatory Korean sentence following it. Use small icons or badges for size, price, and taste, plus tiny separators like "01", "02", "03".
5. Hero product zone: Show {hero 음료} on the right side as a photoreal commercial drink shot, with transparent cup material, ice detail, cold condensation, realistic logo print placement, straw/lid detail if appropriate, and a subtle contact shadow on the poster surface. Add a small flavor note tag near the cup: "2 SHOT", "ICED", "DAILY PICK".
6. Lifestyle support zone: Insert {인물·lifestyle 컷} as a natural supplemental image or connected secondary visual, keeping the same campaign lighting and camera realism. Frame it like a small printed campaign snapshot with caption text: "출근길 한 잔", "서울 성수점 앞", "2026.05.01 08:42".
7. Promo / price zone: Place {가격·태그} in the lower-right area with a strong price emphasis, QR-style square, and a short utility line. Add realistic order details: "APP ORDER", "매장 픽업 가능", "쿠폰은 결제 전 제시", and a tiny barcode-like strip.
8. Background / balance zone: Use a split-field poster background from {컬러 톤}, with the left side calmer and the right side more saturated. Add tactile realism through printed paper fibers, mild fold impression near the lower third, small coffee-ring texture, tiny dotted grid accents, and practical in-store poster details such as a small footer address line: "서울시 강남구 테헤란로 123 · 고객센터 1588-0000".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use bold stencil-style English for the main headline, Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean body lines, and a handwritten brush style for the subcopy; headline weight should feel heavy and poster-like, body text medium to semibold, small print crisp and readable.
- Color palette: cream ivory #f5ebd6, mustard yellow #fdc433, black #1a1a1a, with subtle warm off-white and muted coffee-brown accents; keep strong contrast for legibility.
- Border/shadow: use realistic editorial shadows, soft product drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity, small inset shadows around coupon/QR blocks, and natural printed-poster depth where paper overlaps photo-card or label elements.
- Add believable commercial-poster details: small campaign labels, dotted dividers, coupon perforation marks, simple illustrated ice cubes, marker strokes, menu tabs, app-order micro icons, and a compact price/menu strip without changing the provided main copy.
- Include a secondary mini menu/pricelist area with realistic Korean text, for example: "카페라떼 2,900원", "바닐라라떼 3,400원", "아이스티 2,000원", "디저트 세트 +1,500원"; keep it subordinate to the required hero price.
- Maintain a polished Korean franchise advertising look, practical and approachable rather than luxury; every graphic element should support the value-forward coffee campaign.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Hasselblad X2D 100c with XCD 80mm f/2.8 for the hero drink, or Sony A7R V with 50mm f/1.4 for the lifestyle support image; shoot with commercial advertising precision and shallow-but-real depth.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light from upper-left at roughly 45°, gentle fill from the right, and a subtle rim highlight on the cup edge; lifestyle cut should feel like natural storefront daylight or overcast outdoor light.
- Color grade: warm cream + mustard + black with realistic coffee browns and cool ice highlights, avoiding HDR punch and avoiding oversaturated neon tones.
- Image rendering should feel like a photographed and printed real campaign poster with believable ink, paper texture, product photography, and in-store promotional design details, not an illustration or CG composite.

[6. MOOD]
Mainstream Korean coffee-chain campaign — practical, value-forward brand poster with the energetic commercial realism of a real franchise advertisement: bold price appeal, iced coffee refreshment, everyday commute mood, and friendly neighborhood-store accessibility.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구 — "일상에 메가*", "행복에 메가*", "*MEGA가 일상을 더 크고 행복하게 합니다", "MEGA SIZE", "MEGA PRICE", "MEGA TASTE", "BIG SIZE 2 SHOT", "아메리카노(ICED) 1,500원", "메가의 메뉴가 궁금하다면?"
- Additional small Korean poster text may appear and must be sharp: "오늘도 크게, 부담은 작게", "전국 매장 동시 진행", "출근길 한 잔", "서울 성수점 앞", "APP ORDER", "매장 픽업 가능", "카페라떼 2,900원", "바닐라라떼 3,400원".
- Keep all Korean and English text sharp, correctly spaced, and free of broken characters or jamo errors.
- The hero drink must remain a realistic transparent cup with ice and condensation, not a stylized illustration.
- The lifestyle person(s) must look candid and natural, with photoreal skin texture and no camera-aware posing.
- Layout must preserve a strong left-text / right-product hierarchy with a lower price strip, QR area, promo/date/store footer, and compact menu details.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters, jamo breakup, or font fallback artifacts
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
YouTube live broadcast screen mockup for a Korean creator, designed as a realistic livestream interface with subscriber count, likes, superchat, pinned comment, playback controls, and fast live chat.
Landscape UI screenshot style for social media mockup, with the video area on the left, live chat panel on the right, and recognizable platform-style header/navigation details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left video pane occupies about 62% of the frame, showing {원본 보존} as the live camera feed with realistic webcam sharpness, slight stream compression, and a natural creator-room or café-live atmosphere.
- Right sidebar occupies about 38% of the frame, with white chat background, stacked chat rows, circular user avatars, timestamps, emoji reactions, donation highlights, and compact live-status elements.
- Top channel header bar spans full width, with {채널명·구독자}, {채널 핸들}, and {방송 제목} aligned like a real YouTube live page.
- Use {비율} composition exactly, with platform-like spacing, visible scroll bar, search/profile micro-icons, and desktop browser/screen-capture proportions.
- Place {동시 시청자} near the red LIVE indicator area, and position {슈퍼챗} as a highlighted yellow superchat banner above the chat stream.
- Add {구독 버튼} and {멤버십 버튼} near the channel header, plus {고정 댓글} as a pinned message strip above the chat.
- Let {실시간 채팅} and {추가 채팅} scroll vertically in the right panel with tight active-stream spacing, small avatars, usernames, emoji, and short Korean replies.
- Include {상단 네비게이션}, {재생 컨트롤}, {채팅 입력 안내}, and {후원 티커} so the interface reads like a captured live broadcast page rather than a blank template.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header zone: place {상단 네비게이션} at the very top with search and account micro-icons, then place {채널명·구독자} on the upper-left, {채널 핸들} nearby, {방송 제목} immediately beneath it in a bold live-title style, and a red LIVE badge near the status area.
2) Main video zone: show {원본 보존} inside the left pane as an authentic live-stream camera feed, with subtle screen-edge sharpening, realistic bitrate artifacts in darker areas, and natural skin-tone preservation.
3) Live stats overlay: display {동시 시청자} near the top or upper-right of the video pane, with small white UI text, eye/like icons, and a compact red live-status dot.
4) Creator action row: render {구독 버튼} as a red rounded button and {멤버십 버튼} as a secondary pill button beside the channel information, with small bell/share/clip icons nearby.
5) Superchat highlight: render {슈퍼챗} as a yellow banner floating above the chat stream, with sender avatar, donation amount, and message line matching typical livestream emphasis styling.
6) Pinned and live chat panel: stack {고정 댓글}, {실시간 채팅}, and {추가 채팅} in the right column with alternating short messages, username colors, small timestamps, emoji hearts, and a visible chat scroll bar.
7) Bottom playback layer: include {재생 컨트롤} under the video pane, with a red progress/live line, volume icon, settings gear, captions icon, theater/fullscreen icons, and a tiny “LIVE” timeline marker.
8) Interaction footer: show {채팅 입력 안내} at the bottom of the chat panel with a message input field, emoji icon, send icon, and moderation microtext.
9) UI realism layer: include faint separators, timestamp-like microtext, notification dots, subtle compression on the video pane, and consistent platform spacing so the whole layout reads as an authentic YouTube livestream screenshot.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean UI text, medium and bold weights, with 14–18px equivalent header scale, 12–14px chat scale, and 10–11px micro-label scale.
- Color palette: YouTube-like red #FF0000 for LIVE accents and subscribe button, white #FFFFFF for main UI, soft gray #F1F3F4 for dividers, dark gray #1F1F1F for text, yellow #FFD54A for superchat highlight, pale blue #E8F0FE for pinned chat accent.
- UI treatment: thin 1px separators, subtle 6px blur shadow under floating overlays, low-contrast panel edges, native rounded buttons, visible chat row density, and crisp desktop screenshot alignment.
- Text rendering: all Korean UI strings must be legible, correctly spaced, and horizontally aligned as interface text, not warped signage.
- Use platform-realistic elements such as avatar circles, verified-style small check icon if suitable, thumbs-up icon, bell icon, share arrow, live-dot animation marks, and donation color blocks.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: emulate a desktop screen capture with a 35mm-equivalent digital UI render, crisp flat perspective, no exaggerated depth.
- Lighting: neutral studio-bright screen glow with evenly lit UI, natural monitor cast, and slight soft bloom on the red LIVE badge and donation highlight.
- Color grade: clean white-and-red platform UI with natural skin tones in the video pane, slight cool-neutral monitor cast, realistic livestream contrast, and believable compression on fast-moving chat/video regions.
- Interface fidelity: render the page as if captured from a modern desktop browser at 1536x1024, with accurate proportions, icons, scroll indicators, and readable Korean text layers.

[6. MOOD]
Real YouTube livestream screenshot realism — polished creator broadcast interface like a modern Korean beauty or lifestyle live Q&A stream, lively with viewer reactions, superchat energy, and active community presence.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as rendered strings: "혜민 Hyemin · 구독자 124K", "@hyemin_daily", "라이브 — 같이 카페 가요 ☕️ Q&A", "동시 시청 8.2K · 좋아요 3.4K", "구독", "가입", "민지 ₩5,000 — 언니 사랑해요!", "📌 혜민: 질문은 채팅에 남겨주세요!", "안녕하세요", "오늘 의상 너무 예뻐요", "질문 있어요!", "카페 어디예요?", "하트 눌렀어요 💕", "다음 콘텐츠 스포해주세요", "채팅에 참여하려면 메시지를 입력하세요".
- Keep the live layout structurally accurate: left video pane, right chat column, top navigation, red LIVE badge, visible subscriber count, handle, live stats, subscribe/join buttons, superchat banner, pinned message, playback controls, and scrolling chat.
- Preserve the provided person image faithfully in the video pane without distorting facial features or proportions.
- Maintain 1536x1024 landscape screenshot readability, with Korean UI text large enough to recognize and dense enough to feel like an active live broadcast.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header strip: render a platform-like live status row with the BJ name {BJ 닉네임} on the left, a red LIVE pill, channel profile circle, favorite/star button, compact live indicators, share/settings icons, and thin divider lines aligned like a desktop web player.

6) Chat column: render {채팅} as a fast-scrolling vertical chat feed on the right, with repeated short Korean lines, colored nickname labels, small avatar dots, subscriber badges, emoji reactions, gift icons, and a visible chat input field at the bottom.
7) Side information panels: include {채널 공지} as a pinned notice near the top of the chat area, {후원 랭킹} as a compact ranking card with 1–3 rows, and a small floating mini-tooltip such as “즐겨찾기 추가” or “클립 만들기”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for UI text, with bold 700 for title and semibold 600 for labels; keep font sizes compact and screen-readable, around 18–28px equivalent for desktop UI, with smaller 13–16px equivalents for metadata and chat.
- Color palette: deep charcoal #15171C, near-black #0B0D10, accent red #E53935, orange #FF8A00, alert yellow #FFD54A, white #F5F7FA, muted gray #8A9099, and occasional cyan/green badge accents for chat roles.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px separators, soft panel shadow 0px 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), slight inner glow on active live elements, crisp rectangular UI modules, and readable contrast across all Korean text.
- Interface density: include realistic livestream clutter such as badges, icons, chat bubbles, ranking rows, pinned notice, donation count, and control buttons while keeping the layout aligned to a believable desktop grid.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic desktop screen-capture composition with a 50mm equivalent perspective, clean UI capture feel, stable straight-on monitor framing, and accurate flat-panel alignment.
- Lighting: if the subject is visible as a camera feed, use soft front-facing webcam light with gentle monitor glow from below and faint ambient room shadow, keeping the interface itself flat, sharp, and legible.
- Color grade: dark UI neutral grade with red/orange platform accents, preserving natural skin tones in the video feed while keeping the interface cool, high-contrast, and immediately recognizable as a Korean live broadcast environment.
- Rendering quality: crisp 1536x1024 UI screenshot fidelity, readable Korean labels, sharp icon edges, realistic compression-free capture look, and subtle variation in chat line opacity to imply motion.

[6. MOOD]
Authentic Korean livestream platform screenshot — like a real SOOP 방송 화면 captured mid-stream during an active 먹방/소통 session, with practical creator-dashboard density, lively viewer reactions, donation energy, and believable real-time UI activity.

- Chat text must include readable Korean lines based on {채팅}, such as “안녕하세요”, “오늘도 잘부탁”, “떡볶이 비주얼 미쳤다”, “별풍선 받았어요”, “ㅋㅋㅋㅋ”, “소스 어디 거예요?”.
- Preserve a believable SOOP-like live interface layout with correct 1536x1024 screen proportions, left video/right chat structure, desktop web-player spacing, and readable Korean text.
- The subject in the live video feed must remain based on {원본 보존} and should not be replaced by a different person.

[1. PURPOSE]
Instagram-style selfie feed post mockup for social media presentation, designed to look like a believable real app screenshot captured from a modern phone. Vertical 4:5-like mobile feed composition that preserves the source selfie while adding account identity, likes, caption, hashtags, comments, micro UI icons, timestamp, location, and small realistic interaction details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main post area: {원본 보존} fills the central feed image region, cropped naturally like a real uploaded selfie with authentic phone-camera proportions and everyday lifestyle context visible from the reference image.
- Top account row: {아이디·프로필} placed at the upper-left of the post card, with a small circular avatar, compact username line, subtle verification-like dot only if it reads as a generic UI accent, and a three-dot menu icon on the right.
- Location and meta row: add a small Korean location label under the handle such as “서울 마포구 연남동” or “홍대입구 근처 카페”, plus a tiny “방금 전” / “2026.05.01” style timestamp treatment in muted gray.
- Interaction row: heart, comment bubble, paper-plane/share, and bookmark/save icons aligned in a familiar Instagram-style row beneath the image, with consistent spacing, thin line weight, and tiny tap-target realism.
- Text blocks: {좋아요 수}, {캡션}, {해시태그}, and {댓글} stacked vertically with clear hierarchy, realistic line breaks, username bolding, muted metadata, and natural app padding.
- Social micro details: include a small “저장됨” style bookmark hint, carousel-style dot indicator if appropriate, tiny “공유” / “보내기” affordance feel, and a light-gray input hint at the bottom such as “댓글 달기...” with a small emoji button.
- Background treatment: clean white app canvas with subtle light-gray separators, faint card depth, visible status-bar area, and realistic mobile screenshot spacing.
- Frame behavior: all UI elements should stay inside a single tall mobile feed card, sized like a phone screenshot, with app navigation hints at top and bottom that reinforce the feed context.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Status/navigation section: very top includes small phone status-bar details and an Instagram-like header strip with “Instagram” wordmark-style text, a notification heart icon, and message icon, rendered as generic app UI elements.
- Profile header section: {아이디·프로필} displayed immediately above the image area in standard app-post header placement, with a small profile circle, compact handle text, location line, and right-side menu dots.
- Hero image section (top 58%): {원본 보존} shown as the main Instagram photo, centered and edge-to-edge within the post card, preserving the natural selfie look and retaining believable background texture from the original image.
- Image overlay realism: add a tiny carousel/page dot or subtle media indicator only if it fits the feed screenshot, keeping it small and app-native rather than poster-like.
- Engagement section: icon row directly below the image, then {좋아요 수} in bold text, followed by {캡션} in one or two realistic app lines with the account handle emphasized.
- Hashtag section: {해시태그} appended under the caption in muted blue/link-like styling, separated by subtle spacing as in a real feed post.
- Comment section: {댓글} placed below the caption/hashtags block, with smaller secondary text, short Korean replies, and a “댓글 28개 모두 보기” style link treatment inside the provided copy.
- Bottom app area: include a small “댓글 달기...” field, emoji shortcut, timestamp such as “1시간 전”, and a faint bottom navigation bar with home/search/reels/profile icons.
- UI realism pass: {화면 톤} must govern every icon, divider, text color, avatar treatment, spacing decision, and screenshot clarity so the final image reads as an authentic Instagram feed post.
- Canvas finish: {비율} kept as a tall mobile-screen mockup with believable app chrome, subtle screen edges, and crisp high-resolution UI rendering.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the UI text, 400–600 weight, 18–26 px for body lines, 28–34 px for key counts, and 14–18 px for comments/meta; username and like count should appear slightly bolder.
- Color palette: pure white #FFFFFF, near-black #111111, Instagram-like neutral gray #8E8E8E, separator gray #DBDBDB, soft icon gray #262626, muted link blue #385898 or #00376B for hashtags and comment links.
- Border/shadow: subtle phone-screen card depth, soft gray edge separation, and light UI dividers that feel like a real screenshot captured on a modern device.
- UI density: include realistic app-level detail such as small icon alignment, line-height consistency, avatar ring edge, bottom nav icons, timestamp, location line, and comment input microcopy.
- Korean rendering: all visible Korean text must be sharp, correctly spaced, and natural for an everyday Instagram post rather than advertising copy.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: phone-camera selfie look, 26mm-equivalent smartphone lens, f/1.8 aesthetic, realistic social-app upload sharpness rather than studio portrait polish.
- Lighting: natural window light from upper-left at about 45°, soft fill from front, minimal hard shadowing, realistic indoor daylight balance.
- Color grade: clean neutral whites with slightly warm skin tones, modest contrast, and app-screenshot clarity with no heavy filters.
- Screen realism: crisp 1024x1536 mobile screenshot feel, high-DPI UI edges, slight compression realism in the photo area, and accurate contrast between photo content and app interface.

[6. MOOD]
Casual social-media documentation — modern Instagram feed screenshot aesthetic with the crisp, functional feel of an everyday lifestyle post, enriched with believable interaction details, Korean captioning, and natural mobile-app atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "좋아요 3,247개 + 친구3 외 다수", "오늘은 그냥 카페 데이☕️ 햇살이 너무 좋아서", "#일상 #카페 #홍대 #햇살 #데일리 #ootd", "@friend1 \"언니 너무 예뻐요!\" / @friend2 \"여기 어디?\" / 댓글 28개 모두 보기".

- The layout must read as a real Instagram feed post screenshot, with correct icon order, realistic spacing, status/header/bottom navigation hints, and no broken Korean characters.
- Preserve the source selfie naturally without over-stylized filters, artificial bokeh spam, or mismatched UI components.
- Keep {아이디·프로필}, {좋아요 수}, {캡션}, {해시태그}, {댓글}, {화면 톤}, and {비율} visually represented as the controlling content fields.

- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
1-2 English lines: Instagram Live screen mockup using the provided portrait as the live host, designed to look like an authentic mobile screenshot captured during an active livestream.
Concrete: vertical 9:16 live interface recreation with real Instagram-style UI, profile identity, viewer count, live badge, scrolling comments, reaction hearts, share icons, bottom reply field, small interaction stickers, and a believable selfie environment.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {원본 보존} portrait fills the center 62% of the frame, with the face and upper torso visible behind the live UI overlay; keep the subject looking directly at camera with a slight smile and natural live-video posture.
- Background treatment: {장면} with a realistic indoor setting such as a bedroom desk, cafe corner, studio nook, or evening room; include believable details like a lamp glow, plant silhouette, shelf, mug, cushion, window reflection, or soft wall decor while keeping the host readable.
- Spacing and framing: preserve a true smartphone screenshot framing with no tilted perspective; UI should wrap naturally around the portrait, with top status/header content, side reaction controls, and bottom chat/reply elements layered like a native live broadcast.
- Add small screen-realism details: faint compression texture, subtle front-camera grain, tiny status-bar indicators, touch-safe icon spacing, translucent chat bubbles, floating heart reactions, and a few viewer join notifications.
- Use {아이디·이름}, {시청자 수}, {라이브 라벨}, {실시간 댓글}, {장면}, {화면 톤}, {비율} as customizable placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top status bar: include a realistic phone status row with time, cellular/Wi‑Fi indicators, and battery icon in tiny white UI text, integrated into the live screenshot.
- Top-left header area: render {라이브 라벨} as a realistic Instagram Live badge cluster, aligned close to the screen edge with small padding and crisp UI proportions; include the visible label LIVE in a vivid red rounded pill.
- Upper identity line: place {아이디·이름} beneath or beside the live badge in compact white UI text, with a tiny circular profile thumbnail, subtle dot separator, and a follow-style micro label such as 팔로우.
- Main video area: {원본 보존} portrait stays centered in the live feed, with natural skin tones, believable front-camera perspective, intact hair/shoulders/hands, and clean blending against translucent UI overlays.
- Viewer indicator zone: place {시청자 수} near the upper area with subtle white text and tiny eye/person icon treatment, sized smaller than the name line; add a small line like 함께 시청 중 or 방금 입장 to increase livestream realism.
- Top-right control area: include a close X at top-right, plus small three-dot/options or share-style icon spacing that feels native to the app.
- Comment feed zone: stack {실시간 댓글} from lower-left toward mid-lower screen, each comment separated like a live chat overlay and gently rising upward in chronological order; mix in 4–6 short Korean comments such as 안녕하세요!, 언니 너무 예뻐요, 오늘 방송 짱, 하트 누르고 가요, 어디 카페예요?, 조명 너무 예뻐요.
- Viewer activity layer: add small translucent notifications such as minji_22님이 참여했습니다, seoul_daily님이 하트를 보냈습니다, and 친구에게 공유해보세요, positioned above the reply bar without blocking the face.
- Bottom interaction bar: include a rounded comment input field reading 댓글 달기..., a question/request button such as 질문하기, paper-plane share icon, heart icon, and small circular reaction buttons.
- Floating reactions: place several pink/red/purple heart bubbles rising along the right edge, varied in opacity and size, with a few overlapping softly like a real livestream reaction stream.
- Background scene zone: {장면} should read as a real-time selfie environment with casual domestic, studio, or cafe context and small lived-in details that make the broadcast feel current and spontaneous.
- UI authenticity layer: {화면 톤} must be applied consistently across all icons, gradients, live badge, translucent overlays, and text so the result feels like a genuine app capture, not an edited poster.
- Format layer: {비율} must be preserved exactly as a tall phone screenshot with full-screen mobile UI coverage.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a clean mobile UI sans style similar to SF Pro / Helvetica Neue / Noto Sans KR, regular to medium weight, with small 11–18px sized interface text, compact tracking, and crisp anti-aliased Korean glyphs.
- Color palette: true Instagram-like black overlay gradient, pure white text #FFFFFF, vivid red live badge #FF3040, soft gray UI accents #C8C8CC, translucent charcoal chat bubbles, and subtle signature gradient hues inspired by the app’s pink-orange-purple spectrum.
- UI depth: use native-feeling 1–2px edge contrast, translucent dark gradient wash near the top and bottom for legibility, soft glassy comment bubble opacity, and natural screen glow rather than poster-like drop shadows.
- Details: include micro icons, reaction hearts, tiny profile circles, notification pills, status-bar marks, and slight live-stream compression artifacts to make the image feel captured from an active phone screen.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: smartphone front-camera look, equivalent to a 26–28mm full-frame wide selfie perspective at f/2.0–f/2.8, front-facing capture, slight facial perspective flattening typical of live video.
- Lighting: indoor ambient light with soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from the screen glow on the face, no harsh flash and no dramatic studio setup.
- Color grade: natural skin tones with slightly cool-neutral live-stream processing, black UI overlay, white text, red live badge, soft pink/purple heart accents, and restrained saturation to mimic a real Instagram live screenshot.

[6. MOOD]
Real-time social media capture — authentic Instagram mobile UI screenshot with a casual creator livestream feel, warm audience interaction, visible comments and reactions, and the spontaneity of a lifestyle influencer live session.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as written: "LIVE", "안녕하세요!", "언니 너무 예뻐요", "오늘 방송 짱", "하트 누르고 가요".
- Additional Korean UI text should be short and native-looking, such as "댓글 달기...", "질문하기", "님이 참여했습니다", "공유", "함께 시청 중", "어디 카페예요?", "조명 너무 예뻐요".
- Layout invariants: portrait subject remains fully identifiable behind the interface; comments must scroll upward from the bottom; live badge must sit top-left; the close X must appear top-right; heart count and floating heart reactions must be visible and feel native to a real livestream UI.
- Screen realism: the result must read as a genuine Instagram live screenshot, not an illustration or editorial poster; keep the vertical 1024x1536 phone-screen composition and the {비율} framing.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness changes
