studio:prompts3:ours-311.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Magazine-style i2i composition that places the attached photo as the main spread image and adds reader-like handwritten margin notes, editorial labels, issue metadata, and realistic printed-page details.
Built for Instagram, blog posts, and diary-style scrapbook use with a premium magazine-paper layout that feels collected, annotated, and lived-in.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the photo from {원본 보존} as the main magazine image, occupying about 62% of the canvas height, embedded into a vertical 1024x1536 editorial page with tactile paper margins, small print labels, and annotation marks.
- Use a refined magazine page structure: main image anchored slightly left-of-center, reader notes distributed on the right and lower margins, with a top masthead strip and lower editorial footer details for a real magazine tear-sheet feel.
- Keep the background as warm off-white magazine paper (#F4F0E6) with subtle print fiber, faint handling marks, light ink absorption, and natural page shadow; avoid making it look like a flat sterile mockup.
- Place {여백 손글씨} in the paper margins using {손글씨 톤}, and position {표시 doodle} near visually important parts of the photo as if a reader circled, underlined, or pointed to them while reading.
- Use {잡지 톤} as the overall page direction so the image reads like a high-end lifestyle magazine spread with personal marginalia rather than a poster.
- Apply {컬러 톤} consistently across paper, printed headings, annotation ink, and the preserved photo so the whole page feels like one photographed magazine artifact.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main photo block: show {원본 보존} cleanly embedded on the page with straight crop edges, like a real magazine print inset, preserving the original photo realism and keeping the key subject unobstructed.
2. Magazine identity layer: add a refined masthead and issue metadata around the image, including short Korean editorial text such as "LIFE NOTES", "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", "서울 에디션", and a small price label "₩7,500".
3. Feature headline layer: include 2-3 short Korean magazine blurbs in balanced serif/sans typography, for example "나다운 선택이 가장 좋은 답", "오늘의 장면을 오래 기억하는 법", and "취향이 머무는 오후"; keep them readable and secondary to the photo.
4. Margin handwriting layer: add {여백 손글씨} in several free-form locations around the photo, varying size, pressure, and tilt slightly so it feels handwritten directly in the margins rather than typeset.
5. Doodle annotation layer: place {표시 doodle} around select subject areas, using small red or blue ink circles, check marks, arrows, stars, underlines, and bracket marks with thin casual strokes.
6. Real magazine details: include a small barcode area at the lower outside edge, tiny spine/credit text along one side such as "PHOTO DIARY / MAY ISSUE / PRINTED IN SEOUL", a model-name credit line such as "모델 크레딧: 민서", and a small photo caption below the image.
7. Editorial text balance: keep the attached photo as the visual anchor while surrounding it with authentic magazine microtext, footer numbering like "p. 041", section marker "STYLE / NOTE", and handwritten reader reactions in the margins.
8. Print realism pass: add slight paper grain, mild ink absorption, gentle off-register alignment in tiny printed text, faint page crease or scan shadow, and realistic pen texture while keeping all important Korean text crisp and readable.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: main magazine headings in Vogue-like Didot or Noto Serif KR, body-style accents in Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, handwritten notes in marker-pen, gel pen, or pencil style with a slightly rough edge matching {손글씨 톤}.
- Color palette: off-white paper #F4F0E6, black ink #1A1A1A, red annotation #D94B45, blue annotation #2F62B8, subtle gray print shadows #B9B2A8, harmonized through {컬러 톤}.
- Border/shadow: use a very soft paper shadow, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 12% opacity, to separate the inset image from the page; allow natural printed dividers, fine rules, crop marks, barcode lines, and editorial footer elements.
- Handwritten elements should look human: uneven baseline, varied pen pressure, slight ink pooling, occasional tiny correction mark, and natural spacing around the printed magazine text.
- Printed details should feel authentic: small but legible captions, issue/date labels, page number, barcode block, section tags, and credit lines integrated into the page hierarchy.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial scan look based on a 50mm f/1.8 or 85mm f/1.4 portrait frame, then flattened into a magazine-page composition.
- Lighting: neutral diffused studio light with realistic paper texture visibility, softbox-style illumination at 45°, gentle contact shadows, and a photographed/flatbed-scan hybrid finish.
- Color grade: magazine print tone with slightly warm paper whites, controlled blacks, restrained red/blue ink accents, and cohesive {컬러 톤} across the printed page and handwritten layers.
- Material rendering: matte magazine stock, subtle tooth in the paper, printed ink sitting slightly into the fibers, and hand-drawn ink layered visibly above the print.

[6. MOOD]
Premium editorial scrapbook — like a Kinfolk meets Vogue marginalia spread, with casual reader notes, issue metadata, tiny credits, and real magazine artifacts layered onto a polished lifestyle page.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "이거 진짜 좋다", "꼭 가봐야지", "인생 사진!" must appear exactly as handwritten notes.
- Korean text accuracy: include readable printed magazine details such as "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", "서울 에디션", "나다운 선택이 가장 좋은 답", "오늘의 장면을 오래 기억하는 법", "취향이 머무는 오후", "모델 크레딧: 민서", and "p. 041".
- Korean text accuracy: all margin annotations, captions, feature blurbs, and any visible Korean handwriting must be legible, correctly spaced, and free of broken characters.
- Layout invariants: the attached photo must remain the main focal image, and handwritten notes must stay in the margins or near image edges without covering the key subject.
- Doodle rules: circles, check marks, underlines, arrows, stars, and bracket marks must be small, casual, and clearly readable as annotation marks.
- Barcode and microtext must look like magazine production details, not a product advertisement or official document.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-310.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
인스타 스토리용 손글씨 메모 합성 템플릿. 첨부 사진 위에 짧은 손글씨 멘션, 계정 핸들, 날짜/위치 라벨, 해시태그, 작은 스티커와 스토리 UI를 자연스럽게 얹은 9:16 세로 감성 컷.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {원본 보존}된 첨부 사진이 화면의 중심 비주얼이며, 텍스트와 스티커는 실제 스토리 편집 화면처럼 상단 프로필 바, 사진 위 메모, 하단 답장 바 주변에 리듬감 있게 배치한다.
- 배경은 원본 사진의 실제 질감과 색을 유지하고, 손글씨·스티커·라벨 그래픽은 개인이 직접 꾸민 스토리 캡처처럼 얹는다.
- 전체 프레이밍은 세로형 9:16에 맞춰 상단 스토리 UI 8~12%, 중앙 사진/메모 영역 68~74%, 하단 답장/공유 UI 12~16% 정도로 구성한다.
- {손글씨 멘션}, {해시태그}, {위치·시간 라벨}, {이모지 스티커}, {짧은 캡션}은 사진 속 주요 피사체를 가리지 않도록 배경 대비가 좋은 자리와 가장자리 흐름을 따라 배치한다.
- 상단에는 {인스타 핸들}과 {프로필 표시명}, 작은 원형 프로필 썸네일, 스토리 진행 바, “{스토리 시간}” 표기를 넣어 실제 업로드된 스토리 같은 현실감을 만든다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Story header UI (top 8~12%): 상단에 얇은 스토리 진행 바 3~4칸, 원형 프로필 썸네일, {프로필 표시명}, {인스타 핸들}, {스토리 시간}, 우측의 더보기 점 아이콘을 작게 배치한다. UI는 반투명 화이트와 웜 그레이로 처리해 사진 위에 자연스럽게 올라간 느낌을 준다.
2. Main photo area (center): 첨부 사진을 {원본 보존} 기준으로 9:16 화면에 맞춰 자연스럽게 크롭/배치한다. 원본의 인물, 음식, 풍경, 실내 소품, 거리 질감 등 실제 요소가 살아 있게 하고, 사진 가장자리에 은은한 필름 그레인과 라이트 누출감이 필요하면 아주 약하게 더한다.
3. Handwritten caption zone: {손글씨 멘션}을 흰색 또는 코랄 계열 손글씨 스타일로 배치한다. 글자는 살짝 기울어진 자유 필기 느낌이며, 메인 피사체 주변의 시선 흐름을 따라 스티커처럼 붙인 느낌을 낸다.
4. Date / location label cluster: {위치·시간 라벨}을 작은 위치 스티커, 날짜 라벨, 시간 스티커처럼 구성한다. 예: “성수동”, “2026.05.01 FRI”, “오후 5:00”처럼 실제 스토리에서 볼 법한 정보성을 갖춘다.
5. Hashtag and micro caption: {해시태그}는 하단 코너나 사진의 밝은 면에 한 줄 또는 두 줄로 정리하고, {짧은 캡션}은 작은 메모지 또는 반투명 라벨 위에 넣어 다이어리 기록처럼 보이게 한다.
6. Emoji and decorative stickers: {이모지 스티커}를 손글씨 주변, 위치 라벨 옆, 하단 답장 바 근처에 작게 배치한다. 하트, 별, 체크, 작은 낙서 화살표, 테이프 조각, 반짝이 라인 등 손으로 붙인 듯한 장식을 섞어 개인적인 스토리 꾸밈 느낌을 만든다.
7. Bottom interaction UI: 하단에는 “{답장 유도 문구}”가 들어간 답장 입력 바, 작은 하트 아이콘, 종이비행기 공유 아이콘, 저장/공유 느낌의 마이크로 아이콘을 배치해 실제 인스타 스토리 화면처럼 완성한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: handwritten brush script + casual marker style, medium weight 느낌, 28~42px 크기감; 보조 텍스트는 Pretendard SemiBold 18~24px; UI 마이크로 텍스트는 14~18px 수준.
- Color palette: 원본 톤 기반에 화이트 #FFFFFF, 코랄 #FF7F7F, 웜 그레이 #6E6A67, 옅은 크림 #F7F1E8, 연한 라벤더 #D8C7FF를 포인트로 사용.
- Sticker treatment: 반투명 라벨, 작은 테이프 스티커, 손그림 밑줄, 체크 표시, 위치 핀 모양을 평면 그래픽으로 섞고, 배경이 복잡한 구역에는 아주 얇은 소프트 그림자나 반투명 패치를 더해 가독성을 확보한다.
- Layout rhythm: 상단 UI, 중앙 손글씨, 하단 답장 바가 한 화면 안에서 자연스럽게 연결되도록 하고, 실제 사용자가 스마트폰으로 편집한 듯 약간의 비대칭과 손맛을 유지한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: smartphone social-story look, 26mm equivalent wide lens, f/1.8-like shallow depth feel, vertical handheld snapshot framing.
- Lighting: 원본 사진의 실제 조명 유지, 필요 시 화면 전체는 부드러운 실내 자연광처럼 보이게 하고, 텍스트는 배경에 묻히지 않도록 미세한 대비만 보강한다.
- Color grade: original tones preserved + slightly lifted highlights, soft pastel contrast, mild warm white and coral accent palette.
- Texture: 스마트폰 캡처 특유의 깨끗한 디지털 선명도에 은은한 필름 그레인, 약한 압축감, 손글씨 잉크의 미세한 번짐을 더해 현실적인 SNS 편집 결과처럼 보이게 한다.

[6. MOOD]
Pinterest 감성의 인스타 스토리 메모 카드 — 친구에게 공유하는 하루 기록, 개인 다이어리, 블로그 스냅샷 편집 느낌. 가볍고 친근하며, 실제로 업로드된 스토리 화면처럼 생동감 있게 연출한다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “오늘 진짜 좋았어” / “@daily_suji” / “수지의 하루” / “#오운완 #일상 #성수카페” / “성수동” / “2026.05.01 FRI” / “오후 5:00” / “답장 보내기...”
- 첨부 사진의 본래 분위기와 피사체는 유지하고, 손글씨와 라벨은 피사체의 얼굴·제품명·핵심 장면을 가리지 않게 배치한다.
- 실제 인스타 스토리 캡처처럼 상단 진행 바, 프로필 핸들, 시간 표기, 하단 답장 바와 공유 아이콘이 자연스럽게 보여야 한다.
- 모든 한글은 또렷하고 읽을 수 있어야 하며, 손글씨는 꾸민 듯하지만 의미가 정확히 전달되어야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or implying a real public figure posted it
- Misleading government, school, or medical authority marks

studio:prompts3:ours-309.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
사진 위에 손글씨 메모, 날짜/위치 라벨, 작은 SNS 카드형 디테일을 얹는 i2i 편집 이미지. 인스타 스토리·릴스 표지·블로그 썸네일·여행/일상 기록 카드에 바로 쓰기 좋은 현실적인 감성 합성 컷.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 첨부된 원본 사진을 화면 전체에 1:1로 채우고, 원본의 피사체·구도·톤·색감은 {원본 보존} 기준으로 최대한 유지한다.
- 메인 손글씨 문구 {메인 문구}는 {텍스트 위치}에 배치하며, 사진 속 하늘·벽면·테이블·길바닥·커튼·그림자 영역처럼 읽기 쉬운 영역 위에 자연스럽게 얹는다.
- 텍스트는 원본의 주요 피사체를 가리지 않도록 얼굴, 손, 음식, 제품, 건물명 같은 핵심 디테일을 피해 배치하고, 사진의 시선 흐름이 문구로 이어지게 구성한다.
- 메인 문구 주변에 {짧은 캡션}, {날짜 라벨}, {위치 라벨}을 작은 보조 정보로 추가해 실제 사진 앱 편집본이나 저장된 SNS 스토리처럼 보이게 한다.
- {장식 요소}는 텍스트 주변과 한쪽 코너에 작게 넣어 실제 다이어리 스크랩처럼 보이게 한다. 작은 별표, 밑줄, 하트, 체크 표시, 손그림 화살표, 얇은 마스킹테이프 조각, 찢어진 종이 라벨, 스티커 태그 중 사진 분위기에 맞는 요소를 사용한다.
- 상단 또는 하단 작은 영역에 {계정 핸들}, {해시태그}를 마이크로 텍스트로 넣고, 저장/공유/하트/댓글을 연상시키는 tiny line icon 2~3개를 더해 인스타그램 카드 감성을 강화한다.
- {스티커 태그}는 작은 라벨 또는 말풍선 형태로 배치하여 여행 기록, 카페 방문, 데일리 룩, 친구와의 추억 사진처럼 현실적인 사용 맥락을 만든다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Base layer: 첨부 사진({원본 보존})을 그대로 깔고, 원본의 노출·색온도·필름 그레인·렌즈 질감·피부/사물의 실제 질감은 유지한다.
2. Main handwritten text layer: {메인 문구}를 한 줄 또는 짧은 두 줄 구성으로 넣되, 문장 길이에 따라 자연스럽게 줄바꿈하여 가독성을 우선한다.
3. Placement logic: {텍스트 위치}에 배치하되, 사진의 밝거나 어두운 단색 영역을 활용하고 피사체 얼굴·중요 오브젝트와 겹치지 않게 한다.
4. Handwritten style: {손글씨 스타일}로 처리하며, 획의 시작과 끝에 살짝 흔들림이 있는 자연스러운 마커 필기, 사인펜, 젤펜, 유성펜 같은 손맛을 살린다.
5. Diary detail layer: 메인 문구 근처에 작은 서브 캡션 {짧은 캡션}, 날짜 {날짜 라벨}, 위치 라벨 {위치 라벨}을 더해 실제 사진 앱 편집/다이어리 스티커처럼 보이게 한다.
6. Decorative doodles: {장식 요소}를 텍스트의 시작점 또는 끝점 근처에 작은 포인트로 넣고, 사진 속 색감과 어울리는 스티커·낙서·밑줄·별표·화살표 형태로 정리한다.
7. Social micro details: 한쪽 모서리에 작은 {계정 핸들} 핸들, 하단에 아주 작은 {해시태그} 태그, 저장/공유/하트/댓글을 연상시키는 tiny line icon을 넣어 인스타그램 스토리/릴스 표지 같은 실제 사용감을 만든다.
8. Label and tag details: {스티커 태그}는 반투명 종이 조각, 둥근 캡슐 라벨, 작은 클립 스티커 형태 중 하나로 넣고, 라벨 위에는 짧은 한국어 메모가 또렷하게 보이도록 한다.
9. Color handling: {컬러 톤}을 기준으로 원본 색은 보존하되, 텍스트는 배경과 충분한 대비가 나도록 흰색/검정/짙은 단색 계열로 선명하게 처리한다. 라벨과 낙서는 사진에서 뽑은 보조색을 사용한다.
10. Final feel: 전체적으로 사진 위에 직접 쓴 듯한 자연스러운 손글씨와, 저장된 스토리·여행 앨범·다이어리 스크랩이 섞인 현실적인 편집 결과물처럼 보이게 한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 굵은 한글 손글씨 마커 스타일, Pretendard 또는 Noto Sans KR 기반의 커스텀 브러시 레터링 느낌, 굵기 700~900 수준, 메인 문구 크기는 화면 폭의 10~18% 범위에서 가독성 우선.
- Sub typography: 날짜·위치·핸들·해시태그·짧은 캡션은 얇은 손글씨 또는 작은 고딕체 느낌으로 처리하고, 메인 문구보다 4~6배 작게 배치한다. 예: “2026.05.01”, “오늘의 기록”, “서울 · 오후 4:32”, “#기록 #일상”.
- Color palette: 원본 사진의 색감 유지, 텍스트는 흰색 #FFFFFF 또는 검정 #111111, 필요 시 짙은 회색 #222222, 포인트 doodle은 사진에서 뽑은 보조색 1~2개를 사용한다.
- Texture: 손글씨 획에 아주 미세한 잉크 번짐, 압력 차이, 종이 스티커 같은 반투명 질감을 더해 디지털 폰트가 아니라 실제 필기처럼 보이게 한다.
- Depth and separation: 텍스트에만 아주 얕은 소프트 섀도우를 2px y-offset, 6px blur, 18% opacity 정도로 넣어 배경과 분리한다. 작은 라벨은 반투명 종이 스티커처럼 아주 약한 그림자와 질감을 가질 수 있다.
- SNS detail styling: 하트·댓글·저장·공유 micro icon은 아주 작은 라인 아이콘으로 처리하고, 실제 앱 화면 캡처처럼 과도하게 두드러지기보다 사진 위 편집 스티커처럼 자연스럽게 얹는다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 원본 사진의 촬영감 유지, 자연스러운 스마트폰 스냅 또는 35mm~50mm equivalent의 일상 사진 느낌.
- Lighting: 원본 광원을 그대로 존중하며, 필요 시 창가 자연광이나 흐린 날 확산광처럼 부드러운 명암만 유지한다.
- Color grade: 원본 톤 유지 + 텍스트 대비만 강화, 과채도 없이 미세한 콘트라스트 정리.
- Realism detail: 사진의 입자, 피부/천/음식/풍경 질감, 배경의 실제 빛 번짐과 그림자를 보존하고, 오버레이 요소는 사진 앱에서 직접 붙인 듯 표면 위에 자연스럽게 얹힌 느낌으로 합성한다.
- Overlay material: 손글씨는 표면 위 잉크처럼 보이고, 날짜 라벨·마스킹테이프·스티커 태그는 약간의 종이 섬유감과 가장자리 그림자를 가져 실제 다이어리 꾸미기 요소처럼 보이게 한다.

[6. MOOD]
인스타 스토리 메모 컷 — 무드보드 스크랩, 다이어리 필기 메모, 여행 앨범의 날짜 라벨, 친구에게 보낸 감성 사진 저장본, 해시태그가 붙은 일상 피드 카드가 합쳐진 듯한 따뜻하고 현실적인 편집 느낌.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: “{메인 문구}”, “{날짜 라벨}”, “{위치 라벨}”, “{계정 핸들}”, “{해시태그}”.
- 원본 사진의 피사체, 구도, 톤은 크게 훼손하지 말고, 손글씨 오버레이와 작은 날짜/위치 라벨이 사진 위에 얹힌 듯 자연스럽게 보이게 한다.
- 텍스트는 깨진 한글 없이 또렷하게 읽혀야 하며, 배경과 겹쳐도 문장 인식이 가능해야 한다.
- 추가되는 작은 한국어 라벨은 “오늘의 기록”, “서울 · 오후 4:32”, “#기록 #일상”, “저장해 둔 하루”처럼 짧고 실제 SNS 기록에 어울리는 문구로 유지한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-308.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a photoreal postcard-style handwritten memo composite from the provided photo, designed for Instagram, blog posts, and diary journaling. Show a real two-sided postcard moment in a warm editorial scrapbook flat-lay, with the original photo integrated as the printed front image and the reverse side filled with postal handwriting, travel notes, address details, stamp marks, and tactile paper aging.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The canvas is a square 1:1 composition with both postcard sides visible, arranged as either top/bottom or left/right depending on the input photo’s shape and balance.
- The {원본 보존} image should be integrated as the main postcard front with convincing print-on-paper realism, slight ink absorption, tiny paper fibers, and natural surface sheen rather than a floating digital cutout.
- The front side should occupy about 45–50% of the frame, while the back side and handwritten message should occupy the remaining area, with a believable overlap and tactile tabletop depth.
- Use {레이아웃} to place the front and back in a balanced postcard mockup layout, as if two sides of the same mailed card were laid out for a journal photo.
- Background should feel like {배경 종이}: aged kraft paper or vintage warm ivory postcard stock with subtle paper grain, gentle worn texture, faint stains, soft creases, and natural desk-surface variation.
- Add realistic postcard context: printed divider line, address rules, postal-code boxes, small “POST CARD” label, air-mail style micro text, a tiny date/location notation, and a few subtle scrapbook details such as a kraft envelope corner, a strip of translucent washi tape, or a fountain-pen shadow near the edge.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Front postcard area: apply {원본 보존} directly onto the postcard front with photoreal paper transfer, preserving natural photo detail, realistic print texture, slight paper absorption at the edges, and very mild wear on the corners.
- Front copy area: place {앞면 카피} as the front-side caption in a handwritten postcard note style; set the main Korean phrase prominently and add the location/date line “Seoul · 2026.04.29” smaller beneath it like a real travel postcard caption.
- Back postcard area: write {뒷면 메시지} in natural handwritten ink on the reverse side, with casual line breaks, slight baseline variation, and pressure changes like a real pen on textured paper.
- Postal details: add {우표·소인} near the upper-right corner of the postcard, with the stamp slightly tilted and the circular postmark stamped in semi-faded red ink; include small cancellation waves crossing part of the stamp.
- Address anatomy: include printed Korean labels such as “받는 사람”, “보내는 사람”, “주소”, “우편번호”, plus sample postal-code boxes and short address-like filler lines that look handwritten but do not overpower the main message.
- Extra printed micro details: add small realistic marks such as “POST CARD”, “AIR MAIL”, “NO.0429”, “SEOUL JOURNAL”, and a tiny printer registration dot or paper maker line near the bottom edge.
- Surface treatment: the paper should show gentle crease marks, light fiber texture, tiny ink feathering, slightly rounded corners, mild edge darkening, and realistic shadow falloff where the postcard overlaps the background.
- Overall balance: ensure the front and back sides feel like one coherent mailed object photographed in a diary spread, with tactile paper depth and naturally arranged postal ephemera.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a handwritten script style for the memo text, paired with clean sans-serif support text for postal labels; approximate fonts such as Nanum Pen Script, Cafe24 Oneprettynight, or a neat Pretendard for small support labels; handwriting should feel medium-weight, 26–34px equivalent on a 1024 canvas, with smaller postal micro type at 10–16px equivalent.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} with beige paper #E8DCC8, black ink #1A1A1A, muted postal red #B43A35, soft graphite gray #77716A, and faint blue-gray address lines; avoid neon or oversaturated tones.
- Border/shadow: apply a soft natural paper shadow, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity, with slightly darker contact shadow under overlapping postcard edges and subtle corner lift.
- Printed details should look physically pressed, stamped, written, or printed on paper: uneven ink density, slight misalignment, faint stamp grain, tiny paper dents, and authentic mailing-card wear.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio flat-lay realism, equivalent to a Canon EOS R5 with 35mm lens at f/5.6, top-down framing for the postcard mockup.
- Lighting: soft diffused window light from upper-left at roughly 45°, with a faint fill from lower-right to keep the paper texture visible and reduce harsh contrast.
- Color grade: warm parchment + muted sepia + postal red accents, with natural paper whites, restrained contrast, realistic ink blacks, and a gentle analog-photo warmth.

[6. MOOD]
Quiet travel-journal editorial — a real mailed postcard caught in a Kinfolk-style lifestyle spread, personal, tactile, nostalgic, and freshly written after a spring walk in Seoul.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and clearly in the rendered image:

[1. PURPOSE]
1-2 English lines: Realistic Polaroid-style photo composite with a handwritten Korean memo in the wide bottom margin, designed like a personal diary keepsake for Instagram, blog, and scrapbook use.
Warm instant-film presentation with lived-in tabletop details, small date/location markings, and a genuine pen-on-paper memory-card feel.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The attached photo is preserved inside the instant-photo area, with {원본 보존} occupying the main image zone and the frame centered as the hero object.
- The {폴라로이드 프레임} creates a thick matte white instant-film border with a deliberately wide bottom margin for handwriting, filling most of the square canvas with a slight casual tilt like a real print placed on a desk.
- The memo area sits in the lower blank space, with {하단 메모} written clearly as the focal text in {손글씨 톤}, matching real ink pressure, uneven baseline, and natural Korean handwriting rhythm.
- Add realistic personal-card details: a tiny printed date stamp near the upper frame edge reading “FILM LOG 0429”, a small location tag reading “서울 성수동”, and a tiny caption sticker reading “오늘의 조각” placed on the frame or nearby desk surface.
- {장식} appears as hand-added hearts, stars, washi tape bits, tiny sticker scraps, or pen doodles near the memo and frame edge, integrated naturally without covering the important photo subject.
- {배경} sits outside the Polaroid as a believable tabletop scene: warm wood grain or paper desk mat, a partially visible pen, torn memo paper, dried flower stem, soft coffee-ring mark, or envelope corner to make the print feel photographed in a real diary workspace.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Photo core (upper 65%): {원본 보존} placed inside the Polaroid image window with natural instant-film crop, slight emulsion softness, faint dust specks, and realistic edge integration into the print.
- Frame body: {폴라로이드 프레임} rendered as thick matte white instant-film stock with creamy paper texture, slightly softened corners, tiny handling marks, and classic SX-70/600-like proportion.
- Bottom memo strip (lower 20–25%): {하단 메모} centered or slightly left-aligned in {손글씨 톤}, sized to feel handwritten rather than typeset, with authentic pen overlap, small hesitation marks, and visible ink settling on paper fibers.
- Personal annotations: include small secondary Korean text around the frame such as “서울 성수동”, “오늘의 조각”, and “FILM LOG 0429” as tiny sticker/label details, clearly secondary to the main handwritten memo.
- Small accents: {장식} added as hand-drawn details, sticker edges, tape strips, or diary-style markings with imperfect human strokes and slight paper lift.
- Scene placement: {배경} shown as a real surface under the print, with subtle perspective, contact shadows, slight paper thickness, and a grounded tactile feel.
- Film finish: {필름 톤} applied across the whole Polaroid image, keeping whites slightly creamy, shadows gentle, colors softly muted, and the reference photo looking like it was exposed on instant film.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: handwritten Korean note style, natural marker-pen or gel-pen strokes, medium weight, roughly 28–40 px feel for the main memo area; micro labels should look like tiny printed sticker text or neat diary handwriting.
- Color palette: off-white #F4F0E6, warm paper cream #FAF7F0, graphite black #1F1F1F, muted blue ink #2F4B7C, soft wood brown #8A6A4A, pale tape beige #D8C7A3, dusty rose accent #B98282.
- Border/shadow: subtle paper cast shadow 4px downward offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity, plus tiny curled edge highlights and surface contact shadows from nearby stationery.
- Material detail: visible matte paper grain, slight fingerprints on the glossy photo window, faint corner wear, gentle ink bleed on the memo, and realistic overlap where tape or stickers touch the frame.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down tabletop photo look, 50mm lens, f/2.8, shallow-enough depth for a natural snapshot without strong blur.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from right, mild shadow under the lower edge of the Polaroid, with small highlights on glossy photo emulsion.
- Color grade: faded instant-film palette with soft cream highlights, muted skin/scene tones, slightly desaturated reds and blues, and a cozy analogue-paper warmth.
- Realism cues: slight paper thickness along the lower edge, soft dust on the desk, hand-placed asymmetry, realistic scale relationship between the pen, stickers, tape, and the Polaroid print.

[6. MOOD]
Indie personal scrapbook aesthetic — like a quiet Kinfolk stationery spread mixed with a lived-in Polaroid diary page, warm, intimate, nostalgic, and casually handmade.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: “2026.04.29 — 그날의 너”
- Additional small Korean text may appear as diary labels: “서울 성수동”, “오늘의 조각”, “필름로그”. Keep all Korean syllables correct, evenly spaced, and readable.
- Handwriting must look naturally handwritten in Korean, with correct spacing and no broken syllables or garbled characters.
- The attached photo remains fully inside the Polaroid frame, and the main memo sits only in the white bottom margin.
- Decorative hearts, stars, stickers, tape, and stationery details should support the diary atmosphere while leaving the main photo and memo clearly legible.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

- Background treatment: {배경} as a tactile paper desk surface with visible paper fiber, slight uneven tone, faint pressure marks from writing, and natural soft contact shadows.

- Decor placement: {장식} placed at corners, along photo edges, and in small gaps: tiny stars, hearts, masking-tape strips, pressed-flower-like marks, paper sticker tabs, small arrows, and underline doodles that support the photo.

2. Handwritten border notes: {테두리 메모} written around the perimeter in an organic, slightly uneven flow, as if added in a personal diary after printing.

Square 1:1 social post with warm stationery details, layered paper textures, readable Korean handwriting, and the feeling of a real personal diary page placed over a lived-in snapshot.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The attached everyday photo stays as the main background base via {원본 보존}, with memo elements layered on top in a natural scrapbook / diary-card layout.
- Main text area should occupy about 35–45% of the frame while the original photo remains recognizable; place the paper and writing so the main face, food, object, pet, scenery, or key moment in the reference image is still clearly visible.
- Place the date/weather near the top-left or top-center in small handwritten text, the mood line just below it, and the main memo as the largest handwritten block in the lower-middle or mid-right area.
- Add a small diary label near the header reading “오늘의 기록”, a tiny location-style tag reading “장소: 우리 동네”, and a subtle footer caption reading “소소하지만 기억하고 싶은 하루”.
- Add a small social-post detail such as “@daily.note”, tiny save/share micro icons, and short hashtag-like text “#일상기록 #무드메모” near the bottom edge of the paper or photo.
- Add {장식} around the memo corners and page edges as real stationery details: washi-tape strips, tiny pressed-flower doodles, pen stars, soft stamp marks, masking tape shadows, or small sticker labels that feel physically attached to the paper.
- Use {배경 종이} as a semi-transparent paper layer or torn-paper panel behind the writing, with soft edge blending, visible fiber texture, and slight curling or lifted corners so the original photo still feels present beneath it.
- Apply {컬러 톤} consistently across ink, doodles, tape, stamps, and paper accents so the full composition feels like one cohesive diary entry.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Background base: preserve {원본 보존} as the photographic foundation, keeping natural perspective and original lighting intact, including realistic background details from the source photo.
- Paper layer: place a cream diary-page surface inspired by {배경 종이} behind the memo, with visible paper grain, faint ruled or grid lines, light creases, tiny fibers, torn edges, and gentle shadows that suggest real paper resting over the photo.
- Header line: render {날짜·날씨} in a smaller handwritten style near the top, aligned like a real diary timestamp; include the fixed label “오늘의 기록” close by as a small tag or stamp.
- Mood line: place {오늘의 무드} directly under the date/weather with slightly looser brush handwriting, visually softer than the header and narrower than the main memo block.
- Location / caption details: add “장소: 우리 동네” as a small handwritten label, “소소하지만 기억하고 싶은 하루” as a tiny caption line, and “@daily.note” with “#일상기록 #무드메모” as realistic social diary metadata.
- Main memo block: set {자유 메모} as the dominant handwritten text, with natural line breaks, comfortable leading, small baseline variations, pressure changes, and slight organic tilt for an authentic pen-on-paper feel.
- Decorative accents: scatter {장식} in 3–5 small positions around the page edges or memo corners, mixing hand-drawn marks with tactile stationery pieces such as washi tape, small labels, translucent sticky tabs, or a soft ink stamp.
- Color integration: apply {컬러 톤} to ink, accent doodles, tabs, and subtle paper overlays; use warm cream, beige, charcoal, coral, or lilac accents with readable contrast and a natural diary-film balance.
- Final finish: make the whole piece look like a photographed diary note composited over a real-life snapshot, with layered shadows, paper thickness, realistic texture, and personal everyday details.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: handwritten Korean script style, casual pen-note feel, slightly uneven stroke width; use a clean handwritten font fallback such as Nanum Pen Script or a hand-lettered brush style, with the date smaller, the mood medium-sized, and the memo body larger.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} plus warm paper tones like cream #F6F0E6, beige #D8C7B3, charcoal #3C3A37, and a soft accent such as coral #E88D7B or lilac #B9A7D9.
- Border/shadow: if a paper panel is used, add a soft drop shadow with 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, and about 15% opacity; keep edges irregular, torn, taped, or paper-like rather than a flat digital box.
- Stationery realism: include tactile details such as faint pencil guide lines, tiny ink pooling at stroke ends, slightly translucent tape, small sticker paper thickness, light dust specks, and gentle paper creases.
- Layout rhythm: balance the handwritten memo, labels, hashtags, and decorative pieces so it reads like a real diary card prepared for a personal social post.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic smartphone photo base, equivalent to a 26mm wide smartphone lens at f/1.8 look, preserving everyday snapshot perspective rather than studio product framing.
- Lighting: natural ambient indoor or outdoor daylight from one side, ideally soft overcast light or window light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill and realistic shadows cast by paper, tape, and stickers.
- Color grade: warm cream + muted beige + charcoal with subtle coral or lilac accents, low saturation, slightly faded diary-film tone.
- Texture detail: emphasize believable paper fibers, matte ink, translucent tape, soft sticker edges, and the original image’s real photographic texture.

[6. MOOD]
Personal diary scrapbook overlay — like a gentle Kinfolk journal page mixed with a Real Simple handwritten note layout, but richer and more lived-in, as if someone actually wrote and decorated the memory after the day ended.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함:

  - @daily.note

- Decorations should feel like real diary stationery: tape, tiny tags, small doodles, stamps, and stickers integrated with believable shadows and texture.

[1. PURPOSE]
영화·콘서트 후기 손글씨 메모를 첨부 사진 위에 자연스럽게 합성한 i2i 인스타그램/블로그/다이어리용 기록 이미지.
영화 티켓, 스틸컷, 포스터, 콘서트 현장 사진 같은 원본 위에 실제 관람 후 남긴 손글씨 감상, 티켓 정보, 날짜 라벨, SNS 기록 요소를 얹어 한 장의 촬영된 스크랩북 페이지처럼 완성한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {원본 보존}된 첨부 이미지를 화면의 60~70% 핵심 영역에 유지하고, 가장자리에는 실제 다이어리 기록처럼 손글씨, 날짜 라벨, 작은 티켓 조각, 마스킹테이프, 스티커, 저장/공유 아이콘 낙서가 자연스럽게 붙어 있는 구성을 만든다.
- {작품·날짜}, {별점·평}, {명대사·장면}은 원본의 주요 얼굴·타이틀·무대 장면을 가리지 않도록 좌상단, 우하단, 하단 종이 레이어에 비대칭 배치한다.
- {장식}은 메모 주변에 손그림 포인트로 배치하고, 필름 프레임, 티켓 stub, 하트 doodle, 밑줄, 작은 별표, 체크 표시, 접힌 포스트잇, 해시태그 스티커를 섞어 실제 기록물처럼 만든다.
- {배경 종이}는 전체 바탕으로 깔고, 종이결, 살짝 눌린 자국, 테이프 그림자, 잉크 번짐, 손으로 붙인 사진의 미세한 들뜸, 책상 위에 놓인 듯한 접촉 그림자를 표현한다.
- {컬러 톤}은 텍스트, 하이라이트, 장식, 티켓 조각, 날짜 라벨, 작은 SNS 메타 정보의 색 균형에 반영하고, 원본 위에 얹은 글씨가 또렷하게 읽히도록 대비를 확보한다.
- 이미지 한쪽에는 작은 메타 정보처럼 “{기록 라벨}”, “{관람 장소}”, “{회차·좌석}”, “ticket no. {티켓 번호}”를 작게 넣고, 하단에는 “{인스타 핸들} · {해시태그}”와 저장/공유/댓글을 뜻하는 미세한 손그림 아이콘을 더해 현실감을 높인다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Base layer: 첨부 사진({원본 보존})을 먼저 배치하고, 이미지 경계가 자연스럽게 드러나도록 얇은 종이 그림자, 실제 인화지 같은 반광 질감, 부드러운 가장자리 블렌딩을 적용한다.
- Scrapbook elements: 원본 사진 일부 모서리에 반투명 마스킹테이프 2~3개를 붙이고, 옆에는 작은 영화 티켓 stub, 날짜 스탬프, 찢어진 메모지 조각, 필름 스트립, 영수증처럼 얇은 관람 기록 띠지를 겹쳐 다이어리 콜라주처럼 구성한다.
- Header area: {작품·날짜}를 손글씨 메모의 제목처럼 크게 두되, 포스터 캡션처럼 단정하게 배치하고 1차 강조색으로 시선을 잡는다. 작은 보조 라벨로 “REWATCH NOTE”, “APRIL LOG”, “VOL.04”, “관람 후 메모”를 넣는다.
- Rating area: {별점·평}은 제목 아래 또는 사진 하단 종이 레이어에 바로 적는 방식으로 넣고, 별 아이콘은 손그림처럼 살짝 불균일하게 표현한다. 옆에는 작은 한줄 감상 “{한줄 캡션}”을 아주 작게 추가한다.
- Quote area: {명대사·장면}은 작은 따옴표와 함께 강조 문장처럼 배치하여 후기의 핵심 감정을 읽히게 한다. 문장 아래에는 얇은 밑줄, 작은 화살표, “명대사 체크” 같은 손글씨 캡션과 동그라미 표시를 넣는다.
- Detail notes: 여백에 “{짧은 메모 1}”, “{짧은 메모 2}”, “{짧은 메모 3}” 같은 짧은 한국어 메모 2~3개를 작은 글씨로 흩어 배치하되, 핵심 문구보다 덜 강조한다.
- Ticket metadata: 작은 티켓 조각에는 “{관람 장소}”, “{회차·좌석}”, “ticket no. {티켓 번호}”, “입장 20:10”, “상영관 4관” 같은 현실적인 정보를 인쇄체와 손글씨가 섞인 형태로 넣는다.
- Social diary footer: 하단 또는 우측 가장자리에는 {인스타 핸들}, {해시태그}, “저장해둔 오늘의 장면”, 작은 북마크·말풍선·종이비행기 아이콘을 손으로 그린 듯 추가하여 인스타그램 카드와 개인 다이어리의 중간 느낌을 만든다.
- Decoration layer: {장식}은 텍스트 주변과 사진 모서리에 흩뿌리듯 넣고, 필름 릴·티켓 stub·하트 doodle·별점 표시·체크박스·찢어진 스티커는 실제 스케치 펜 터치처럼 보이게 한다.
- Paper treatment: {배경 종이}는 빈티지 메모지/다이어리 페이지 느낌으로 전체 톤을 정리하고, 미세한 종이 결과 잉크 번짐, 스탬프 눌림, 연필 가이드선, 손때가 묻은 듯한 따뜻한 얼룩을 약하게 추가한다.
- Final integration: 원본과 손글씨가 따로 노는 느낌이 없도록 색온도와 대비를 맞추고, 실제 책상 위에서 촬영한 완성된 후기 카드처럼 사진, 메모, 테이프, 종이, 티켓 조각이 하나의 물리적 페이지로 보이게 합성한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: handwritten Korean note style with brush pen + fine marker mix, title 42–54px 느낌, body 26–34px 느낌, micro note 14–18px 느낌, slightly irregular baseline, Pretendard or Nanum Pen Script 기반의 정돈된 손글씨 인상.
- Text hierarchy: 핵심 문구 3개는 가장 선명하고 크게, 보조 메모와 티켓 정보는 작지만 읽을 수 있게 배치한다. 실제 손으로 쓴 듯 획 굵기와 자간을 살짝 다르게 만든다.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}을 중심으로 black #111111, gold #C8A24A, deep red #8B1E1E, warm paper brown #3B2A22, muted cream #E9DDC9.
- Border/shadow: use soft paper drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity, subtle edge vignette, taped corners, layered paper shadows, and realistic contact shadows between the photo, ticket stub, stickers, and background paper.
- Material detail: paper fiber, matte ink, slightly glossy photo print, translucent tape, stamped date ink, ticket stock perforation, sticker edge lift, and fine marker pressure variations should be visible at close inspection.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial still-life composite feel, Canon EOS R5 with 50mm f/1.8 look for the handwritten overlay, flat-lay alignment reminiscent of a magazine scrapbook page.
- Lighting: soft overhead diffused light with a slight upper-left fill, gentle paper shadowing, realistic contact shadows around taped corners and ticket pieces, gentle contrast so text remains readable over the original image.
- Color grade: cinematic black + gold + deep red grade with restrained saturation, warm shadows, and slightly faded vintage paper highlights.
- Realism: physical scrapbook flat-lay, not a sterile digital mockup; preserve the texture of paper, ink, tape, ticket stock, sticker vinyl, and photo print so the final square image feels photographed rather than generated as a clean template.

[6. MOOD]
Indie film scrapbook page — A24-style review note mixed with Kinfolk editorial diary aesthetics, warm late-night after-movie reflection, personal archive feeling, slightly nostalgic and tactile, with the intimacy of a fan’s handwritten afterglow record.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문구:
  - "영화 \"기생충\" 재관람 / 2026.04.20"
  - "★★★★★ (5/5) — \"여러 번 봐도 다른 결\""
  - "\"이거 진짜 계획이 다 있구나.\""
- Additional small Korean detail text must be readable and may include: “관람 기록”, “CGV 용산아이파크몰”, “NIGHT 2회차 · 좌석 F열 12번”, “ticket no. 0420-05”, “명대사 체크”, “다시 보니 더 서늘함”, “저장해둔 오늘의 장면”, “@cine_diary”, “#영화후기 #기생충 #재관람”. Keep these secondary and smaller than the required text.
- {원본 보존}된 첨부 사진의 핵심 내용이 흐려지거나 과도하게 덮이지 않게 유지한다.
- 손글씨는 실제 메모처럼 자연스러워야 하며, 글자 깨짐 없이 모든 한글이 정확히 읽혀야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-303.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
첨부된 책 사진 위와 주변 종이 위에 실제 손글씨 리뷰 메모, 독서 기록 라벨, 인스타 카드형 마이크로 텍스트, 북스타그램 저장용 캡션 요소를 자연스럽게 합성한 인스타·블로그·다이어리용 i2i 콘텐츠.
원본 책 이미지를 유지하면서, 책상 위에 방금 정리한 독서노트 한 페이지와 북스타그램 카드가 함께 촬영된 듯한 1:1 정사각형 편집 컷.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {원본 보존}된 책 사진이 화면의 65~75%를 차지하도록 유지하고, 책 주변에는 실제 독서 기록처럼 손글씨 메모, 날짜 라벨, 장소 태그, 작은 해시태그, 저장/공유 아이콘 느낌의 마이크로 표시가 함께 놓인 구도.
- 배경은 {배경 종이}처럼 보이는 크림톤 종이 질감으로 통일하되, 섬유결, 미세한 접힌 자국, 연필 자국, 살짝 겹친 메모지 가장자리, 얇은 마스킹테이프 단면이 보여 실제 다이어리 페이지처럼 느껴지게 구성.
- 상단에는 {책 정보}와 작은 기록 헤더, 중앙에는 {별점·한 줄}, 하단에는 {인상 깊은 문장}, {기록 날짜}/{장소 라벨}, 짧은 감상 태그와 저장 유도 캡션이 자연스럽게 이어지도록 배치.
- 메모는 실제 펜으로 쓴 듯한 유기적 곡선과 약간의 기울기를 유지하며, {컬러 톤}에 맞춰 전체 톤을 정리.
- 주변에는 얇은 금색 북마크, 무광 펜, 반투명 인덱스 탭, 작은 영수증 조각, 접힌 서점 봉투 모서리, 찻잔 그림자 같은 현실적인 독서 소품을 부분적으로 포함해 장면의 생활감을 높임.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Base layer: 첨부 책 사진({원본 보존})을 중심 오브젝트로 유지하되, 책 표지/페이지가 과도하게 왜곡되지 않도록 정방향으로 정리하고 실제 종이 위에 올려진 듯한 접촉 그림자를 더함.
- Background layer: {배경 종이} 질감을 가진 크림색 종이 배경을 깔고, 모서리는 약간 바랜 종이 톤, 손으로 넘긴 듯한 미세한 주름, 아주 작은 잉크 점, 연필로 지운 흔적을 포함해 다이어리 스캔 페이지의 현실감을 살림.
- Header note area: 상단 여백에 {책 정보}를 손글씨 메모처럼 배치하되, 제목·작가·출판사·연도를 한 줄씩 나누어 가독성 있게 정렬하고, 옆에는 작은 라벨 텍스트 “독서노트 03”, “{기록 날짜}”, “{장소 라벨}”, “읽은 시간 22:40”을 함께 적음.
- Rating line area: 중상단 또는 우측 여백에 {별점·한 줄}을 눈에 띄는 포인트로 배치하고, 별점은 손그림 별 모양 5개가 또렷하게 보이게 처리하며, 아래에 짧은 감상 태그 “다시 펼쳐볼 문장들”과 “올해의 책 후보”를 작게 덧붙임.
- Quote area: 하단 또는 책 옆 세로 여백에 {인상 깊은 문장}을 작은 인용부호와 함께 적고, 옆에 “p.184”, “밑줄 저장”, “재독 체크” 같은 페이지 메모를 넣어 실제 독서 기록처럼 보이게 구성.
- Social card micro layer: 하단 가장자리에는 작은 인스타 카드 요소처럼 “{계정명}”, “{해시태그}”, tiny save/share/heart/comment outline icons, “{좋아요 수}”, “저장해두고 다시 읽기”, “{페이지 표시}” 정도의 작고 읽기 쉬운 보조 텍스트를 배치.
- Caption sticker layer: 한쪽 모서리에 작은 캡션 스티커처럼 “오늘의 문장”, “마음에 남은 장면”, “짧은 리뷰”를 적고, 얇은 구분선 아래에 “한여름의 끝에서 시작되는 다정한 회고”라는 한 줄 감상 메모를 넣음.
- Decoration layer: {장식}을 책 주변에 배치하되, 금색 별표, 밑줄, 동그라미 체크, 작은 테이프 조각, 낙엽 모양 doodle, 얇은 구분선이 메모의 시선 흐름을 돕도록 종이 위에 실제로 그려진 것처럼 자연스럽게 포함.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 손글씨 스타일 중심, Pretendard를 보조 설명 텍스트와 인스타 UI 마이크로 텍스트 느낌으로 아주 작게 사용한 듯한 균형; 제목은 굵기 700 수준의 또렷한 손글씨, 본문 메모는 400~500 수준의 가벼운 필기체, 날짜/해시태그/페이지 번호/아이콘 라벨은 작은 고딕체 느낌.
- Color palette: cream #F4EBDD, charcoal #2E2A28, gold accent #C9A24A, warm beige #DCCCB7, faded ink brown #6B5346.
- Border/shadow: 손글씨와 메모지 조각 아래에는 4px y-offset / 10px blur / 12% opacity의 아주 약한 종이 그림자를 적용하고, 책과 소품은 실제 플랫레이 촬영처럼 부드러운 접촉 그림자를 가짐.
- Pen texture: 잉크 번짐이 거의 없는 매트한 펜촉 질감, 압력 차로 선 굵기가 조금씩 달라지는 실제 필기감, 일부 밑줄은 한 번에 그은 듯 살짝 떨리는 선으로 표현.
- Realistic details: 종이 섬유결, 책 표지의 미세한 반사, 펜촉 자국, 테이프의 반투명한 가장자리, 북마크의 얇은 금속광, 인덱스 탭의 살짝 뜬 모서리, 영수증의 흐린 열전사 글자를 과하지 않게 살림.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat lay 느낌의 35mm lens perspective, f/5.6, documentary editorial composition.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper-left at 45°, natural paper shadow, slight warm bounce from lower-right to keep paper creamy.
- Color grade: warm cream + muted gold + deep charcoal, with low saturation and gentle paper grain.
- Finish: realistic diary scan meets editorial bookstagram photo, tactile paper layers, readable handwriting, subtle analog warmth.

[6. MOOD]
Kinfolk 스타일의 북리뷰 편집 메모 — 정돈된 다이어리 스캔 페이지와 실제 책상 위 독서 기록, 북스타그램 저장 카드가 섞인 따뜻하고 사적인 감성.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구
  - 제목 "여름의 끝에서"
  - 작가 김아람
  - 출판사 문학파스
  - 2026
  - ★★★★★ (5/5) — "올해 최고의 한 권"

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean workout log note composite over an existing gym photo, handwritten memo style for Instagram, blog, and diary use.
Create a warm, realistic fitness diary capture: the original exercise image remains the lived-in photographic base, while a paper memo, small labels, tape, checklist marks, and hand-drawn accents make it feel like an actual post-workout record saved in a training journal.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Reference photo remains the full-bleed base layer, with the handwritten memo integrated as a semi-transparent paper overlay occupying the lower 42% of the frame.
- Main handwritten block sits slightly left of center so the subject in {원본 보존} stays visible, with the memo naturally layered over the lower portion like a real note placed on a phone snapshot.
- Background treatment uses {배경 종이}: off-white notebook paper, graph paper, recycled memo paper, or lightly textured fitness-tracker journal paper with visible fiber, faint grid lines, subtle creases, and gentle paper shadow.
- Place {운동 종류·세트}, {오늘의 다짐}, and {기록·시간} as clearly separated handwritten lines, with realistic supporting labels such as "WORKOUT LOG", "오늘의 루틴", "체크 완료", and "기록 저장".
- Add a small top label on the memo reading "오운완 기록" and a date/location strip such as "2026.05.01  |  우리동네 헬스장" or "GYM NOTE #047".
- {장식} appears around the memo as small hand-drawn accents: checkboxes, tiny dumbbell doodle, sweat mark, heart pulse line, star sticker, washi-tape corner, circled count marks, or a small torn-sticker label.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Base layer: {원본 보존} stays sharp and natural, with realistic gym details such as equipment edges, mirror reflections, floor texture, towel, bottle, rack, or ambient background activity retained when present.
2. Memo panel: a light paper or notebook overlay appears on top of the photo with 85–90% opacity, enough to read text while still allowing the gym image tone to show through at the edges.
3. Header area: add a small handwritten or stamped-feel title "오운완 기록" near the upper-left of the memo, plus a compact micro caption "운동 후 바로 남긴 오늘의 메모".
4. Workout line: {운동 종류·세트} is written first in a bold handwritten marker style, aligned horizontally near the top of the memo block, with a small checkbox or underline accent in {컬러 톤}.
5. Motivation line: include the exact phrase "오늘도 한 걸음, 내일은 더 멋진 나" as the main quote, and place {오늘의 다짐} nearby as a personal note line, slightly slanted like real handwriting.
6. Timing line: {기록·시간} is placed as a compact footer line near the lower right of the memo area, formatted like a training log timestamp, with tiny labels such as "START", "FINISH", or "TOTAL" if it fits naturally.
7. Detail strips: add one or two small realistic journal details, such as "컨디션 ★★★★☆", "수분 체크 ✓", "RPE 7/10", "DAY 24", or "SAVE TO DIARY", kept secondary to the main Korean text.
8. Decorative accents: {장식} are hand-drawn icons and sticker-like marks placed near corners, line breaks, and paper edges without covering the subject’s face or key exercise form.
9. Color integration: use {컬러 톤} for text accents, doodles, separators, check marks, washi tape, and small stickers, while keeping the memo base neutral and readable.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: handwritten note style combining Pretendard Bold for tiny support labels if needed, with a brush-pen or marker handwriting feel for the main lines; size hierarchy roughly 28–34 px for the workout line, 22–26 px for the quote, 18–20 px for the timing line, and 10–14 px for micro labels.
- Color palette: use white, charcoal, muted green, and optional red accent from {컬러 톤}; paper base in #F7F6F2 or #F4F1EA; text in #222222 with accent tones in forest green #2F5D50 or deep red #B23A3A.
- Paper realism: add subtle paper grain, tiny pressure variations in handwriting, imperfect underline strokes, light tape translucency, and slight curled or torn paper edges where appropriate.
- Layering: the memo should look physically placed over the gym photo, with believable contact shadow, tape pieces, sticker edges, and a soft interaction between paper texture and the photo beneath.
- Border/shadow: use a very soft paper shadow with 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity to separate the memo from the photo; decoration should feel like journal stationery rather than a poster frame.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: preserve the original gym photo look as a realistic smartphone or DSLR workout snapshot; if new generation is implied, match a 35mm or 50mm equivalent perspective with natural proportions, similar to an iPhone 15 Pro main camera or Canon EOS R5 with RF 35mm lens.
- Lighting: keep the source photo lighting intact; any added memo overlay should be evenly lit with soft diffused top light, believable paper shadow, and no reflective glare over the handwritten text.
- Color grade: clean fitness-journal grade with neutral whites, charcoal blacks, and restrained green/red accents; skin tones, gym equipment, and floor texture should remain natural.
- Detail quality: make the handwriting feel human, with slight ink density changes, marker overlap, and small pressure marks; the paper texture should show enough tactile detail to read as a real memo sheet.

[6. MOOD]
Feels like a personal fitness diary page — a real hand-annotated training log captured after a workout, warm and motivating, with the practical, collected look of a modern Bullet Journal spread and the casual honesty of an Instagram 오운완 post.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함:
  - "오늘도 한 걸음, 내일은 더 멋진 나"
  - {운동 종류·세트}
  - {오늘의 다짐}
  - {기록·시간}
- Additional Korean micro text may include: "오운완 기록", "오늘의 루틴", "체크 완료", "기록 저장", "운동 후 바로 남긴 오늘의 메모", "컨디션 ★★★★☆", "수분 체크 ✓".
- The original workout image in {원본 보존} must remain recognizable and unwarped; do not crop out the main subject.
- Handwritten text must be legible, aligned, and free of broken Korean characters.
- Decorative doodles and stationery details should support the diary-note feeling without overwhelming the main workout record.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Base photo layer — Keep {원본 보존} fully recognizable, with the café atmosphere still visible behind the memo overlay; preserve real photographic depth, reflections, table texture, cups, plates, pastries, window light, or interior details that already exist in the source.

5. Rating line — Render {별점} directly beneath the title, using compact hand-drawn star marks, a clean slash format, and a tiny label “별점 기록”, sized smaller than the title but still highly legible.
6. Menu note — Place {시그니처 메뉴} in a neat two-part line or short stacked format, with menu prices or separators styled like café receipt handwriting using slashes, dots, or small bullets for easy reading.
7. Mood quote — Insert {분위기 한 줄} in quotation marks as a casual side note or underlined scribble, mimicking a real handwritten reaction after tasting coffee.
8. Detail snippets — Add 2–3 short Korean micro-notes around the main memo: “재방문 의사 있음”, “창가 자리 추천”, “디저트랑 잘 어울림”, using tiny handwriting so the card feels like a real review note.
9. Decorative accents — Add {장식} around corners and gaps, including soft marker circles, washi-tape pieces, tiny stars, coffee-ring stains, receipt perforation dots, and hand-drawn arrows pointing toward the café photo.
10. Social footer — Near the bottom, include “@cafe_tour.log  #카페투어 #오늘의커피” with tiny heart, save, and share icons, as if this memo is prepared for an Instagram story archive.
11. Final integration — Blend the memo into the café photo with slight shadow, paper grain, real-world perspective, and warm color matching so it looks like a photographed scrapbook capture rather than a flat pasted graphic.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: handwritten Korean style with a mix of Pretendard SemiBold for tiny support text and hand-drawn marker / brush script for the main memo lines; title roughly 28–34 px equivalent, body 18–22 px equivalent, micro labels 10–13 px equivalent.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}, plus off-white #F5F0E6, deep charcoal #2D2A26, muted amber #C98A3A, soft brown #8A6B52, pale latte #D9C2A3, and muted sage #9BA889 for small accent stickers.
- Paper and ink: use slightly uneven marker edges, graphite pencil pressure changes, tiny ink pooling at stroke ends, paper fibers, tape translucency, faint receipt grid marks, and subtle coffee-ring stains.
- Border/shadow: subtle paper shadow with 0 px x-offset, 4 px y-offset, 12 px blur, 14% opacity; if framing is needed, use a hand-drawn wavy line, folded paper edge, or torn receipt edge rather than a rigid digital box.
- Layout rhythm: combine a bold title, compact rating row, stacked menu note, quote line, and tiny social footer so the image has the density of a real café diary page while keeping the main review text easy to read.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: keep the existing café lighting from the source photo; if adding graphic shading, use a soft diffused shadow from upper-left at about 45° so the memo feels physically placed on paper.
- Color grade: beige + charcoal + warm amber accents, with slight film grain and restrained contrast, similar to a cozy magazine diary recap.
- Realism details: add natural paper curl, tiny dust specks, slight lens softness at the far edges, gentle tabletop reflections, and imperfect handmade alignment so the final image feels captured in a real café moment.

[6. MOOD]

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as written for the rendered content: "{카페명·위치}", "{별점}", "{시그니처 메뉴}", "{분위기 한 줄}".

- Keep all Korean text clean and fully legible, with no broken Korean characters, no garbled spacing, and no mistaken star symbols.

- Memo placement: {메모 내용} appears as a paper-note overlay or handwritten caption, anchored to one side, a lower corner, or slightly overlapping the image edge, covering about 18–30% of the frame while staying readable.
- Category cue: {카테고리} is expressed through a small category tab, handwritten label, doodle motif, and note tone, without redrawing the original scene.
- Background treatment: {배경 종이} with visible paper fiber, tiny creases, torn or softly cut edges, realistic tape, a paperclip, washi strip, or small label sticker for a natural cut-and-paste scrapbook feel.
- Supporting details: include a small date/location line such as “2026.05.01 · 서울”, a tiny caption like “오늘의 기록”, a note number like “No. 024”, and 1–2 micro tags such as “#메모” or “mood note” printed or handwritten near the memo.
- Framing: let the original photo read clearly while making the memo area feel tactile, layered, and intentionally arranged like a real diary page photographed from above or composited with matched shadows.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Base layer — keep {원본 보존} intact as the full-bleed or near full-bleed foundation, preserving original colors, textures, lighting direction, and composition.
2. Paper layer — place {배경 종이} as a memo sheet element near the photo edge or partially underlapping the image, with realistic thickness, paper grain, slight curl, faint smudges, and irregular handmade placement.
3. Handwriting layer — write {메모 내용} in prominent Korean handwriting, with {손글씨 톤} style, using strong contrast against the paper; add a smaller Korean line such as “작게 남겨두는 오늘” or “기록해두기” if it fits the mood.
4. Category and index layer — show {카테고리} as a tiny tab, file-label sticker, or circled header near the top of the memo; add a realistic date stamp, page mark, or small index text like “memo card / vol. 12”.
5. Doodle layer — add {장식·doodle} around the memo edge and nearby paper corners: small arrows, stars, hearts, flowers, food icons, travel marks, check boxes, underline strokes, or hand-drawn frames that match the category.
6. Scrapbook objects — include believable stationery details such as beige masking tape, transparent tape shine, a small binder clip shadow, pressed-paper sticker, receipt strip, or torn kraft label; keep them physically plausible and matched to the photo lighting.
7. Color harmony — apply {컬러 톤} consistently across ink, doodles, category tab, tape, and paper accents so the whole composition feels unified and reusable across categories.
8. Final polish — make the result look like a scanned or photographed scrapbook note pasted onto a real photo, with tactile paper edges, readable handwriting, natural shadows, and authentic lifestyle-magazine finishing.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: handwritten Korean in a marker-pen / pencil / fountain-pen hybrid feel, with small English secondary notes in Pretendard SemiBold or handwritten sans, size hint 28–54 px for the main memo and 12–18 px for tiny support text.
- Text hierarchy: {메모 내용} is the largest text; {카테고리} appears as a small header or label; support text can include “오늘의 메모”, “No. 024”, “2026.05.01”, “서울 성수동”, “mood note”, or “save this moment”.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} as the main palette, anchored by beige, charcoal ink, and coral or green accents; paper tones should stay in off-white, kraft brown, warm gray, pale butter, or recycled-paper beige.
- Border/shadow: subtle real-paper drop shadow, 4px y-offset, 10–14px blur, 12–18% opacity; use tactile paper edges, tape overlaps, and ink underlines instead of hard digital outline boxes or neon glow.
- Material detail: handwriting should show slight ink pressure variation, tiny pen skips, soft pencil grain, or marker pooling; paper should show fiber, compression marks, folded corners, and gentle surface imperfections.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic smartphone photo or 50mm f/1.8 documentary snapshot look, depending on the source image; keep perspective natural and unwarped.
- Lighting: preserve the original lighting of the source photo; if adding paper overlays, match them with soft ambient light from upper-left and a faint shadow to the lower-right.
- Color grade: warm cream + beige + charcoal with small coral or sage accents, low saturation, slightly matte finish.
- Realism: stationery objects, tape shine, paper curl, dust specks, and handwritten ink must share the same perspective and light direction as the source photo.

[6. MOOD]
Indie scrapbook journaling aesthetic — like a personal note page from a modern Korean lifestyle magazine spread, with a handmade diary feel, tactile stationery details, and a warm collected-memory atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following verbatim Korean strings must appear correctly when used by the user: “{메모 내용}”.
- If {카테고리} appears as visible text, render it accurately in Korean and make it feel like a real memo label or category tab.
- Additional small Korean text may be included when appropriate, such as “오늘의 메모”, “기록해두기”, “서울”, “작게 남긴 하루”, or “다시 보고 싶은 순간”; all Korean must be legible and naturally handwritten or printed.
- Preserve the source image identity, colors, and texture as much as possible; do not convert the photo into a different scene.
- Handwriting must remain readable, natural, and category-appropriate, with believable human variation rather than a generic font look.
- Doodles and stationery details should support the memo theme and feel hand-placed, not randomly scattered.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness replacement

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a 4x4 grid sheet of 16 messenger-style emotes based on the attached portrait photo. The result should feel like a polished sticker pack preview page: photo-based, cute, expressive, commercially presented, and shareable as a single square image with title, creator metadata, version/date details, and playful sticker-pack UI cues.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {원본 보존} 인물의 얼굴이 16개 셀 모두에서 동일하게 유지되도록 하며, 각 셀은 표정과 제스처만 바뀌도록 구성한다.
- {배경 스타일} 위에 파스텔 톤의 얇은 구분선, 작은 종이 질감, 반투명 컬러 스티커 조각, 손그림 느낌의 점·별·하트 장식을 가볍게 배치한다.
- 상단에는 {팩 제목}, {크리에이터 핸들}, {버전 표기}, {제작일}을 작은 스티커팩 카탈로그 헤더처럼 배치한다.
- {배치}는 중앙 영역을 4x4 균등 그리드로 나누어 총 16개 이모티콘을 좌→우, 상→하 순서로 정렬한다.
- 각 셀은 둥근 사각형 카드 또는 투명 스티커 프레임처럼 보이게 만들고, 셀 상단 모서리에 {셀 번호 라벨}을 작은 캡슐 태그로 넣는다.
- 각 셀 하단 또는 얼굴 주변에 {16개 한국어 텍스트}를 배치하고, 작은 {미니 이모지}를 표정에 맞게 1~2개씩 곁들인다.
- 하단에는 {하단 안내문}과 작은 page indicator, 저장/공유/좋아요를 암시하는 마이크로 아이콘을 넣어 실제 스티커팩 미리보기 카드처럼 완성한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Overall canvas: build a square 1024x1024 sticker-pack preview sheet with a compact header, 16 equal emote cells, and a slim footer information strip, all aligned to a consistent editorial grid.
2. Header information: render the pack title “{팩 제목}” prominently, with “{크리에이터 핸들}”, “{버전 표기}”, and “{제작일}” as smaller realistic metadata.
3. Each cell portrait: place the same person in every cell, keeping identity, face shape, eye-nose-mouth positions, and proportions unchanged while changing only expression, micro-gesture, and emotion accents.
4. Sticker treatment: apply {스티커 디자인} to every emote so each face reads like an individual sticker placed on a preview sheet.
5. Expression mapping: render the 16 expressions in order from left to right, top to bottom, matching each cell to the corresponding {16개 표정 리스트} item.
6. Caption placement: set the matching {16개 한국어 텍스트} clearly in each cell, positioned as a bold sticker caption that supports the facial expression.
7. Decorative accents: add small {미니 이모지}, pastel speech bubbles, mini sparkle marks, sweat drops, tiny hearts, flames, food crumbs, or motion lines according to the emotion of each cell.
8. Footer details: include “{하단 안내문}”, a small “1/1” page indicator, and simple save/share/heart micro icons to make the sheet feel like a real preview card rather than an isolated grid.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use {텍스트 폰트}; captions should be thick, rounded, and highly readable, with occasional pastel shadow blocks or sticker-label backplates.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} across captions, mini labels, header stickers, footer strip, and decorative accents.
- Layout finish: keep all 16 cells equal in size with consistent spacing, rounded card corners, playful capsule labels, and a balanced header/footer hierarchy.
- Border/shadow: apply a crisp white sticker outline around each emote, soft drop shadow, and subtle contact shadow under the sticker cutout for a tactile printed-sheet look.
- Text realism: Korean captions must look typeset, centered, and intentionally designed; use handwritten emphasis only where it improves the emote feeling.
- Decorative graphics: use small tape pieces, sticker tabs, sparkles, dots, hearts, and emotion marks as part of the designed sticker-pack preview.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with RF 85mm f/1.2L USM portrait-photo look, natural facial proportions, clean skin detail, realistic eye highlights, adapted into a sticker-sheet layout.
- Lighting: soft studio softbox from upper-left at 45° with gentle fill from the right, even skin tones, delicate cheek highlights, and soft shadows below sticker cutouts.
- Color grade: pastel editorial grade with creamy whites, gentle coral-mint-lilac accents, warm neutral skin tones, and lightly printed paper texture.
- Rendering finish: realistic photo-collage sticker style, crisp facial detail, rounded graphic elements, polished app-store sticker preview presentation.

[6. MOOD]
Cute premium sticker-sheet editorial — a playful messenger emote pack preview with expressive portrait realism, pastel stationery charm, cheerful Korean captions, and a finished creator-card presentation.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 16개 캡션: "안녕!", "힝 ㅠㅠ", "졸려요~", "우와!", "멍~", "냠냠~", "쳇!", "좋아요!", "크앙!", "으악!", "반짝!", "응?!", "음..", "헤헷!", "흥!", "버럭!"
- Header/footer Korean text must be readable: "{팩 제목}", "{크리에이터 핸들}", "{버전 표기}", "{제작일}", "{하단 안내문}".
- All 16 cells must show the same person and the same facial identity; only the expression, gesture, and emotion accent changes.
- Facial features, eye/nose/mouth placement, face shape, hairline, and key identity markers must remain consistent.
- The 4x4 grid must be evenly balanced; every cell must align correctly with its expression number and matching Korean caption.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Different person or face replacement
- Celebrity composites unless explicitly provided as the reference image

studio:prompts3:ours-297.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Cinematic close-up portrait transformation for an input photo, designed as a vertical editorial still with realistic skin detail, lived-in atmosphere, and restrained commercial finish.
Close-up face-and-shoulders portrait with film-still mood, suitable for profile hero image, premium personal branding, or a character-driven editorial portrait.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {원본 보존} as the main hero, framed from chest-up in a straight-on eye-level composition, face centered slightly above midline with natural headroom and believable portrait spacing.
- Background treatment: {배경} as a warm cinematic interior or studio backdrop with visible real-world depth: softly blurred textured wall, dark wood or fabric tones, faint practical lamp bokeh, and gentle atmospheric falloff behind the subject.
- Spacing and framing: tight medium close-up crop, shoulders fully readable, hair silhouette intact, with enough surrounding environment to feel photographed in a real room rather than isolated on a flat backdrop.
- Expression and pose: {표정} with natural facial tension preserved, no exaggerated smile, no beauty-pose distortion; include subtle human micro-expression in the eyes and mouth.
- Angle control: {앵글} with a stable camera feel and realistic portrait perspective.
- Realistic detail: include natural wardrobe texture near the collar and shoulders, soft fabric folds, a faint catchlight in both eyes, tiny flyaway hairs, and believable skin variation.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Base portrait layer: keep {원본 보존} as the identity anchor, preserving facial structure, hairstyle silhouette, and key features without beautification drift.
- Face rendering: retain pore-level texture, subtle under-eye detail, natural lip texture, fine facial hair or peach fuzz where present, realistic catchlights, and organic asymmetry; avoid plastic smoothing.
- Lighting block: apply {라이팅} with a single-key cinematic setup, softly shaping cheekbones and jawline while keeping shadows deep but legible.
- Background block: render {배경} as a moody, low-contrast but tangible backdrop with warm wall texture, soft shadow gradients, muted furniture or curtain shapes, and one or two distant defocused practical highlights.
- Color and texture block: build {컬러·텍스처} into the final grade, with fine soft grain, warm midtones, controlled highlight roll-off, tactile fabric detail, and subtle atmospheric haze.
- Camera look block: emulate {카메라·렌즈} with shallow depth of field, clean subject separation, natural portrait compression, and gentle background bokeh.
- Finish block: keep the image as a cinematic film still, not a glossy beauty retouch; the final portrait should feel like a captured moment from a premium indie film scene.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: no designed title overlay; incidental background marks or tiny unreadable set details may exist only if naturally part of the environment.
- Color palette: warm amber, deep charcoal, dark brown, muted umber, soft skin beige, tobacco brown, aged brass, and restrained black accents.
- Surface and texture: emphasize realistic skin, hair, fabric weave, slight lens grain, muted wall texture, and soft practical-light glow in the background.
- Depth cues: use layered foreground-to-background separation, subtle shadow on the neck and jaw, and a believable falloff from face to shoulders.
- Border/shadow: no graphic frame is required; if separation is needed, rely on photographic lighting and depth of field rather than a cutout effect.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame portrait look, Sony A7R V with 85mm f/1.4, shot around f/2.0, ISO 400, shallow depth of field, natural facial perspective.
- Lighting: single warm key light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from front-right at very low intensity, charcoal shadow falloff on the far cheek and neck, with a faint warm practical glow behind the subject.
- Color grade: warm amber highlights, deep charcoal shadows, slightly muted brown mids, soft grain, subtle cinematic contrast, no neon, no glossy skin shine.

[6. MOOD]
Moody cinematic portrait — A24-style film still with restrained warmth, intimate character framing, and the feeling of a quiet late-evening interior scene.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: no intentional on-image Korean text is needed; if any tiny incidental background text appears, it must be natural, unobtrusive, and not broken.
- Preserve identity exactly from {원본 보존}; do not change facial identity, age impression, or core facial geometry.
- Keep the subject centered, eye-level, and recognizably human with anatomically correct neck, shoulders, ears, hairline, hands if visible, and realistic eye alignment.
- Maintain a real photographic close-up portrait, with believable skin texture, wardrobe texture, background depth, and cinematic warm tone.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]

- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a high-fashion botanical magazine-cover portrait transformed from the attached person photo, with the face preserved and framed by dense floral elements.
The result should feel like a premium Korean beauty editorial cover: realistic skin, tactile petals and leaves, cinematic daylight, and polished cover typography integrated around the portrait without hiding the facial features.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the face in a tight vertical close-up crop, with shoulders only slightly visible at the bottom edge and the floral frame filling the surrounding cover area.
- Build a thick floral-and-foliage wreath around the face, letting leaves, petals, stems, and small buds overlap the hairline, temples, cheeks, and collar area in a natural layered way.
- Keep {원본 보존} so facial identity remains recognizable, while the floral layers overlap only the outer contour areas.
- Surround the frame edges with {플로럴 구성}, keeping the eyes, nose, and mouth clearly readable and emotionally expressive.
- Use {구도} as the main framing logic, with the masthead and cover lines placed around the botanical frame like a real fashion magazine cover.
- Add realistic magazine-cover details: large top masthead “FLORAL FACE”, small issue label “VOL.247”, date label “2026년 5월호”, barcode box near the lower corner, a small model credit line “모델: 오늘의 얼굴”, and 2–3 short Korean feature blurbs arranged along the side areas.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Face base layer: preserve the attached subject’s facial structure and likeness first, then integrate the floral overlay without warping facial proportions.
2. Botanical frame: place dense dark green leaves around the temples, cheeks, and lower jawline, with red, orange, cream-white, and small pale-yellow blossoms distributed asymmetrically for an editorial, natural look. Include visible petal veins, pollen texture, leaf serrations, tiny stems, and a few dew-like highlights for tactile realism.
3. Magazine cover layer: add a polished editorial masthead, issue number, date, barcode area, price text “₩7,500”, short Korean cover lines such as “꽃으로 완성한 얼굴”, “나다운 색의 순간”, “봄의 빛과 피부”, plus small spine/credit text along one edge.
4. Light interaction: apply {조명} so the face has dimensional separation from the foliage, with subtle rim highlights along the hairline, cheek edges, petals, and glossy leaf surfaces.
5. Color integration: blend {컬러 톤} so the flowers feel vivid but still cinematic, avoiding neon or hyper-saturated clipping.
6. Capture feel: render with {카메라·렌즈} for crisp skin detail, selective depth separation, realistic macro clarity, and tactile magazine-print richness.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: premium Korean fashion-magazine cover typography, elegant serif masthead mixed with clean sans-serif Korean blurbs; text must look professionally printed and aligned to the portrait.
- Required cover text elements: “FLORAL FACE”, “VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호”, “₩7,500”, “모델: 오늘의 얼굴”, “꽃으로 완성한 얼굴”, “나다운 색의 순간”, “봄의 빛과 피부”.
- Color palette: deep forest green, crimson red, burnt orange, cream white, charcoal shadow, muted skin tones; keep saturation controlled and editorial.
- Border/shadow: soft natural edge falloff around the floral frame, delicate shadowing under overlapping petals and leaves, subtle printed-cover depth, realistic magazine finish.
- Add small production details like a barcode rectangle, tiny credit line “PHOTO / BEAUTY EDIT”, page-style micro text, and slim vertical spine text, all integrated cleanly into the cover.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Sony A7R V look, 100mm f/2.8 macro, f/4, high-resolution portrait detail.
- Lighting: soft side light from one side with light leaking through the leaves, plus a clean rim light tracing the face contour; realistic diffused daylight rather than studio gloss.
- Color grade: deep green and floral primaries against cream-white highlights, charcoal shadows, restrained contrast, fashion-editorial tonal balance.
- Material realism: natural skin pores, soft peach fuzz, hydrated petals, matte leaf undersides, glossy leaf highlights, tiny shadows where flowers overlap the face, and subtle magazine-print sheen.

[6. MOOD]
High-fashion botanical portrait — like a Vogue Italia beauty spread crossed with a Korean fine-art floral magazine cover, intimate, lush, cinematic, and premium.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render all Korean text cleanly and legibly, especially “꽃으로 완성한 얼굴”, “나다운 색의 순간”, “봄의 빛과 피부”, “2026년 5월호”, and “모델: 오늘의 얼굴”.
- Preserve the subject’s facial identity from the reference image.
- Keep the floral frame dense around the face while maintaining clear visibility of core facial features.
- Do not distort anatomy; eyes, nose, mouth, skin texture, hairline, neck, and shoulders must remain natural.
- Magazine-cover elements must feel printed into the final design, not floating stickers.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Candid high-angle street fashion snap for editorial social content, vertical full-body portrait with footwear, outfit layering, accessories, and surrounding street atmosphere clearly readable.
Vogue Street-inspired fashion photography feel, suitable for lookbook, street style feed, and poster-like social post with authentic city details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {모델 묘사} occupies the lower-middle 55% of the frame, with visible surrounding sidewalk geometry, storefront atmosphere, and full visibility of shoes, hemline, bag, jewelry, and hair styling.
- Background treatment: {장면} with urban pavement texture, curb edges, café windows, gallery facades, street posters, crosswalk paint, a parked bicycle or scooter, small planter boxes, reflections in glass, and subtle pedestrian flow; background remains recognizable as a real street environment while the outfit stays dominant.
- Framing direction: vertical composition, camera looking slightly downward from above, maintaining a spontaneous street-snapshot feel as if captured from café steps, a raised curb, or a low balcony.
- Pose and motion: {포즈} while the body line stays elegant and readable; one leg slightly forward or weight shifted for movement, with natural hand placement interacting with bag strap, coat lapel, phone, sunglasses, or hair.
- Angle emphasis: {앵글} so the outfit silhouette, bag shape, jewelry glints, shoe design, pavement scale, and street-layer perspective are all visible at once.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero subject area: {모델 묘사} centered slightly off-center, with the outfit taking visual priority and the face still clearly readable, including realistic skin texture, hair strands, fabric weave, seams, buttons, zipper lines, and accessory materials.
- Street context layer: {장면} rendered as a lived-in urban fashion backdrop with realistic sidewalk perspective, curb edges, café/galleria signage, chalkboard menu details, taped event flyers, window reflections, delivery marks, fallen leaves, small puddle highlights, and a few naturally blurred passersby.
- Motion cue: {포즈} captured at the peak of a casual step or pause, with natural arm position, believable garment drape, slight fabric movement, and a candid micro-expression rather than a runway pose.
- Perspective control: {앵글} used to elongate the body slightly while preserving shoe detail, bag strap lines, jacket or coat structure, and the relationship between the subject and pavement lines.
- Editorial street details: include small realistic city text elements such as a café sign reading "커피", a gallery poster reading "전시 중", or a tiny pavement sticker reading "성수동"; text should feel incidental to the photographed street, not like a flat graphic mockup.
- Lighting pass: {라이팅} applied so fabric texture, skin tone, hair edges, metallic accessories, glass reflections, and pavement grain have soft separation without harsh shadow clipping.
- Color and finish: {컬러 톤} with slightly faded contrast, gentle film grain, warm highlight bloom, authentic asphalt and concrete texture, and a polished editorial street-photo finish.
- Camera look: {카메라·렌즈} with crisp subject detail, shallow-to-moderate background separation, realistic street-photography clarity, and natural lens perspective from the high angle.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: allow incidental real-world Korean signage and very small editorial metadata only if it feels photographed or tastefully printed, such as "성수동 스트리트", "LOOK 07", "2026.05.01", or "오늘의 실루엣"; keep all text short, legible, and integrated with the street fashion editorial mood.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} translated into beige, charcoal, warm amber accents, muted asphalt gray, soft off-white highlights, natural denim or leather tones, and subtle storefront reflections.
- Graphic treatment: if an editorial social-post overlay is used, keep it refined and photographic — a tiny corner date/location label, small model-name credit such as "MODEL: HANA", or thin caption tag that does not hide the outfit.
- Environmental realism: include natural street objects and textures such as pavement cracks, curb paint, café table edges, window glare, posters, bollards, metal grates, rain speckles, leaves, and passing silhouettes to make the shot feel captured in a real city.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Sony A7R V with a 35mm f/1.8 street-photography look, around ISO 400 and f/2.8 for sharp outfit detail and soft background separation.
- Lighting: natural daylight under overcast conditions or golden hour, with soft directional light and gentle shadows that define clothing texture, facial contours, accessories, and pavement detail without flattening the scene.
- Color grade: Portra 800-inspired grading, faded beige and charcoal base with warm amber lift in highlights, slightly softened blacks, gentle film grain, and realistic highlight roll-off on glass and metal surfaces.

[6. MOOD]
Vogue Street editorial — like a polished urban lookbook shot in a New York SoHo or Seoul Seongsu street-style spread, candid, fashionable, textured, and alive with small city details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: any visible Korean must be correctly formed and short; acceptable examples include "성수동 스트리트", "커피", "전시 중", "오늘의 실루엣", "LOOK 07", and "2026.05.01".
- Anatomy/layout invariants: body proportions must remain natural; hands and feet anatomically correct; shoes and outfit details fully visible; face readable; bag straps, sleeves, hems, and jewelry must connect logically to the body.
- Realism invariants: keep the image photographic, with believable street scale, natural reflections, realistic fabric texture, and coherent high-angle perspective.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]

- language: Korean
