[1. PURPOSE]
Korean gift bouquet magazine-style product photo, editorial top-shot / shoulder-close-up composition for premium florist and shopping mall hero image.
Designed for birthday gifts, wedding bouquets, anniversaries, and e-commerce main banners in a vertical 2:3 frame.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {꽃다발 종류} arranged as the clear hero, occupying about 60% of the frame, with the bouquet slightly off-center for a refined editorial balance.
- Background treatment: {배경·소품} on a cream-white linen surface with visible weave texture, natural wrinkles, loose petals, ribbon tails, a small florist card, and a gift note that feel genuinely placed for a premium delivery scene.
- Framing direction: {장면 구도} so the bouquet reads naturally either as a flat-lay overhead spread or a shoulder-level close-up in a held-gift scene.
- Realistic gifting details: include a small printed shop sticker, care-tip card, and slim product tag with {플로리스트명}, {상품 코드}, and {가격 정보}, integrated on the wrapping or beside the bouquet.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero bouquet layer (mid 60%): {꽃다발 종류} rendered with crisp petal edges, layered volume, visible stem overlap, and clearly visible wrapping paper folds; the bouquet should feel freshly wrapped and gift-ready.
- Gift detail layer: satin ribbon knots, trailing ribbon ends, a tucked greeting card, florist sticker, tiny delivery label, and scattered petals from {배경·소품} placed like a real packing table before handoff.
- Text object layer: the card should show {카드 문구}, the shop label should show {플로리스트명}, and a small date/location label should show {날짜·장소 라벨} in readable Korean.
- Composition layer: {장면 구도} should guide the eye toward the bouquet center, with a balanced diagonal flow if overhead, or soft hand-held intimacy if shoulder-close.
- Surface layer: cream linen texture beneath the bouquet, slightly wrinkled and softly lit, with natural fiber detail, matte paper grain, ribbon sheen, and believable contact shadows.
- Finish layer: maintain realistic floral depth, irregular petal shapes, fresh cut stems, translucent paper edges, and an editorial premium shopping-mall look.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: any visible card, label, or product tag text should use clean Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium weight, around 24–36px feel for card text and 14–20px feel for label details; keep letters sharp and legible.
- Printed elements: include a small florist business card, a care note, and a product tag; these should look like real printed paper with slight texture, tiny alignment imperfections, and soft shadows.
- Color palette: faded cream, coral, sage, beige kraft, soft ivory, muted blush, warm gray ink, and natural eucalyptus green; keep the bouquet elegant and giftable.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow under the bouquet, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, with natural contact shadows only.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: {카메라·렌즈}, with a clean medium-format editorial look and precise floral detail.
- Lighting: {라이팅}, large window light from the left at about 45°, diffused with sheer white curtain, gentle fill from the right, soft shadow falloff.
- Color grade: {필름·톤}, creamy highlights, soft coral midtones, muted sage greens, low contrast, gentle film grain.
- Material realism: show matte kraft paper fibers, semi-translucent bouquet wrap layers, satin ribbon highlights, natural petal translucency, pollen centers, eucalyptus powdery texture, and linen weave.

[6. MOOD]
Premium florist editorial — Kinfolk magazine spread feel meets high-end shopping mall product photography, warm Korean gift culture, quiet luxury, freshly prepared bouquet before delivery.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Visible Korean text must be readable and correctly spelled: card text “{카드 문구}”, shop label “{플로리스트명}”, product tag “{상품 코드} · {가격 정보}”, date/location label “{날짜·장소 라벨}”.
- Add a small care card reading “물올림 후 서늘한 곳에 보관하세요” and a tiny delivery memo reading “오늘 픽업 15:30” if the composition allows.
- Bouquet realism: petals, ribbon, wrapping folds, stem angles, and flower proportions must look natural and gift-ready; avoid artificial symmetry.
- Overhead version must preserve a believable top-down flower arrangement with correct depth cues; shoulder-close version must show natural hands, fabric shoulder texture, and believable bouquet scale.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Unrealistic plastic-looking flowers or impossible bouquet structure

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean lifestyle beverage advertising poster for a trendy highball or non-alcoholic cocktail, designed for Instagram, café wall display, pop-up store promotion, and lifestyle magazine placement.
Casual editorial commercial poster with a transparent can/bottle hero, realistic chilled condensation, fresh garnish cues, event-style campaign information, and premium retail appeal.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero product is placed slightly right of center, occupying about 42% of the frame height, with {브랜드·제품명·도수} as the primary focal point.
- Supporting lifestyle scene uses {모델 톤} in a softly cropped background layer, keeping the face and body secondary to the product while still feeling like a real café terrace or studio pop-up moment.
- Background is a bright white-to-mint beverage campaign set with a lightly textured tabletop, frosted acrylic riser, small condensation puddles, café menu-card edges, and natural garnish details that support the product story.
- Maintain strong readability around the headline and product label through layered typography, soft tonal separation, and realistic product-lighting contrast.
- Use {제품 카테고리}, {시각 컨셉}, {컬러 톤}, and {브랜드 정보} as customizable content anchors.
- Add believable poster information elements: campaign date, tasting event details, venue line, ticket/QR-style reservation block, sponsor strip, and small legal-style product notes in Korean.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 15%): set a trendy poster headline treatment with the product category first, then the product name and alcohol detail as a compact subline, aligned to the left. Include small uppercase campaign text such as “SUMMER SIP SERIES”, “VOL.024”, and a Korean date label “2026.05.24 — 06.30”.
2. Hero product zone (center-right 42%): render the transparent can or bottle with crisp condensation, visible ice, lemon peel, ginger slice, sparkling bubbles, and a reflective wet base; the label must be the sharpest element in the frame.
3. Lifestyle layer (left-lower 30%): add {모델 톤} as a natural, candid editorial presence, with a relaxed hand near the table, linen shirt sleeve, shoulder framing, or soft profile crop; the model should feel like part of a premium café campaign rather than a direct sales pose.
4. Ingredient / freshness accents: place lemon slices, ginger pieces, ice cubes, mint leaves, a metal stirrer, a small clear glass with sparkling bubbles, and a folded tasting note card around the base and edge areas, arranged like a premium café product shoot.
5. Color harmony: apply {컬러 톤} across background gradients, garnish accents, poster stickers, and small graphic elements, keeping the can/bottle label high-contrast and readable.
6. Copy block (lower 20%): place the main copy {카피 한 줄} in a bold but airy layout, with supporting brand info {브랜드 정보} in small neat text underneath. Add short Korean subcopy lines such as “상큼한 첫 모금, 가볍게 오래 남는 여운” and “레몬·진저·스파클링 블렌드”.
7. Event details and CTA area: include a small ticket-style block near the bottom or lower-right with “TASTING POP-UP”, “일시 2026.06.08 SAT 14:00–20:00”, “장소 성수 로컬 라운지”, “예약 @dailyhighball”, and “입장 무료 · 한정 시음”. Add a small square QR-code-like placeholder graphic that looks decorative, not scannable.
8. Sponsor / retail strip: add a thin bottom sponsor area with small Korean text such as “with CAFE SEOUL”, “LIFESTYLE DRINK FAIR”, “DRINK RESPONSIBLY”, plus tiny icons for ice, lemon, and sparkle.
9. Finish: add subtle editorial motion cues such as soft splash droplets, fizz bubbles, chilled condensation trails, and reflective highlights so the poster feels photographed and printed rather than flat.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main copy, Bold 700–800 for the headline, Medium 500 for supporting text, with tight but breathable line spacing. Use small condensed English labels for campaign metadata and sponsor strip.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} plus off-white #F7F7F2, pale mint #DDEFE5, lemon yellow #F6E56B, coral accent #F4A08A, dark charcoal #232323 for text.
- Graphic system: layered poster typography, small rounded sticker tags, thin warm-gray dividers, ticket-style information box, tiny icon row, and café campaign microcopy.
- Border/shadow: soft product drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 16% opacity; optional thin divider line in warm gray #D9D9D2; realistic glass reflections and wet-surface highlights.
- Text hierarchy: product/category at top, hero label in center-right, main copy in lower block, event and sponsor information at bottom.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end studio beverage photography, 85mm f/2.0 on full-frame or 50mm f/1.8 for a slightly wider lifestyle-commercial feel, sharp focus on label and condensation.
- Lighting: softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, subtle rim light from behind to outline the transparent can/bottle and ice.
- Color grade: fresh mint-white editorial grade with lemon highlights and slightly lifted blacks, similar to modern Korean café brand campaigns and Condé Nast-style lifestyle ads.
- Material realism: transparent packaging, glossy label ink, chilled aluminum or glass, crushed ice translucency, citrus pulp texture, mint leaf veins, tiny water droplets, paper ticket fibers, and matte printed poster graphics.

[6. MOOD]
Premium café-lifestyle beverage campaign — modern Korean editorial poster with a polished Kinfolk x Aesop commercial feel, enriched with a believable pop-up tasting event atmosphere and fresh summer retail energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함.
  - {제품 카테고리}
  - {브랜드·제품명·도수}
  - {카피 한 줄}
  - {브랜드 정보}
- Additional Korean poster text may appear and should be clean and readable, for example: “2026.05.24 — 06.30”, “상큼한 첫 모금, 가볍게 오래 남는 여운”, “일시 2026.06.08 SAT 14:00–20:00”, “장소 성수 로컬 라운지”, “예약 @dailyhighball”, “입장 무료 · 한정 시음”.
- The can/bottle label must remain legible and centered as the main visual point.
- Adult-appropriate commercial tone only; no underage cues, no intoxication, no explicit drinking pose.
- If a model appears, keep proportions natural and anatomy correct, with realistic hands and no distorted fingers.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Modern neon cocktail advertisement poster for a premium bar, vertical editorial layout, designed for social-feed promotion, venue marketing, and a real printed poster look.
Showcase a citrus-forward signature drink with a cinematic dark background, luminous neon accents, and believable nightlife poster details such as event information, ticket notes, sponsor strip, and small editorial credits.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster format: tall vertical composition with the central cocktail glass occupying about 48–55% of the frame height, headline area at the top 15%, event-detail band around the mid-lower area, and brand/signature block anchored at the bottom 14–18%.
- Primary subject: {칵테일명·베이스} in a crystal-clear cocktail glass, slightly angled hero view, with vivid garnish detail, realistic condensation beads, transparent ice, and bright specular highlights.
- Overall direction: apply {시각 컨셉} and {구도} as the main framing logic, keeping the drink dominant while surrounding it with credible bar-poster information and atmospheric graphic elements.
- Background treatment: deep navy matte backdrop with smoky gradient edges, faint neon sign glow, blurred bar-shelf silhouettes, soft reflections on a glossy counter surface, and subtle citrus peel shapes floating near the rim.
- Composition detail: let neon reflections, bokeh, glass shadows, citrus wedges, salt/sugar rim texture, and small light flares build a premium nightlife atmosphere around the glass without covering important text.
- Use {브랜드·바 이름}, {카피 한 줄}, {브랜드 정보}, and {컬러 톤} as the variable content blocks.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top headline zone: place {카피 한 줄} in a clean, bold modern sans-serif, centered or slightly left-aligned, with neon-style glow treatment that stays legible on dark navy. Add a small kicker above it: “SIGNATURE COCKTAIL NIGHT”.
- Hero center zone: render the cocktail glass as the main focal point, with ice cubes catching specular highlights, {칵테일명·베이스} liquid color clearly visible, and a fresh citrus slice garnish positioned near the rim. Add tiny droplets on the glass, rim sparkle, and realistic refraction through the drink.
- Event information zone: include poster details in Korean and numeric type, such as “2026.05.24 SAT 20:00”, “한남동 네온 라운지”, “입장 ₩18,000 · RSVP 권장”, and “오늘의 시그니처 1잔 포함”. Place these as compact lines or ticket-stub style modules near the lower third.
- Edge lighting zone: add neon reflections along the glass contour, especially on the right and upper edges, to create a glossy signboard effect while preserving the drink color and garnish detail.
- Bottom brand zone: set {브랜드·바 이름} prominently, followed by {브랜드 정보} in smaller supporting type; keep the hierarchy crisp and premium, like an upscale drink poster. Add micro credits such as “PHOTO BY BAR STUDIO”, “MENU NO. 07”, and “LIMITED SEASONAL SERVE”.
- Sponsor and utility strip: add a narrow sponsor/footer area with realistic small text such as “SPONSORED BY TONIC LAB · CITRUS MARKET”, “문의 02-000-0000”, and a small QR-code-like ticket block or barcode-style reservation mark.
- Supporting visual accents: echo the palette in coral and yellow neon bokeh marks, thin geometric arcs, citrus zest lines, small star glints, and subtle vapor trails so the poster feels lively and professionally art-directed.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the main headline, 48–72 px feel; use Pretendard Medium or Noto Sans KR Medium for secondary text, 22–32 px feel; use tiny condensed sans-serif for credits, ticket notes, and sponsor text; allow slight tracking for a polished poster finish.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 톤}; specify deep navy #07172D, neon yellow #FFD84D, coral #FF6F61, and white foam highlights #F6F7FB.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow under the glass, 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 18% opacity; use a thin neon outer glow on glass edges, plus layered reflections on the counter and small glow halos around event text.
- Text treatment: keep the Korean text clean and sharply rendered, with no warped letters, no broken strokes, and no confusing overlap. Use realistic print-poster hierarchy: large headline, medium drink/event details, small brand and sponsor microcopy.
- Decorative system: include thin neon line dividers, small corner registration marks, a ticket-stub perforation motif, and a few transparent citrus-slice graphics integrated with the background glow.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end commercial product photo look, 85mm f/1.8 on full-frame or 105mm macro equivalent, shallow depth of field focused on the garnish and glass rim.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at 45° with a narrow neon rim light from the right, plus a soft fill from the front to reveal condensation, ice texture, citrus pulp, and the glossy bar-counter reflection.
- Color grade: deep navy shadows, saturated yellow neon highlights, coral accent glints, and clean white foam sparkle; keep contrast punchy but premium.
- Material realism: glass must show thickness at the rim, realistic refraction, liquid meniscus, air bubbles near ice, wet condensation streaks, and believable caustic highlights on the counter.
- Poster finish: simulate a polished digital advertisement that could also be printed, with crisp typography, sharp product photography, subtle grain in the dark background, and luminous neon bloom.

[6. MOOD]
Upscale nightlife beverage campaign — Vogue Korea meets a Tokyo cocktail bar editorial, with a sleek neon sign aesthetic, cinematic bar ambience, premium citrus freshness, and a late-night invitation feel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as written: {칵테일명·베이스}, {브랜드·바 이름}, {카피 한 줄}, {브랜드 정보}.
- Additional Korean poster text may include: “시그니처 나이트”, “2026.05.24 SAT 20:00”, “한남동 네온 라운지”, “입장 ₩18,000”, “예약 필수”, “오늘의 한 잔”. Render all Korean cleanly and legibly.
- Keep the glass anatomically believable and cleanly shaped; ice cubes should look physically plausible and transparent.
- Ensure the drink looks adult-oriented and premium, with refined venue-poster styling and no intoxication cues.
- Make the neon reflection readable on the glass edges, but do not let it obscure the cocktail color or garnish.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Japanese sake advertisement poster, vertical editorial key visual for a premium alcohol brand campaign.
Designed as a refined print-style poster that highlights the bottle, sakazuki cup, seasonal Japanese atmosphere, and authentic promotional information for a tasting event or product launch.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical poster format with an elegant editorial composition: upper 18% for expressive calligraphy and small campaign metadata, central 52% for the bottle and cup still life, lower 20% for product details, event information, and brand footer.
- Main hero placement: {브랜드명} bottle and a small sakazuki cup centered slightly below midline, occupying about 45–50% of the frame height, with the bottle slightly behind the cup for depth.
- Background treatment: cream-white matte washi paper surface with visible fiber grain, faint sumi ink wash gradients near the edges, a few natural paper speckles, and soft shadows from real studio lighting.
- Framing direction: balanced Japanese editorial poster layout with calm spacing, a plum branch accent entering from the upper-right or left edge, and subtle decorative details such as a small red hanko-style square mark, thin vertical rule lines, and a tasting-note card near the footer.
- Use {브랜드명}, {제품명·등급·도수}, {카피 한 줄}, {시각 컨셉}, {컬러 톤}, {구도}, {브랜드 정보} placeholders naturally in the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header zone (upper 18%): render a large Japanese brush-calligraphy-style title in black ink, with visible brush texture, ink pooling, slightly irregular stroke edges, and a premium handmade feeling; add small vertical campaign text beside it such as “2026 春季限定”, “VOL. 04”, and “SAKE POSTER SERIES”.
- Main still life zone (middle 52%): place the ceramic sake bottle and the small sakazuki cup as the primary objects, with the bottle slightly taller and behind the cup; include a delicate plum blossom branch, a folded cream tasting note, a tiny pool of reflected light on the cup rim, and a few soft fallen petals on the paper surface.
- Product label zone: add clean, legible typography on the bottle label and nearby layout surfaces to show {제품명·등급·도수}; make the label feel printed on textured washi with fine black type, a muted plum accent line, and a small batch-style detail such as “LOT 05 · 720ml”.
- Copy zone: place {카피 한 줄} as a restrained headline beneath the still life, aligned to center or slightly left, using a refined serif or brush-inspired type treatment; add two short Korean feature blurbs nearby, such as “부드러운 산미” and “차갑게 마실 때 더 선명한 향”.
- Event and ticket zone: include realistic poster details in small Korean text, for example “시음회 2026.05.24 토 17:00”, “장소: 성수 사케 라운지”, “예약 ₩15,000 / 현장 ₩18,000”, and “문의 @woldam_sake”, arranged with thin dividers and careful typographic hierarchy.
- Brand info zone (lower 20%): set {브랜드 정보} in small, crisp text with strong hierarchy separation; include “20세 이상 음용 가능”, “순미긴조 추천 온도 8–12°C”, address/contact-style microcopy, and a small barcode/QR placeholder area labeled “INFO” without implying official certification.
- Overall rhythm: maintain a calm Japanese premium poster feel while allowing authentic print details, seasonal cues, product information, and realistic promotional micro-elements to make the poster feel like a real alcohol campaign.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: combine Noto Sans KR for small informational text, Nanum Myeongjo for refined Korean lines, and a Japanese brush-calligraphy look for the top title; use bold weight for the main calligraphy and medium/regular weight for footer, tasting notes, event details, and microcopy.
- Color palette: cream white #F5F0E6, ink black #111111, muted plum pink #D8A0A8, warm ceramic beige #D8C7B2, soft gray #B9B3AA.
- Poster graphics: use thin ink-gray divider lines, small vertical annotation text, muted plum petal accents, a subtle red hanko-style square graphic, and natural washi paper grain to create an authentic printed advertisement.
- Border/shadow: very soft drop shadow under the bottle and cup, 3px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity; no hard outline and no glossy UI effects.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product photography look, Canon EOS R5 with 85mm prime at f/5.6 for a clean editorial still-life rendering with controlled depth and crisp object separation.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, faint rim light on the bottle edge to define the silhouette, and realistic contact shadows on textured paper.
- Color grade: muted ivory + black ink + blush plum, with low saturation and restrained contrast, inspired by contemporary Japanese design posters, premium sake editorials, printed tasting-event posters, and boutique liquor campaign photography.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Japanese sake advertisement poster — quiet Muji x Kinfolk editorial still-life sensibility with richer print realism, tactile washi texture, seasonal plum details, and believable tasting-event information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must render exactly these strings:
  - 월담
  - 月談 純米吟醸 · 15%
  - 한 잔에 비치는 달 — 月談
  - 20세 이상 / 純米吟醸 / 정미율 50%
- Additional Korean poster text may include short realistic details such as “시음회 2026.05.24 토 17:00”, “장소: 성수 사케 라운지”, “예약 ₩15,000”, “부드러운 산미”, and “차갑게 마실 때 더 선명한 향”.
- Japanese/Chinese character accuracy: keep 月談 and 純米吟醸 clean, correctly shaped, and fully legible.
- Layout invariant: bottle and cup must remain the central product focus, with the top calligraphy, middle still life, and bottom brand/event information clearly separated.
- The composition must read as a premium 20+ alcohol advertisement and refined tasting-event poster, not a bar scene or drinking party.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Vertical premium whiskey advertising poster for a sophisticated adult audience, centered on a bottle-and-glass hero composition with luxury editorial styling and realistic print-ad details.
Designed to feel like a high-end spirits campaign poster for print, social, hotel lounge display, and premium bar promotion.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {브랜드명·연식·도수} whiskey bottle and a poured glass, placed on the center vertical axis with the bottle occupying about 40% of the frame height and the glass 20% at lower-right.
- Header area: top 15% carries {카피 한 줄} as the main campaign line, with a small date/collection label above it such as "2026 WINTER POUR" and "VOL. 12".
- Mid-frame: bottle hero shot front-facing with a slight 10–15° turn to catch the label edge, embossed paper label, foil cap, glass reflections, condensation-like highlights, and amber liquid depth.
- Lower area: {브랜드 정보} aligned beneath the bottle in a compact premium lockup, accompanied by realistic ad information such as "20세 이상", "TASTING NOTES: 꿀 · 바닐라 · 오크 · 은은한 스모크", "권장소비자가 ₩89,000", and a small QR/barcode-style information block.
- Background treatment: deep black-to-dark-brown studio backdrop with smoked oak texture, warm backlit haze, charred barrel curves, a polished dark wood table surface, and subtle dust motes in the light beam.
- Composition framing: tall poster crop, symmetrical premium balance with slight asymmetry from the glowing tumbler, angled ice cube, and reflected amber pour trail.
- Use {위스키 종류}, {시각 컨셉}, {컬러 톤}, {구도}, and {브랜드 정보} as the customizable layout and content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Title/copy block: place {카피 한 줄} at the top center in crisp white or warm ivory, with a short supporting Korean line beneath it such as "오크통에서 천천히 완성된 깊은 여운" and small catalog text "KOREA LIMITED CAMPAIGN / 2026.05".
- Hero bottle block: place {브랜드명·연식·도수} as the focal bottle in the middle, label fully legible, with amber rim light outlining the glass shoulders and neck; add tactile details like textured label stock, metallic stamp accents, batch number "BATCH K-1205", and a slim neck tag reading "SLOW AGED".
- Glass detail block: position a half-filled crystal tumbler beside the bottle, with one large clear ice cube, realistic caustic reflections on the wood, a warm amber glow through the liquid, and a faint smoke wisp rising behind it.
- Flavor/brand cue block: weave {위스키 종류} into the poster language via visual tone and small premium callouts, including "싱글몰트 노트", "블렌딩 밸런스", "오크 캐스크 피니시", or similar Korean tasting-card details depending on the product context.
- Footer block: place {브랜드 정보} at the bottom center in small caps style, evenly spaced, like a luxury spirits back-label callout; include micro text lines such as "MALT · OAK · TIME", "문의 02-000-0000", and "공식 판매처 안내".
- Atmosphere block: reinforce {시각 컨셉} through dark wood surface, controlled reflections, amber halo behind the bottle, barrel-room depth, understated gold filigree lines, tasting-note dividers, and a small sponsor/importer area near the bottom edge.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for Korean copy, with 28–40px headline scale and 12–16px footer scale; use clean modern English brand marks and refined serif microtype for tasting notes.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with specific accents of #C8922D amber, #E3B35A gold, #F2E7D5 ivory, and near-black #0B0B0C.
- Border/shadow: soft cinematic shadow under bottle and glass, 4px y-offset, 18px blur, 20% opacity; use thin gold rule lines, small divider dots, label-like panels, and warm reflected highlights rather than a harsh outline.
- Print finish: subtle matte paper texture with a faint gloss highlight on the bottle label and glass rim; add realistic poster grain, foil-stamp shine on selected gold type, and slightly darker ink density around the corners.
- Layout enrichment: include realistic poster metadata and product-ad elements such as "AGED 12 YEARS", "700ml / 40% ALC.", "BARREL NO. 0526", tasting icons, tiny legal microcopy, and a neat QR/barcode area without overpowering the bottle.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Hasselblad medium format look, 100mm lens at f/5.6, studio product photography framing.
- Lighting: strong amber backlight from behind the bottle at 30° high center, soft key from upper-left, low controlled fill from right, precise specular highlight on glass, and warm bounce from the wood tabletop.
- Color grade: deep brown shadows, warm amber highlights, restrained gold saturation, luxury spirits advertising grade with realistic glass refraction and label texture.

[6. MOOD]
Premium whisky campaign poster — Johnnie Walker / Macallan-style luxury spirits editorial with a refined high-end bar and oak cellar aesthetic, mature, polished, tactile, and cinematic.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear exactly as written: "12년의 고요 — 한 잔에 담긴 시간", "20세 이상".
- Add realistic Korean poster text in short, legible lines, such as "오크통에서 천천히 완성된 깊은 여운", "테이스팅 노트", "꿀 · 바닐라 · 오크 · 은은한 스모크", and "지나친 음주는 건강에 해롭습니다".
- Label accuracy: if any English label text is rendered, it must be clean, legible, and free of broken characters.
- Composition invariant: bottle and glass must remain the dominant subjects, with the bottle as the primary focal point.
- Adult tone only: premium sipping context, responsible-drinking framing, no intoxication cues, no sexualized framing, no youth-oriented styling.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Luxury wine advertisement poster in a magazine-editorial style, designed for a premium bottle-centered brand campaign. Emphasize a refined adult-only wine aesthetic with clear label legibility, realistic still-life richness, and elegant commercial polish suitable for a full-page printed poster.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical poster composition with the bottle as the primary hero occupying about 58% of the frame height, slightly off-center for a premium editorial balance.
- Place {브랜드명·빈티지} prominently near the upper third, with the bottle and glass arranged on a dark wood table plane below.
- Build a realistic luxury wine still life around the hero bottle: polished dark walnut surface, folded linen napkin, cork, small tasting card, subtle grape vine or dried botanical accent, and soft reflections on the glassware.
- Background should feel like an intimate premium wine bar or cellar corner, using deep brown and burgundy gradients, blurred shelving silhouettes, candle-like warm highlights, and matte paper poster depth.
- Keep {와인 종류} visually consistent with the bottle presentation and glass pour styling: red wine with deep ruby body, white wine with pale gold clarity, sparkling wine with fine bubbles and champagne flute cues.
- Use {시각 컨셉} as the core scene structure and {컬러 톤} as the dominant visual palette.
- Include refined poster information blocks: a small tasting event line, date/time/venue, reservation or ticket note, sponsor area, and decorative gold divider rules that support the luxury campaign without overpowering the bottle.
- {브랜드 정보} appears as a precise footer line with address/contact-style polish.
- The layout should feel premium and content-rich, with the label and bottle silhouette immediately readable at first glance.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header zone (12%): set {브랜드명·빈티지} in a refined editorial masthead style, centered or slightly left-aligned, with generous tracking and clean spacing. Add a tiny poster series label such as “WINE COLLECTION POSTER · VOL. 24” above or beside it.
2. Hero zone (middle 58%): render a single elegant wine bottle on the dark wood table, with a partially poured glass beside it; the bottle label must be the visual focal point and fully legible. Add realistic table details such as cork texture, condensation or glass reflection, a folded ivory tasting note card, and soft ambient bokeh in the background.
3. Secondary detail zone: place {원산지·품종·도수} as a clean small-text line near the bottle base or lower right, aligned with the luxury ad hierarchy. Add a second micro-detail line in Korean: “테이스팅 노트 · 산도 / 바디 / 여운”.
4. Main copy zone: position {카피 한 줄} as the main emotional line, with elegant spacing and a strong editorial hierarchy. Support it with short Korean subcopy such as “한 잔의 깊이로 완성되는 오늘의 테이블”.
5. Event detail zone: include realistic poster details in Korean: “프라이빗 테이스팅 · 2026.05.24 SAT 19:00”, “서울 성수 와인룸”, “예약 ₩45,000 · 한정 40석”. Use small caps, refined dividers, and antique gold accents.
6. Sponsor / partner zone: add a small sponsor area with text such as “PAIRING BY BISTRO TABLE · GLASSWARE PARTNER MAISON VERRE” and tiny line icons for glass, cork, and vineyard leaf.
7. Footer zone (bottom 8%): place {브랜드 정보} in small, precise type, maintaining an adult-only, certified-free commercial look. Include a tiny barcode-style rectangle or catalog code area labeled “AD POSTER 2026 / CELLAR EDITION” for printed realism, not as a certification mark.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Medium for Korean text, paired with a refined serif like Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display for the brand-style headline; headline size large, supporting text small and crisp.
- Color palette: deep burgundy #4A1020, dark brown #2A1A14, antique gold #C8A45D, warm black #111111, soft ivory #F3EBDD.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow under the bottle, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; no harsh outline, no glossy sticker effects.
- Add tasteful editorial decoration: thin antique-gold divider lines, small wine-spec glyphs, delicate corner registration marks, and a restrained barcode/catalog block that makes the poster feel commercially printed.
- Surface realism: show wood grain, glass caustics, cork pores, linen weave, paper texture, and gentle specular highlights on the bottle shoulder.
- Keep label typography sharp, aligned, and premium; the design should feel like a high-end wine magazine ad on matte paper.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame product photography, 85mm f/1.4 lens, medium close-up on bottle and glass, shallow depth of field with the label in sharp focus.
- Lighting: soft directional light from upper-left at about 45°, with a gentle rim light from right to shape the bottle curves; controlled reflections only, no blown highlights.
- Color grade: rich burgundy and dark walnut shadows with restrained gold accents, slightly warm editorial toning, high contrast but elegant.
- Rendering quality: realistic commercial product photography merged with premium poster typography; accurate glass refraction, believable wine color density, natural bottle curvature, and matte print finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium wine magazine advertisement — think Condé Nast-style luxury still life with the polished restraint of a high-end vineyard editorial, enriched with the atmosphere of a private evening tasting at an elegant cellar table.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함: {브랜드명·빈티지}, {원산지·품종·도수}, {카피 한 줄}, {브랜드 정보}
- 추가 포스터 문구는 선명한 한국어로 표시: “프라이빗 테이스팅 · 2026.05.24 SAT 19:00”, “서울 성수 와인룸”, “예약 ₩45,000 · 한정 40석”, “테이스팅 노트 · 산도 / 바디 / 여운”.
- Label legibility: bottle label text must be sharp, clean, and fully readable in both Korean and English where applicable.
- Adult-only commercial tone: keep the scene sophisticated and responsible, with no intoxication cues and no youthful styling.
- The bottle, glass, cork, table plane, reflections, and label must remain anatomically and perspectively plausible with realistic proportions.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-235.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean craft beer advertising poster, indie brewery zine style, hand-drawn label-forward vertical poster for adult beer branding.
Poster should feel like a limited-release can or bottle campaign with modern typography, rough illustration textures, real product-ad information, release-event details, and tactile print materials.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Primary subject: {제품 종류} close-up placed in the lower-middle 52% of the frame, angled slightly 10–15 degrees for dimensionality, with the label clearly readable and realistic metal/glass reflections.
- Brand hierarchy: {브루어리} appears as the brewery identifier in the top header zone, while {제품명·스타일·도수} sits as the main product title in a strong central typographic block.
- Background treatment: paper-like off-white base with recycled zine grain, faint halftone noise, screen-print texture, taped poster corners, small registration marks, and subtle ink smudges that feel naturally printed.
- Illustration placement: {라벨 일러스트} integrated directly on the label surface as hand-drawn artwork, with visible ink line variation, slightly imperfect edge registration, and label paper fibers.
- Copy placement: {카피 한 줄} positioned as the main slogan near the upper-middle or beside the product, supported by short Korean release blurbs such as “한정 양조”, “탭룸 선공개”, “신선한 홉 아로마”.
- Information block: {브랜드 정보} set in a compact footer area with small but legible text, aligned like an indie beer release sheet with spec rows, price, batch note, and contact line.
- Poster details: include event information in Korean — “RELEASE DAY”, “2026.05.24 SAT 18:00”, “탭룸 공개”, “입장 19세 이상”, “355ml / ₩7,500”, plus a small ticket-style strip and sponsor/support area.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 15%): place {브루어리} in a bold modern sans-serif masthead style, then support it with a smaller secondary line for {제품명·스타일·도수}; add a tiny issue-style line such as “BREWERY POSTER SERIES · VOL.024 · 2026 SUMMER RELEASE”.
2. Main hero zone (mid 45%): render {제품 종류} as a realistic packaged product close-up, slightly enlarged, with crisp silhouette edges, label readability, condensation micro-beads or gentle paper-label texture depending on the package type, and a believable cast shadow on the printed poster surface.
3. Label zone: draw {라벨 일러스트} directly on the label with rough hand-drawn strokes, visible brush jitter, ink trapping, small batch-number details, and printed-poster texture so it feels like a small-batch brewery release.
4. Slogan zone: set {카피 한 줄} in a high-contrast typographic treatment, mixing condensed sans for the product mood with a subtle handwritten accent if needed; add 2–3 short supporting blurbs in Korean: “홉 향이 터지는 첫 모금”, “몰트의 깊은 여운”, “오늘만 열리는 릴리즈”.
5. Event and ticket zone: add a vertical side ticket strip or stamped panel reading “LIMITED RELEASE”, “2026.05.24 SAT”, “18:00 OPEN”, “TAPROOM ONLY”, “₩7,500”, with perforation dots, small arrows, starbursts, and hand-drawn divider lines.
6. Info footer (bottom 15%): place {브랜드 정보} as a compact beer-spec block, aligned in a neat grid with small separators, including “ABV”, “IBU”, “BATCH NO. 024”, “355ml”, “보관: 냉장”, “문의: @brewery_official”, and a tiny barcode-style area that reads as packaging/poster detail rather than an official certification.
7. Sponsor / support area: include a small row at the bottom or side labeled “SUPPORTED BY LOCAL MALT · HOPS LAB · TAPROOM CREW” with tiny logo-like wordmarks, simple icons of hops/barley, and decorative dividers.
8. Final polish: keep the overall composition poster-like and collector-zine-like, with balanced asymmetry, layered print artifacts, tactile material detail, strong product emphasis, and clear separation between illustration, typography, event information, and product packshot.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold / Noto Sans KR SemiBold for headers, Noto Sans KR Regular for details, and optional hand-drawn accent lettering for the slogan; title size should feel large enough for a 1024x1536 poster, with clear hierarchy.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} should dominate, supported by off-white paper #F4F0E6, ink black #171717, muted neutral shadow tones, and small accent blocks for the ticket strip, batch label, and hops/barley icons.
- Border/shadow: thin printed-border feel with soft offset shadow 4px y-offset, 10–12px blur, 14% opacity, like a screen-printed poster layered on paper; add slight paper curl or taped-corner depth.
- Print texture: add halftone dots, slightly uneven ink edges, risograph-style color misregistration, small scuffs, paper fibers, and tiny speckles; avoid polished corporate-ad perfection while preserving premium craft quality.
- Decorative graphic elements: include hand-drawn hops, barley stems, small arrows, starbursts, measurement ticks, batch-number stamps, and a perforated ticket motif around the product without covering the key label text.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: product-poster realism with a 50mm prime look, f/4 framing, slightly elevated front-facing composition, as if shot for a craft-beer campaign reference board.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from front-right, controlled specular highlights so the label remains readable and the can/bottle edge stays crisp.
- Color grade: deep orange + dark green + cream white with muted print blacks, slightly desaturated midtones, warm paper highlights, and rich ink density in the headline and label art.
- Material realism: realistic aluminum can rim or bottle glass thickness, label seam, tiny condensation beads if appropriate, subtle dents or manufacturing imperfections, and a grounded contact shadow on the paper-poster background.

[6. MOOD]
Indie craft-beer zine poster — a mix of Vice magazine editorial energy and refined Korean taproom design, with the tactile feel of a small-batch brewery release, a real event poster, and a collectible limited-can campaign.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함: "{브루어리}", "{제품명·스타일·도수}", "{카피 한 줄}", "{브랜드 정보}"
- Additional Korean poster text should be readable and theme-fit: “한정 양조”, “탭룸 선공개”, “2026.05.24 SAT 18:00”, “입장 19세 이상”, “355ml / ₩7,500”, “보관: 냉장”, “문의: @brewery_official”.
- Label illustration must remain hand-drawn and rough, not vector-flat corporate art.
- Adult-only alcohol branding tone: no people drinking, no intoxication cues, no youthful or school-related imagery; the product can be promoted as a release poster or taproom announcement.
- If English text appears in the design, it must be clean and spelled correctly; no broken Hangul or garbled mixed text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-234.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean beer advertising poster for lager or pale ale, vertical campaign key visual. Emphasize crisp refreshment, condensation, foam, premium adult brand appeal, and a real outdoor summer campaign atmosphere for social media, print poster, and OOH use.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Central hero: {제품명·도수} in a large chilled beer glass, occupying about 55% of the frame height, with dense foam crown, visible condensation beads, amber beer translucency, and ice-cold mist around the rim.
- Brand lockup: {브랜드명} placed at the upper third as a confident masthead, with a small campaign date label such as "2026 여름 한정" and a slim issue-style marker like "POSTER NO. 07" nearby.
- Main copy: {카피 한 줄} integrated near the lower-middle, aligned to the glass silhouette so it feels like part of the poster layout and interacts with the golden reflection of the beer.
- Scene treatment: {시각 컨셉} with a realistic outdoor summer setting that feels fresh, premium, and lived-in: a sunlit terrace table, chilled coaster, scattered hop cones, barley grains, condensation rings, and warm bokeh lights.
- Background: {배경} rendered as softly blurred atmospheric context with hints of riverside terrace architecture, evening sky gradient, distant tables, summer plants, and reflected sunlight on glass or metal surfaces.
- Color direction: {컬러 톤} across highlights, shadows, typography accents, small decorative lines, ticket-info blocks, and sponsor-style footer details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header zone (15%): Set {브랜드명} in bold, spaced Korean display typography, centered or slightly left-aligned, with a thin horizontal rule below. Add small Korean campaign text: "2026 여름 한정", "프리미엄 크래프트 라거", and "POSTER NO. 07" as compact editorial details.
- Hero zone (middle 55%): Render {제품명·도수} as the unmistakable focal object, sharply lit with cool condensation on glass, thick foam texture, tiny water droplets catching the light, realistic beer bubbles rising inside, and a glossy wet coaster at the base.
- Support atmosphere (background 20%): Build {배경} behind the hero with softened bokeh, sunlit reflections, a faint suggestion of river or terrace architecture, wood tabletop texture, hop cones, barley grains, citrus peel, a bottle opener, and a chilled metal bucket partially visible at the edge.
- Copy zone (lower 10%): Place {카피 한 줄} in a clean, high-contrast type block with strong legibility and generous tracking. Add short feature blurbs in Korean around it, such as "첫 모금의 청량감", "은은한 몰트 향", "깔끔한 피니시".
- Event / ticket block: Include a realistic poster information strip near the lower area: "출시 기념 팝업", "2026.07.18 SAT 17:00", "한강 루프탑 테라스", "입장 19세 이상", "QR 예매". Add a small QR-code-like square and ticket perforation graphic without claiming official certification.
- Sponsor / pairing area: Add a compact sponsor-style row with invented Korean labels like "푸드 페어링", "라이브 DJ", "테이스팅 노트", plus small divider dots and icons for music, glass, and hops.
- Footer info: Set {브랜드 정보} as a compact legal-style line in a small, neatly spaced format, clearly separated from the main copy, with an additional small caution line such as "지나친 음주는 건강에 해롭습니다" and "19세 미만 구매 불가".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main Korean copy in SemiBold to Bold, with headline size around 72–96 px equivalent and footer size around 22–28 px equivalent; keep the type crisp and print-ready. Use smaller condensed Korean typography for the event strip, ticket details, and sponsor row.
- Color palette: Use {컬러 톤} with concrete anchors like golden yellow #D8A73C, cool white #F7FAFC, deep beer amber #B8742A, accent blue #5FA9E6, dark navy #112033, and warm terrace brown #8A5A32.
- Border/shadow: Add a soft drop shadow under the glass, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; use subtle glossy highlights, fine divider rules, translucent ticket panels, and small metallic reflections rather than hard outlines.
- Poster realism: Make the printed-poster design feel production-ready, with tactile paper grain, slight ink density variation in large flat color areas, believable typographic hierarchy, realistic barcode/QR-like micro graphic area, and high-resolution beverage photography integrated into the layout.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Ultra-real beverage advertising look, shot on Phase One IQ4 with an 80mm lens at f/4, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on condensation and foam texture.
- Lighting: Golden hour backlight from upper-right at about 30°, with a cool fill from upper-left and a faint rim light to separate the glass from the background.
- Color grade: Warm gold highlights balanced with cool blue shadows, clean white foam, and a lightly desaturated summer editorial grade.
- Material detail: Render wet glass, foam bubbles, water droplets, wood grain, paper texture, metallic bottle opener, hop leaves, barley, and citrus peel with realistic scale and depth.

[6. MOOD]
Premium beer campaign key visual with an editorial outdoor-refreshment feel, like a Condé Nast beverage ad crossed with a crisp Kinfolk summer spread, upgraded with a believable Korean pop-up event poster layout and tactile summer evening details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보이게 렌더링: {브랜드명}, {제품명·도수}, {카피 한 줄}, {브랜드 정보}
- Additional Korean poster text should be readable and natural: "2026 여름 한정", "출시 기념 팝업", "2026.07.18 SAT 17:00", "한강 루프탑 테라스", "입장 19세 이상", "QR 예매", "첫 모금의 청량감", "은은한 몰트 향", "깔끔한 피니시".
- Visual invariants: beer glass must look full and cold, foam must be realistic and abundant, condensation droplets must be visible, and the scene must feel adult-only and premium.
- No people dominating the frame; if any human presence appears, it must be subtle background atmosphere only and not holding the glass.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-233.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean traditional liquor advertisement poster for premium cheongju, yakju, or fruit wine.
Designed as a luxury vertical print poster that combines traditional ink painting, ceramic still-life product photography, and realistic commercial poster information such as release date, tasting event notice, store contact, and responsible drinking copy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical poster layout with a clear top-to-bottom hierarchy: upper calligraphy title, atmospheric Korean painting scene, central product hero, lower brand story and event information.
- Main ceramic liquor bottle and small traditional cup(s) placed slightly below center, occupying about 45% of the frame height, with refined still-life staging, natural tabletop texture, plum blossom petals, folded hanji paper, and a subtle gold accent line.
- Background uses {시각 컨셉} with layered Korean painting texture, visible hanji fibers, soft ink wash mountains, plum branches, and atmospheric depth.
- Arrange the calligraphy, bottle, cup, brand label, and information blocks like a finished premium liquor campaign poster intended for gallery display, magazine placement, and in-store promotion.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header area (about 18%): place large brush-calligraphy inspired Korean/Chinese characters reading {상단 캘리그라피} in dark ink, lightly textured like sumi-e on hanji paper, aligned toward the upper center with a small gold vertical subtitle {한자 부제} beside it.
2) Mid-upper atmosphere: build a painted landscape with plum blossoms, distant mountains, ink wash fog, and celadon-tinted air using {컬러 톤}; include a few falling petals and brush-textured decorative strokes that support the premium heritage tone.
3) Center hero area (about 45%): render a ceramic liquor bottle and a small traditional cup in a refined studio still-life style, centered and slightly forward, with realistic ceramic glaze highlights, engraved bottle label, condensation-free premium surface, and a subtle shadow anchor on a textured hanji or stone tabletop.
4) Product labeling zone: integrate {브랜드명}, {제품 종류·이름·도수}, and {원료 설명} as elegant premium ad text near the lower third; include a small product badge reading {제품 배지} and a release label reading {출시 정보}.
5) Copy zone (bottom): display {카피 한 줄} prominently, followed by {브랜드 정보} in smaller supporting copy; add poster-style details: {행사 정보}, {장소 정보}, {티켓 정보}, and {문의 정보} in a neat information grid with thin gold dividers.
6) Sponsor / notice area: include a small sponsor row reading {후원 표기}, a responsible drinking notice {책임 고지}, a simple QR-code placeholder labeled {QR 안내}, and a tiny vertical spine credit along the left edge reading {스파인 크레딧}.
7) Finish: preserve the ink-texture mood while making the ad crisp, polished, text-rich, and suitable for a premium editorial liquor campaign and realistic printed poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a mix of hand-brushed Korean calligraphy for the headline and Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for supporting copy; headline weight appears like bold brush strokes, body text medium 500–600, with controlled letter spacing and strong print readability.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} rendered as deep ink black, antique gold, celadon blue-green, and plum blossom pink; off-white hanji paper background (#F3EBDD) with muted accent tones.
- Poster details: use fine gold divider lines, small vertical captions, date/location microcopy, a sponsor strip, and a QR placeholder that feels printed rather than digital; typography should remain elegant and legible.
- Border/shadow: very soft drop shadow under the bottle and cup, about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; paper-edge vignette and hand-painted ornamental flourishes may be used to create a premium printed frame.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: premium studio still-life look, shot as if on a Hasselblad X2D 100C with an 80mm lens at f/5.6, clean product separation and fine ceramic detail.
- Lighting: soft diffused key light from upper-left at 45°, delicate rim light from upper-right, controlled reflections on the bottle glaze, no harsh specular hotspots.
- Color grade: warm hanji cream + ink black + celadon + muted blossom pink, with a restrained gold accent and slightly desaturated editorial finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean heritage liquor campaign — feels like a museum-quality traditional craft advertisement blended with a luxury cultural magazine poster, quiet, dignified, poetic, and commercially polished.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 렌더되어야 하는 문구: "{브랜드명}", "{제품 종류·이름·도수}", "{카피 한 줄}", "{브랜드 정보}", "{상단 캘리그라피}", "{행사 정보}", "{장소 정보}", "{티켓 정보}", "{책임 고지}"
- The final poster must visibly include realistic printed-ad elements: product name, alcohol type and ABV, release/date information, tasting event details, venue, ticket or reservation information, sponsor row, QR 안내, and contact information.
- The bottle, cup, and decorative elements must stay elegant and non-explicit; avoid intoxication cues, party scenes, youth-oriented styling, or exaggerated health/performance messaging.
- All typography must be clean, legible, correctly oriented, and natural for Korean premium advertising.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Minors, youth, or school-related imagery
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized celebrity likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-232.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Vertical advertising poster for a traditional-plus-modern Korean makgeolli brand, designed as a premium beverage key visual for print, store display, and social sharing. Emphasize refined product appeal, cultural texture, realistic promotional information, and strong commercial readability.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: a close-up of a ceramic cup receiving poured makgeolli, placed in the center 45% of the frame as the hero visual, with creamy liquid texture, tiny bubbles, and glazed ceramic reflections.
- Top zone: a large headline area occupying about 18–22% of the height, with {카피 한 줄} in bold, elegant Korean calligraphy style, paired with a small event eyebrow line reading {프로모션명}.
- Mid zone: {시각 컨셉} rendered as the main visual narrative, with the pour moment frozen crisply, the cup rim clearly visible, moonlight reflecting on the liquid, and fine hanji fibers visible in the background.
- Bottom zone: brand lockup and product details anchored in a polished information band, with {브랜드명}, {제품명·도수}, {브랜드 정보}, and a compact tasting-event block.
- Promotional details: include {행사일시}, {행사장소}, {입장안내}, {협찬문구}, {해시태그}, and {하단고지} as realistic poster text elements in the lower third.
- Decorative graphics: add subtle ink-brush crescent moon, thin gold dividers, small rice-grain motifs, nuruk-inspired circular patterning, and a tiny QR-style square for event reservation.
- Framing direction: {구도}, with a refined vertical hierarchy that feels like a premium liquor campaign poster rather than a plain product shot.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area: place {프로모션명} as a small top label, then {카피 한 줄} as the dominant headline, centered or slightly left-weighted, with high contrast against the moonlit indigo background.
- Hero area: show the pour of makgeolli into a ceramic cup in sharp focus, with creamy liquid flow, a soft splash crown, visible foam beads, ceramic glaze highlights, and a tactile tabletop edge in warm shadow.
- Product layer: integrate {제품명·도수} near the lower third as a polished product descriptor, sized smaller than the main headline but clearly legible.
- Brand layer: position {브랜드명} at the bottom center or bottom left as the anchor brand mark, paired with {브랜드 정보} in smaller supporting text.
- Event information layer: create a neat poster-style information block with date, time, venue, ticket or entry information, sponsor/support line, and hashtag text: {행사일시} / {행사장소} / {입장안내} / {협찬문구} / {해시태그}.
- Background layer: build a modern-traditional atmosphere using layered hanji paper texture, moon motif, rice grain details, and restrained ink-like shadows so the image feels editorial and culturally grounded.
- Commercial finish: align all typography to a premium grid, using thin gold rules and small icon-like markers to separate headline, product, and event details.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for product information and event details, paired with a handwritten Korean calligraphy style for the headline; body copy in Pretendard Medium at small size.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} translated into off-white cream #F4ECDD, ink black #171717, deep indigo #1D2B4D, and warm gold #C89A45 accents.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow under the ceramic cup, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; use fine gold separator lines and soft vignette depth for a premium print finish.
- Layout rule: keep the ad elegant and premium, with typography sitting on invisible columns, decorative details integrated as cultural texture, and event information readable at poster scale.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end commercial product photography look, 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens for the hero cup and pour, shallow depth of field with crisp liquid detail.
- Lighting: soft key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle rim light from upper-right, with controlled specular highlights on the ceramic and liquid surface.
- Color grade: moonlit cream and indigo base with restrained warm gold highlights, slightly desaturated midtones, premium editorial beverage ad finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean craft liquor editorial — a modern luxury beverage poster with the calm cultural polish of a Kinfolk x Aesop campaign, enriched with realistic tasting-event information and refined traditional ornament.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: {브랜드명}, {제품명·도수}, {카피 한 줄}, {브랜드 정보}, {프로모션명}, {행사일시}, {행사장소}, {입장안내}, {협찬문구}, {해시태그}, {하단고지}
- 포스터 하단 정보 블록에는 “{행사일시}”, “{행사장소}”, “{입장안내}”가 실제 행사 안내처럼 또렷하게 보여야 한다.
- 막걸리 따르는 장면은 물리적으로 자연스럽게 보여야 하며, 유속, 거품, 잔 표면 반사, 액체의 농도가 현실적인 전통주 광고 사진처럼 표현되어야 한다.
- 도자기 잔은 올바른 원형 림, 몸체, 굽의 원근을 유지하고, 한지 질감과 달빛 반사는 고급 인쇄 포스터처럼 섬세하게 표현한다.
- 전체 톤은 성인 대상 프리미엄 전통주 광고로 보이게 하며, {하단고지}는 작은 글씨지만 판독 가능하게 배치한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Distorted product label text or warped Korean typography
